items.titleEn: Watch Blue Jays prospects in Arizona Fall League action
bodyEn: The 34th annual Arizona Fall League season is underway, and you can watch top prospects from all 30 MLB organizations throughout October and November as AFL matchups are once again streaming for free on both MLB.com (here and on the AFL site) and MLB.TV.

All but five games of the 90-game regular season are available to stream completely free, along with the AFL Home Run Derby, Fall Stars Game, Quarterfinals, Semifinals and Championship Game. Additionally, the Fall Stars Game and Championship Game will be broadcast on MLB Network. All contests have Gameday available as well.
Here are the Fall League teams and their MLB affiliations:

Glendale Desert Dogs: Braves, Dodgers, Marlins, Pirates, White SoxMesa Solar Sox: Angels, Athletics, Blue Jays, Cubs, Red SoxPeoria Javelinas: Cardinals, Mariners, Orioles, Padres, RedsSalt River Rafters: D-backs, Nationals, Rockies, Twins, YankeesScottsdale Scorpions: Astros, Brewers, Giants, Rays, TigersSurprise Saguaros: Guardians, Mets, Phillies, Rangers, Royals
And here's a look at the upcoming matchups:
MONDAY
TUESDAY

Salt River (AZ, COL, MIN, NYY, WSH) vs. Glendale (ATL, CWS, LAD, MIA, PIT), 4:30 p.m. ETSince at least 2005, only one Twins prospect has swiped 50+ bases and hit 15+ homers over the course of one season -- Yasser Mercedes (MIN No. 17) in 2026. The 21-year-old has strong bat speed and generates plenty of hard hits, making him a prime candidate to drive in on-base gurus Demetrio Crisantes (AZ No. 1/MLB No. 84) and Dax Kilby (NYY No. 1/MLB No. 78) at the top of Salt River’s lineup. On Glendale’s side, Eduardo Quintero (LAD No. 2/MLB No. 15), Caleb Bonemer (CWS No. 2/MLB No. 27), Charles Davalan (LAD No. 6/MLB No. 79) and Tate Southisene (ATL No. 3/MLB No. 58) form a potent core packed with athleticism and power.

Mesa (ATH, BOS, CHC, LAA, TOR) vs. Surprise (CLE, KC, NYM, PHI, TEX), 9:30 p.m. ETThe Red Sox selected a pair of high-ceiling prep prospects among their first three picks of the 2023 Draft, and after slow starts, they’re beginning to emerge. Nazzan Zanetello (second round) and Antonio Anderson (third round) showcased their raw abilities during the regular season and are aiming to bolster their progress with Mesa -- which also features Arjun Nimmala (LAA No. 1/MLB No. 34). Another toolsy infielder, Welbyn Francisca (CLE No. 19), highlights a Surprise lineup that includes Top 100 prospects Sebastian Walcott (TEX No. 1/MLB No. 8), Aidan Miller (PHI No. 2/MLB No. 59) and Angeibel Gomez (KC No. 2/MLB No. 76). Francisca has a knack for finding the barrel and collected five knocks, including a homer, in his first fall showing.

Peoria (BAL, CIN, SD, SEA, STL) vs. Scottsdale (DET, HOU, MIL, SF, TB), 9:30 p.m. ETTai Peete (STL No. 17) found a new gear after he was dealt to the Cardinals in the Brendan Donovan trade last winter. The 2023 No. 30 overall pick -- who is making up for lost at-bats due to injury -- slashed .296/.359/.549 with 13 homers across 66 games, besting his previous career marks. He helps key a Peoria offense that also includes polished hitter Ike Irish (BAL No. 5/MLB No. 95). Headlining Scottsdale’s lineup is the elite prospect trio of Zyhir Hope (DET No. 1/MLB No. 26), Bryce Rainer (DET No. 2/MLB No. 44) and Nathan Flewelling (TB No. 4/MLB No. 63). All three have a penchant for leaving the yard as some of the top bats in the Fall League.
WEDNESDAY

Peoria (BAL, CIN, SD, SEA, STL) vs. Surprise (CLE, KC, NYM, PHI, TEX), 4:30 p.m. ETThere’s something about the Orioles’ Vance Honeycutt and Spring Training stadiums. After swatting homers in his first four at-bats this past spring, the 2024 first-rounder went yard in two of his first three games in Arizona. Honeycutt has been a force in the Javelinas lineup alongside system mate Ike Irish (BAL No. 5/MLB No. 95). Opposing the duo will be Surprise’s trio of Top 100 prospects -- Sebastian Walcott (TEX No. 1/MLB No. 8), Aidan Miller (PHI No. 2/MLB No. 59) and Angeibel Gomez (KC No. 2/MLB No. 76). Walcott missed most of the season after undergoing surgery on his throwing elbow, but validated his elite prospect status upon his return by slashing .325/.401/.590 with 10 homers over 41 games.
Subscribe to the MLB Pipeline Newsletter
THURSDAY

Surprise (CLE, KC, NYM, PHI, TEX) vs. Glendale (ATL, CWS, LAD, MIA, PIT), 4:30 p.m. ETJac Caglianone made the rare stop in the Fall League just months after he was drafted in 2024. This year, the Royals are giving Zion Rose (KC No. 6) the same treatment. The No. 6 overall pick this past July, Rose garners attention for his power to all fields and advanced bat-to-ball ability. The former Louisville Cardinal anchors a Surprise squad that also includes Sebastian Walcott (TEX No. 1/MLB No. 8), Aidan Miller (PHI No. 2/MLB No. 59) and organization-mate Angeibel Gomez (KC No. 2/MLB No. 76). Headlining the Glendale roster are Top 100 prospects Eduardo Quintero (LAD No. 2/MLB No. 15), Caleb Bonemer (CWS No. 2/MLB No. 27), Charles Davalan (LAD No. 6/MLB No. 79) and Tate Southisene (ATL No. 3/MLB No. 58). Quintero -- one of the most dynamic players in the Minors -- is one of just seven prospects with five tools graded 55 or better.
Scottsdale (DET, HOU, MIL, SF, TB) vs. Peoria (BAL, CIN, SD, SEA, STL), 9:30 p.m. ET

A trio of Top 100 prospects with plenty of firepower headline Scottsdale’s offense -- outfielder Zyhir Hope (DET No. 1/MLB No. 26), shortstop Bryce Rainer (DET No. 2/MLB No. 44) and catcher Nathan Flewelling (TB No. 4/MLB No. 63). They will be opposed by one of the Fall League’s hottest hitters so far in Peoria’s Ike Irish (BAL No. 5/MLB No. 95). The 22-year-old, who had his season cut short in July by an injury, has come out looking sharp at the onset of this campaign and aims to keep it rolling for the Javelinas.
Mesa (ATH, BOS, CHC, LAA, TOR) vs. Salt River (AZ, COL, MIN, NYY, WSH), 9:30 p.m. ET

A trio of Top 100 prospects headline this tilt between heavy-hitting lineups. Leading the way for Mesa is Arjun Nimmala (LAA No. 1/MLB No. 34), who has not cooled off since the start of his campaign in the desert. The 2023 first-rounder is riding high after claiming a Double-A title with Rocket City. Nimmala posted a .966 OPS with eight homers and nine doubles in 27 regular-season Southern League games. In the other dugout, Dax Kilby (NYY No. 1/MLB No. 78) and Demetrio Crisantes (AZ No. 1/MLB No. 84) highlight a Sal River lineup that has not been shy about putting up runs.
FRIDAY

Mesa (ATH, BOS, CHC, LAA, TOR) vs. Surprise (CLE, KC, NYM, PHI, TEX), 4:30 p.m. ETAfter enrolling at Southern Mississippi as a two-way player and pitching in his first collegiate season, Jake Cook (TOR No. 20) flipped to offense as a redshirt sophomore and caught the eyes of MLB clubs -- namely the Blue Jays. Toronto selected the 80-grade speedster in the third-round of the 2025 Draft and now he’s in the Fall League aiming to turn his tantalizing raw ability into production. Cook adds dynamic athleticism to a Mesa roster that is led by Arjun Nimmala (LAA No. 1/MLB No. 34). Opposite the Solar Sox will be Surprise’s contingent of Top 100 talents -- Sebastian Walcott (TEX No. 1/MLB No. 8), Aidan Miller (PHI No. 2/MLB No. 59) and Angeibel Gomez (KC No. 2/MLB No. 76).

Peoria (BAL, CIN, SD, SEA, STL) vs. Salt River (AZ, COL, MIN, NYY, WSH), 4:30 p.m. ETStanding at 6-foot-5, 260 pounds, Alex McCoy (SD No. 26) has the makings of a prototypical masher -- with unexpected speed. The 2024 non-drafted free agent has blossomed into a legitimate prospect for the Friars and is one of their most intriguing hitters in the desert this fall. The 24-year-old is joined by Top 100 prospect Ike Irish (BAL No. 5/MLB No. 95) among other potent bats on Peoria’s roster. Taking center stage for Salt River will be on-base specialists Dax Kilby (NYY No. 1/MLB No. 78) and Demetrio Crisantes (AZ No. 1/MLB No. 84). Crisantes collected multiple knocks in two of his first four Fall League contests, including a four-hit outburst on Oct. 9.

Glendale (ATL, CWS, LAD, MIA, PIT) vs. Scottsdale (DET, HOU, MIL, SF, TB), 9:30 p.m. ETFresh off a season in which he posted the second 30+ homer campaign by a Pirates prospect since 2019 (Murf Gray completed the feat a day prior), Jhonny Severino (PIT No. 28) added another homer to his 2026 ledger by belting a 106.6 mph, 417-foot wallop in his second contest of the fall. The 21-year-old with impressive pull-side pop is one of several dynamic talents on Glendale, including Top 100 prospects Eduardo Quintero (LAD No. 2/MLB No. 15), Caleb Bonemer (CWS No. 2/MLB No. 27) and Charles Davalan (LAD No. 6/MLB No. 79). In the Scottsdale dugout, breakout 2024 first-rounder Braylon Payne (MIL No. 6) is aiming to build on his stellar season with a stint in the desert. Payne has high-end power and speed, which led to his first 25-25 season in 2026. Along with the athletic outfielder, Scottsdale sports Zyhir Hope (DET No. 1/MLB No. 26), Bryce Rainer (DET No. 2/MLB No. 44) and Nathan Flewelling (TB No. 4/MLB No. 63).
items.titleZh: 关注亚利桑那秋季联赛中的蓝鸟潜力新秀
items.summaryZh: 亚利桑那秋季联赛火热进行中，球迷可通过多渠道免费观看包括多伦多蓝鸟在内的30支MLB球队潜力新秀的表现。
bodyZh: 第34届亚利桑那秋季联赛赛季正在进行中，在整个10月和11月，您可以通过MLB.com（在此处以及AFL网站上）和MLB.TV免费观看全部30个MLB组织的顶级潜力新秀的AFL比赛直播。
在90场常规赛中，除了5场比赛外，其余所有比赛均可完全免费观看，同时还有AFL本垒打大赛、秋季明星赛、四分之一决赛、半决赛和冠军赛。此外，秋季明星赛和冠军赛将在MLB Network上进行转播。所有比赛也都提供Gameday（比赛日）功能。
以下是秋季联赛球队及其MLB所属关系：

格伦代尔沙漠狗（Glendale Desert Dogs）：勇士、道奇、马林鱼、海盗、白袜 梅萨太阳袜（Mesa Solar Sox）：天使、运动家、蓝鸟、小熊、红袜 皮奥里亚标枪手（Peoria Javelinas）：红雀、水手、金莺、教士、红人 盐河 rafters（Salt River Rafters）：响尾蛇、国民、洛矶、双城、洋基 斯科茨代尔蝎子（Scottsdale Scorpions）：太空人、酿酒人、巨人、光芒、老虎 瑟古拉仙人掌（Surprise Saguaros）：守护者、大都会、费城人、游骑兵、皇家
以下是即将到来的比赛对阵：
周一
周二

盐河（AZ, COL, MIN, NYY, WSH）对阵 格伦代尔（ATL, CWS, LAD, MIA, PIT），美国东部时间下午4:30 自2005年以来，双城仅有一名潜力新秀在单赛季中盗垒达到50次以上并轰出15场以上本垒打——2026年的Yasser Mercedes（双城第17号）。这位21岁的球员拥有强劲的挥棒速度并能制造大量扎实的击球，这使他成为将盐河阵容顶端的上垒高手Demetrio Crisantes（响尾蛇第1号/MLB第84号）和Dax Kilby（洋基第1号/MLB第78号）送回本垒打点的主要人选。在格伦代尔方面，Eduardo Quintero（道奇第2号/MLB第15号）、Caleb Bonemer（白袜第2号/MLB第27号）、Charles Davalan（道奇第6号/MLB第79号）和Tate Southisene（勇士第3号/MLB第58号）组成了一个兼具运动能力和力量的强力核心。

梅萨（ATH, BOS, CHC, LAA, TOR）对阵 瑟古拉（CLE, KC, NYM, PHI, TEX），美国东部时间晚上9:30 红袜在2023年选秀的前三轮中挑选了一对上限极高的预科学校潜力新秀，在开局慢热之后，他们开始崭露头角。Nazzan Zanetello（第二轮）和Antonio Anderson（第三轮）在常规赛中展现了他们未经雕琢的能力，并希望在梅萨巩固他们的进步——梅萨阵中还拥有Arjun Nimmala（天使第1号/MLB第34号）。另一位充满工具人的内野手Welbyn Francisca（守护者第19号）是瑟古拉阵容中的亮点，该阵容还包括百大潜力新秀Sebastian Walcott（游骑兵第1号/MLB第8号）、Aidan Miller（费城人第2号/MLB第59号）和Angeibel Gomez（皇家第2号/MLB第76号）。Francisca有着极佳的寻找球棒核心能力，在他的首场秋季秀中就收获了5支安打，其中包括1支本垒打。

皮奥里亚（BAL, CIN, SD, SEA, STL）对阵 斯科茨代尔（DET, HOU, MIL, SF, TB），美国东部时间晚上9:30 Tai Peete（红雀第17号）在去年冬天通过Brendan Donovan的交易被送往红雀后找到了全新的状态。这位2023年总顺位第30的球员——他正在弥补因伤缺阵而失去的打席——在66场比赛中交出了.296/.359/.549的打击三围，并有13支本垒打，刷新了其职业生涯纪录。他协助支撑了皮奥里亚的进攻火力，阵中还包括技术成熟的击球手Ike Irish（金莺第5号/MLB第95号）。斯科茨代尔阵容的头牌是顶尖潜力新秀三人组Zyhir Hope（老虎第1号/MLB第26号）、Bryce Rainer（老虎第2号/MLB第44号）和Nathan Flewelling（光芒第4号/MLB第63号）。这三人作为秋季联赛中最顶尖的打击力量，都有着出色的轰出球场的能力。
周三

皮奥里亚（BAL, CIN, SD, SEA, STL）对阵 瑟古拉（CLE, KC, NYM, PHI, TEX），美国东部时间下午4:30 金莺的Vance Honeycutt与春训球场之间似乎有着某种奇妙的缘分。这位2024年的首轮秀在今年春训的前四个打席全部轰出本垒打后，在亚利桑那的前三场比赛中又有两场将球轰出墙外。Honeycutt与同系统队友Ike Irish（金莺第5号/MLB第95号）一起成为了标枪手阵容中的一股力量。与这对组合对抗的将是瑟古拉的三位百大潜力新秀——Sebastian Walcott（游骑兵第1号/MLB第8号）、Aidan Miller（费城人第2号/MLB第59号）和Angeibel Gomez（皇家第2号/MLB第76号）。Walcott在接受了投球肘手术后缺席了大部分赛季，但在复出后通过在41场比赛中交出.325/.401/.590的打击三围外加10支本垒打，证明了其顶尖潜力新秀的地位。
订阅 MLB Pipeline 通讯
周四

瑟古拉（CLE, KC, NYM, PHI, TEX）对阵 格伦代尔（ATL, CWS, LAD, MIA, PIT），美国东部时间下午4:30 Jac Caglianone在2024年被选中仅几个月后便罕见地登陆秋季联赛。今年，皇家队对Zion Rose（皇家第6号）采取了相同的待遇。作为今年7月总顺位第6的新秀，Rose因其能够打向各个方向的力量以及先进的击球能力而备受瞩目。这位前路易斯安那红雀队球员撑起了瑟古拉的阵容，阵中还包括Sebastian Walcott（游骑兵第1号/MLB第8号）、Aidan Miller（费城人第2号/MLB第59号）以及同组织队友Angeibel Gomez（皇家第2号/MLB第76号）。格伦代尔的领衔阵容则是百大潜力新秀Eduardo Quintero（道奇第2号/MLB第15号）、Caleb Bonemer（白袜第2号/MLB第27号）、Charles Davalan（道奇第6号/MLB第79号）和Tate Southisene（勇士第3号/MLB第58号）。Quintero作为小联盟中最具动态活力的球员之一，是仅有的七位拥有五项评分达到55或更高工具的潜力新秀之一。
斯科茨代尔（DET, HOU, MIL, SF, TB）对阵 皮奥里亚（BAL, CIN, SD, SEA, STL），美国东部时间晚上9:30

三位拥有强大火力的百大潜力新秀领衔斯科茨代尔的进攻端——外野手Zyhir Hope（老虎第1号/MLB第26号）、游击手Bryce Rainer（老虎第2号/MLB第44号）和捕手Nathan Flewelling（光芒第4号/MLB第63号）。他们将迎战秋季联赛至今手感最火热的打者之一——皮奥里亚的Ike Irish（金莺第5号/MLB第95号）。这位22岁的球员在7月因伤提前结束了赛季，但在本次赛事开局阶段展现出了锐利的竞技状态，并渴望在标枪手延续这一势头。
梅萨（ATH, BOS, CHC, LAA, TOR）对阵 盐河（AZ, COL, MIN, NYY, WSH），美国东部时间晚上9:30

三位百大潜力新秀领衔这场强打阵容之间的对决。领跑梅萨的是Arjun Nimmala（天使第1号/MLB第34号），他在沙漠中开启赛事以来便一直保持火热状态。这位2023年的首轮秀在随火箭城（Rocket City）夺得双A冠军后气势正盛。Nimmala在27场常规赛南部联盟（Southern League）比赛中交出了.966的OPS，外加8支本垒打和9支二垒安打。在另一个休息区内，Dax Kilby（洋基第1号/MLB第78号）和Demetrio Crisantes（响尾蛇第1号/MLB第84号）则成为了盐河阵容的亮点，该阵容在得分方面一直毫不手软。
周五

梅萨（ATH, BOS, CHC, LAA, TOR）对阵 瑟古拉（CLE, KC, NYM, PHI, TEX），美国东部时间下午4:30 Jake Cook（蓝鸟第20号）在南密西西比大学（Southern Mississippi）注册为双刀流球员并在大学首季担任投手后，作为红衫大二生转战进攻端，并吸引了MLB球团尤其是蓝鸟队的目光。多伦多在2025年选秀第三轮挑选了这位80级速度的球员，现在他正身处秋季联赛，力求将他诱人的纯粹天赋转化为场上产出。Cook为以Arjun Nimmala（天使第1号/MLB第34号）为首的梅萨阵容增添了极具动态的运动能力。与太阳袜对垒的将是瑟古拉的百大新秀阵容——Sebastian Walcott（游骑兵第1号/MLB第8号）、Aidan Miller（费城人第2号/MLB第59号）和Angeibel Gomez（皇家第2号/MLB第76号）。

皮奥里亚（BAL, CIN, SD, SEA, STL）对阵 盐河（AZ, COL, MIN, NYY, WSH），美国东部时间下午4:30 身高6尺5寸、体重260磅的Alex McCoy（教士第26号）具备了原型重炮手的特质——且兼具意料之外的速度。这位2024年未被选中的自由球员已经为教士队成长为一名正牌潜力新秀，也是他们今年秋天在沙漠中最引人注目的打者之一。这位24岁的球员与百大潜力新秀Ike Irish（金莺第5号/MLB第95号）以及皮奥里亚阵容中的其他强打者并肩作战。盐河队的焦点则将是上垒专家Dax Kilby（洋基第1号/MLB第78号）和Demetrio Crisantes（响尾蛇第1号/MLB第84号）。Crisantes在前四场秋季联赛中的两场比赛里收获多支安打，其中包括10月9日单场狂敲4安的爆发表现。

格伦代尔（ATL, CWS, LAD, MIA, PIT）对阵 斯科茨代尔（DET, HOU, MIL, SF, TB），美国东部时间晚上9:30 在经历了一个打出海盗自2019年以来第二多单季30+本垒打的赛季（Murf Gray在前一天刚完成这一壮举）之后，Jhonny Severino（海盗第28号）在他的秋季联赛第二场比赛中轰出了一记时速106.6英里、飞翔417英尺的墙外本垒打，为他的2026年数据再添一轰。这位21岁、拥有惊人拉打力量的球员是格伦代尔众多充满动态的天赋球员之一，其中还包括百大潜力新秀Eduardo Quintero（道奇第2号/MLB第15号）、Caleb Bonemer（白袜第2号/MLB第27号）和Charles Davalan（道奇第6号/MLB第79号）。在斯科茨代尔休息区，2024年实现爆发的首轮秀Braylon Payne（酿酒人第6号）正力求通过在沙漠中的磨炼，在自己出色的赛季基础更上一层楼。Payne拥有高端的力量和速度，这促成了他在2026年达成生涯首个25-25赛季。除了这位运动能力出色的外野手外，斯科茨代尔还拥有Zyhir Hope（老虎第1号/MLB第26号）、Bryce Rainer（老虎第2号/MLB第44号）和Nathan Flewelling（光芒第4号/MLB第63号）。
items.author: Rob Terranova, Brendan Samson and Michael Avallone

items.titleEn: Here's one stat from each farm system that caught our eye in 2026
bodyEn: The most important thing for prospects is development: learning how to be a professional, acquiring new skills, sharpening tools or pitches. There often can be bumps in the road along the path to the big leagues, and it's important to note that performance and production in the moment isn't necessarily the be-all/end-all in projecting future success.

Sometimes, though, top prospects also put up impressive numbers on that developmental journey and the game is still very much results-based. Below is a standout stat from a prospect in each organization. In many cases, each of these players sat at, or near, the top of their systems not only in the category we chose to highlight, but in many others as well. Not surprisingly, a good amount of these high-performing prospects earned organizational hitting or pitching prospect of the year nods a week ago.
Jump to: AL East | AL Central | AL West | NL East | NL Central | NL West
AMERICAN LEAGUE EAST

Blue Jays: 36.0 K%Nolan Perry, RHP (No. 2/MLB No. 90)A 12th-round pick in 2022, Perry missed the 2025 season due to Tommy John surgery, but he sure shook off the rust in a hurry while reaching Double-A for the first time in 2026. His strikeout percentage -- he whiffed 117 in 82 2/3 innings -- led the Blue Jays and was fourth among all Minor League pitchers with at least 80 IP. He was also top 10 with his 2.50 ERA, .181 BAA, 1.02 WHIP, 12.7 K/9 and 26.2 K-BB%.

Orioles: .186 BAAJoseph Dzierwa, LHP (No. 3/MLB No. 69)The 6-foot-8 lefty was the Orioles' second-rounder in 2025 out of Michigan State and made the most of his first full season, spending most of it in Double-A. He led all Minor League pitchers with that .186 batting average against, while also topping them with his 0.90 WHIP and finishing second in ERA (2.27).

Rays: 22 HR, 44 SBTheo Gillen, OF (No. 2/MLB No. 16)Gillen was one of only five Minor Leaguers to have a 20-40 season, as he reached Double-A at age 20. The 2024 first-rounder got to his power more consistently and finished the year with a .965 OPS, tops in the Rays organization and 15th among qualified full-season Minor Leaguers.

Red Sox: 32.2 K%Dylan Brown, LHP (No. 19)Brown ranked second in the Minors in strikeout rate among official qualifiers, a shade behind Marlins left-hander Julio Mendez (32.3 percent), and also topped Red Sox farmhands in ERA (3.46) and strikeouts (143 in 106 2/3 innings between Single-A and High-A) during his pro debut. The 2025 eighth-rounder from Old Dominion has a fastball that tops out at 95 mph but misses bats with command and deception.

Yankees: .358 AVG, 16 HR, 67 RBIWilberson De Pena, OF (No. 13)Acquired from the Angels in exchange for Oswald Peraza at the 2025 Trade Deadline, De Pena earned MVP and top prospect accolades in the Rookie-level Florida Complex League after winning the triple crown. He also paced the FCL in slugging (.677), OPS (1.088), hits (81), doubles (20), extra-base hits (38) and total bases (153) while displaying well above-average raw power and flashing plus speed.
AMERICAN LEAGUE CENTRAL

Guardians: .952 OPSCooper Ingle, C/OF (No. 4)Ingle was named International League MVP after topping the Triple-A circuit in OPS, wRC+ (151) and walk rate (18 percent). The 2023 fourth-rounder from Clemson is a disciplined hitter with average power and more athleticism than most catchers.

Royals: 1.120 OPSAngeibel Gomez, OF (No. 2/MLB No. 76)We know we have to take Rookie-level Dominican Summer League stats with a grain of salt, but it's hard not to get excited about Gomez, especially after seeing him holding his own at age 17 in the Arizona Fall League. Signed for $2.9 million in January, Gomez led qualified Royals prospects at any level in OPS, SLG (.652) and ISO (.292).

Tigers: 13.5 K%Max Anderson, 2B/3B (No. 10)We might need to start a "Free the prospect" campaign because it's clear Anderson is ready for a big league shot offensively, but without a clear spot in Detroit for him. He topped all qualified Tigers players with that minuscule strikeout rate, in line with his career numbers, and he also led the system with a 134 wRC+.

Twins: 417 PAWalker Jenkins, OF (No. 1/MLB No. 13)Plate appearances aren’t exactly a new-fangled stat, but it stands out for Jenkins, who has had some issues with staying healthy. The 417 PA combine his Minor League and big league debut totals and represent a career high. When he's been on the field, he's produced, and this year was no different, with his .939 OPS with Triple-A St. Paul giving the Twins confidence to call him up for the first time.

White Sox: 69 XBHCaleb Bonemer, 3B/SS/OF (No. 2/MLB No. 27)Bonemer won Single-A Carolina League MVP honors in his 2025 pro debut, then demonstrated significantly more power in his second pro season. He led the Minor Leagues in extra-base hits while boosting his home run production from 12 to 37 (fifth in the Minors), the result of turning his right-handed swing loose more often and with an improved launch angle, enabling him to hit balls harder and farther. The 2024 second-rounder from a Michigan high school ranks as baseball's best third-base prospect but is focusing on the outfield in the Arizona Fall League to expedite his bat to the big leagues.
AMERICAN LEAGUE WEST

Angels: 24.0 K-BB%Tyler Bremner, RHP (No. 2/MLB No. 42)While an early illness limited Bremner's workload in his first full season, the No. 2 overall pick in the 2025 Draft still reached Double-A and led the org (min. 70 IP) not only in K-BB percentage, but also in FIP (3.46) and xFIP (3.51).

Astros: 32 HR, 32 SBJason Schiavone, C/OF (No. 6)An 11th-rounder from James Madison in 2024, Schiavone went from hitting .180 in his first full pro season to posting the second-ever 30-30 season by a Minor League catcher in his second while advancing from High-A to Triple-A. He's a study in extremes with high-end exit velocities, patience bordering on passivity but also worrisome swing-and-miss rates (both overall and versus strikes).

A's: .904 OPSDevin Taylor, OF (No. 7)The A's second-rounder in 2025 began the year in High-A and finished it in Triple-A, producing everywhere he went. He led the system in OPS, and also in wRC+ (129) while finishing with a .308/.411/.493 line and knocking firmly on the big league door.

Mariners: 10.38 K/BBKade Anderson, LHP (No. 1/MLB No. 5)MLB Pipeline's Pitching Prospect of the Year led the Minors (min. 90 IP) in a host of pitching categories, including ERA (1.06), WHIP (0.64), average-against (.147) and walks (13), but that K/BB rate really stands out. The 2025 No. 3 pick's K/BB was 2.38 more than his closest competitor (fellow Mariner Ryan Sloan).

Rangers: .991 OPSSebastian Walcott, SS/3B (No. 1/MLB No. 8)Billed as the best Bahamian prospect ever when he signed for $3.2 million in 2023, Walcott likely would have made his big league debut this year at age 20 if he hadn't required internal brace surgery on his throwing elbow in February. But it wasn't a completely lost season, as he showed off his precocious bat and well-above-average power by slashing .325/.401/.590 with 10 homers in 41 games (mostly in Double-A) after returning in mid-July.
Subscribe to the MLB Pipeline Newsletter
NATIONAL LEAGUE EAST

Braves: 26 HR, 56 SBEric Hartman, OF (No. 1/MLB No. 38)A 20th-round pick out of the western Canadian high school scene, Hartman shot up the Top 100 with his breakout season as the only player in the Minors to turn in a 20-50 campaign. He reached 20-30 in just 71 games, the second-fastest to get there since 2005.

Marlins: 1.72 ERAJacob Kisting, RHP (No. 21)Traded from the Twins to the Rays last November for Eric Orze and then to the Marlins in a package for Liam Hicks in July, Kisting broke out by leading the Minors in ERA and ranking second in opponent average (.186) and WHIP (0.91). Drafted in the 14th round out of Bradley in 2024, he operates from a low release height that adds deception, owns a low-90s fastball that plays up with horizontal action and command and keeps batters off balance with two versions of a low-80s changeup.

Mets: 163 KJonathan Santucci, LHP (No. 2)The Duke product went in the second round of the 2024 Draft and has steadily pitched his way up the ladder, reaching Triple-A in 2026. He edged Jurrangelo Cijntje of the Cardinals, Cedric De Grandpre of the Braves and Adam Seminaris of the Phillies by one K for the Minor League strikeout crown. He led the Mets organization in K/9 (11.74), K% (30.8) and xFIP (3.73).

Nationals: .463 SLGEli Willits, SS (No. 1/MLB No. 6)The Nationals made Willits the No. 1 overall pick in 2025, and there were several other clubs that rated him as the best player in the Draft, but the one question was how much power he ultimately would have. An Oklahoma high school product who's the son of former big league outfielder Reggie Willits, he put those concerns to rest by hitting 14 homers and slugging .463 as an 18-year-old climbing from Single-A to Double-A. Guardians outfielder Juneiker Caceres was the only age-18 batting qualifier in full-season ball with a higher slugging percentage (.484).

Phillies: 176 wRC+Francisco Renteria, OF (No. 3/MLB No. 73)Renteria joins Angeibel Gomez as the lone players from the DSL to make this list. Signed by the Phillies last January for $4 million, Renteria earned league MVP honors after hitting .379/.470/.682. That 176 wRC+ led qualified Minor Leaguers at any level, as did his .682 SLG and 1.152 OPS. He topped the Phillies system in batting average, OBP and ISO (.303) as well.
NATIONAL LEAGUE CENTRAL

Brewers: 48 HRAndrew Fischer, 3B/1B (No. 5)Fischer's 48 homers were the most by a Minor Leaguer since Ron Kittle's 50 in 1982, and he also topped the Minors in slugging (.654), OPS (1.067) and total bases (287) while ranking second in RBI (114) and wRC+ (162). The 2025 first-rounder from Tennessee produces some of the highest exit velocities and launch angles in the Minors, but he also comes with some of the worst contact rates, both overall and against strikes.

Cardinals: .328 AVG, .408 OBP, .591 SLGRainiel Rodriguez, C/1B (No. 1/MLB No. 10)Rodriguez established himself as the game's premier catching prospect by leading the Double-A Texas League in all three slash stats at age 19 and batting a combined .324/.413/.574 with 27 homers and 11 steals in 115 games between that level and High-A. Signed for $300,000 out of the Dominican Republic in 2024, he still requires some defensive polish, but his bat should make him a star.

Cubs: 127 R, 120 BB, 70 SBKane Kepley, OF (No. 5)The Cubs selected Kepley in the 2025 Draft's second round out of North Carolina because he's a classic table-setter with plus hitting ability, speed and center-field defense. In his first full pro season, he led the Minors in runs (the most in a season since 2019), walks (the most since 2015) and steals.

Pirates: 40.4 K%Seth Hernandez, RHP (No. 1/MLB No. 9)The only thing that slowed Hernandez down was an oblique injury that ended his season in July. He led all Pirates pitchers (min. 70 IP) in several categories, including that K%, ERA (2.43), xFIP (3.19) and K-BB% (29.8). That 40.4 percentage was good for third among Minor Leaguers with that many innings, while he finished third in K/9 (14.35), fourth in K-BB% and seventh in xFIP.

Reds: .986 OPSCarter Graham, 1B (No. 22)An eighth-round pick in 2023, Graham had little to show for his first two full years of pro ball, but he jumped on the prospect radar by finally getting out of A ball and up to Double-A while slashing a combined .300/.421/.565 in 2026. He led the Reds in OPS and wRC+ (151) and all three slash line categories, as well as counting stats like home runs (29) and RBIs (93).
NATIONAL LEAGUE WEST

Diamondbacks: 27 HR, 28 SBAvery Owusu-Asiedu, OF (not ranked on D-backs Top 30)Acquired from the Phillies last December for Kyle Backhus, Owusu-Asiedu recorded the first 25-25 season ever by a D-backs farmhand. The 6-foot-4, 245-pounder possesses plus raw power and solid speed once he gets going.

Dodgers: 11 GJosue De Paula, OF (No. 1/MLB No. 4)The best offensive prospect in the Minors, De Paula required just 11 big league games to claim a spot on the Dodgers' postseason roster, going 10-for-31 with twice as many walks (11) and as many extra-base hits as strikeouts (five). Signed for $397,500 out of the Dominican Republic in 2022, he won Texas League MVP honors this summer after slashing .303/.401/.547 and topping the Double-A circuit in hits (152), doubles (37), runs (106) and RBI (104).

Giants: 3 straight league pitcher of the year awardsJacob Bresnahan, LHP (No. 9)Bresnahan earned league pitcher of the year accolades for the third straight season, adding High-A Northwest League hardware to go with awards from the Rookie-level Arizona Complex (2024) and Single-A California (2025) leagues. Stolen from the Guardians in a July 2024 trade for Alex Cobb, he confounds hitters with a 92-97 mph fastball with huge carry and a nasty mid-80s kick changeup.

Padres: Age 20Ethan Salas, C (No. 1/MLB No. 21)At 20, Salas was the youngest player in the MLB playoffs and started three of San Diego's four Division Series games. The top-rated prospect in the 2023 international class, he signed for $5.6 million out of Venezuela before struggling with injuries and getting rushed by the Padres in 2024 and '25. He bounced back to bat .296/.374/.448 with 10 homers and 17 steals in 96 games between Double-A and Triple-A this season and won the Minor League Defensive Player of the Year award.

Rockies: .402 AVGCristian Arguelles, OF (No. 5)Arguelles signed in January 2024 for $700,000, and in his two most recent main stops -- the DSL in 2025 and the Arizona Complex League this year -- he's hit over .400. He hit .422 in the Dominican, earning league MVP honors, then hit .402 in the ACL to earn another MVP award before getting promoted to full-season ball for the first time. He'll bring a .344/.434/.518 career line with him into the 2027 season.
items.titleZh: 2026赛季各队农场系统亮点数据盘点
items.summaryZh: 本文盘点了2026赛季美职棒各支球队农场系统潜力新秀的最亮眼数据。
bodyZh: 对潜力新秀而言，最重要的是发展：学习如何成为一名职业球员、掌握新技能、打磨技术或球路。通往大联盟的道路往往会有所坎坷，需要指出的是，眼前的表现和产出并不一定是预测未来成功的唯一决定因素。
不过，顶级新秀在这一成长历程中也常常交出令人印象深刻的数据，这项运动依然非常看重结果。以下是各个组织中一名新秀的突出数据。在许多情况下，这些球员不仅在我们选择重点关注的类别中名列其系或接近榜首，在许多其他方面也名列前茅。毫无疑问，其中相当一部分表现优异的新秀在一周前获得了球队年度最佳打者或投手新秀的荣誉。
跳转至：美联东区 | 美联中区 | 美联西区 | 国联东区 | 国联中区 | 国联西区
美国联盟东区

多伦多蓝鸟：36.0%三振率 Nolan Perry，右投手（第2名/大联盟第90名）作为2022年第12轮选秀球员，Perry因接受汤米·约翰手术错过了2025赛季，但在2026年首次升上双A时，他确实迅速找回了状态。他的三振率——在82.2局中三振了117名打者——在蓝鸟领跑，在所有局数至少达到80局的小联盟投手排名中位列第四。他的2.50自责分率、.181对手打击率、1.02每局被上垒率、12.7九局三振数以及26.2%三振保送率也均跻身前十。
巴尔的摩金莺：.186对手打击率 Joseph Dzierwa，左投手（第3名/大联盟第69名）这位身高6尺8寸的左投手是金莺2025年在密歇根州大选中的第二轮秀，他充分利用了自己的第一个完整赛季，大部分时间都在双A度过。他的对手打击率低至.186，在所有小联盟投手盘中领跑，同时还以0.90的每局被上垒率高居榜首，自责分率（2.27）则排名第二。
坦帕湾光芒：22本垒打、44盗垒 Theo Gillen，外野手（第2名/大联盟第16名）Gillen是仅有的五名打出“20-20”（实际为20-40）赛季的小联盟球员之一，他在20岁时升上了双A。这位2024年的首轮秀更加稳定地展现出他的长打能力，以.965的上垒加长打率结束了这一年，在光芒组织中排名第一，在所有符合条件的全赛季小联盟球员中排名第15。

波士顿红袜：32.2%三振率 Dylan Brown，左投手（第19名）在官方符合条件的球员中，Brown的三振率在小联盟中排名第二，仅次于迈阿密马林鱼左投手Julio Mendez（32.3%），在他职业生涯的处子赛季中，他的自责分率（3.46）和三振数（在单A和高阶单A的106.2局中三振143次）也在红袜农场中领先。这位2025年来自老道明大学的第八轮秀拥有一颗球速可达95英里的直球，并凭借控球和迷惑性来制造挥空。

纽约洋基：.358打击率、16本垒打、67打点 Wilberson De Pena，外野手（第13名）在2025年交易截止日为换取Oswald Peraza从天使交易而来后，De Pena在赢得新人级别的佛罗里达综合联盟三冠王后，获得了MVP和顶级新秀的赞誉。他在展现远超平均水平的纯粹力量和闪现出色速度的同时，还在FCL的长打率（.677）、上垒加长打率（1.088）、安打（81）、二垒安打（20）、长打（38）和垒打数（153）方面领跑。
美国联盟中区
克利夫兰守护者：.952上垒加长打率 Cooper Ingle，捕手/外野手（第4名）Ingle在国际联盟的OPS、加权得分创造（151）和保送率（18%）三项三振三振三冠（注：原文指三项数据居首）后被评为国际联盟MVP。这位2023年来自克莱姆森大学的第四轮秀是一名纪律性强的打者，具备平均水平的力量，且比大多数捕手更具运动能力。
堪萨斯城皇家：1.120上垒加长打率 Angeibel Gomez，外野手（第2名/大联盟第76名）我们知道对于新人级别的多米尼加夏季联盟数据需要持保留态度，但很难不对Gomez感到兴奋，尤其是看到他在17岁时就能在亚利桑那秋季联盟站稳脚跟。今年1月以290万美元签约的Gomez，在皇家任何级别的符合条件的新秀中，其OPS、长打率（.652）和纯长打率（.292）均居于领先地位。
底特律老虎：13.5%三振率 Max Anderson，二垒手/三垒手（第10名）我们可能需要发起一场“解放新秀”的运动，因为很明显Anderson在进攻端已经做好了登上大联盟的准备，但底特律却没有给他留出明确的位置。他的三振率微乎其微，在所有符合条件的老虎球员中排名第一，这与他职业生涯的数据相符，并且他还以134的wRC+领跑整个系统。
明尼苏达双城：417打席 Walker Jenkins，外野手（第1名/大联盟第13名）打席算不上什么新潮的数据，但对于一直受困于伤病的Jenkins来说，这个数字十分引人注目。417个打席结合了他小联盟和大联盟首秀的总数，创造了其职业生涯的新高。当他能够上场时，他就能产出，今年也不例外，他在3A圣保罗的.939上垒加长打率让双城有信心将他首次升上大联盟。

芝加哥白袜：69支长打 Caleb Bonemer，三垒手/游击手/外野手（第2名/大联盟第27名）Bonemer在2025年的职业处子赛季中赢得了单A卡罗莱纳联盟MVP荣誉，随后在其第二个职业赛季中展现出了更强的长打能力。他以出色的发力击球和提升的仰角，将本垒打产量从12支飙升至37支（在小联盟中排名第五），这使他能够将球打得更狠、更远，从而在小联盟的长打数中领跑。这位2024年来自密歇根州高中的第二轮秀被评为棒球界最佳三垒手新秀，但为了加快他的球棒登陆大联盟的速度，他目前正在亚利桑那秋季联盟专注于外野守备。
美国联盟西区
洛杉矶天使：24.0%三振保送率 Tyler Bremner，右投手（第2名/大联盟第42名）尽管早期的疾病限制了Bremner在其第一个完整赛季中的工作量，但作为2025年选秀的全体第二顺位新秀，他依然晋升到了双A，并且在组织内（至少投满70局）不仅在三振保送率百分比上领跑，还在独立于守备的投手独立防守率（3.46）和期望独立防守率（3.51）上名列前茅。

休斯敦太空人：32本垒打、32盗垒 Jason Schiavone，捕手/外野手（第6名）作为2024年从詹姆斯麦迪逊大学选出的第11轮秀，Schiavone在职业生涯第一个完整赛季交出.180打击率后，在第二个赛季从高阶单A升至3A的过程中，成为了小联盟历史上第二位达成“30-30”赛季的捕手。他是一个极端案例的研究，拥有极高的挥棒离球击球初速，游走于消极边缘的耐心，但同时也伴随着令人担忧的挥空率（包括总体及面对好球时的挥空率）。
运动家：.904上垒加长打率 Devin Taylor，外野手（第7名）运动家2025年的第二轮秀在赛季初从高阶单A起步，并在3A结束赛季，无论走到哪里都能输出产出。他以.308/.411/.493的打击三围和129的wRC+结束赛季，并在球队的OPS中领跑，同时对大联盟大门发起了强有力的叩击。

西雅图水手：10.38九局三振保送比 Kade Anderson，左投手（第1名/大联盟第5名）MLB Pipeline的年度投手新秀在多项投球类别中领跑小联盟（至少投满90局），包括自责分率（1.06）、每局被上垒率（0.64）、对手打击率（.147）和保送数（13），但那个三振保送比尤其引人注目。这位2025年选秀探花的K/BB比率比最接近的竞争者（同为水手隊的Ryan Sloan）高出2.38。

得克萨斯游骑兵：.991上垒加长打率 Sebastian Walcott，游击手/三垒手（第1名/大联盟第8名）作为2023年以320万美元签约时被宣传为巴哈马有史以来最好新秀的Walcott，如果不是因为在2月份其投球肘部需要进行内侧支架手术，他本可能在今年以20岁的年纪完成大联盟首秀。但这并非完全荒废的赛季，因为他在7月中旬复出后，在41场比赛中（大部分在双A）交出.325/.401/.590的打击三围和10记本垒打，展现了他早熟的球棒和远超平均水平的力量。
订阅 MLB Pipeline 新闻通讯
国家联盟东区
亚特兰大勇士：26本垒打、56盗垒 Eric Hartman，外野手（第1名/大联盟第38名）作为一名出自加拿大西部高中场景的第20轮选秀球员，Hartman凭借其爆发性的赛季在百大新秀榜上蹿升，成为小联盟中唯一一位打出“20-50”赛季的球员。他仅用了71场比赛就达成20-30，成为2005年以来达成该成就第二快的球员。

迈阿密马林鱼：1.72自责分率 Jacob Kisting，右投手（第21名）去年11月在涉及Eric Orze的交易中从双子被交易至光芒，随后在7月作为换取Liam Hicks的筹码包的一部分被交易到马林鱼，Kisting通过在自责分率上领跑小联盟并以.186的对手打击率（排名第二）和0.91的每局被上垒率（排名第二）实现爆发。作为2024年从布拉德利大学在第14轮被选中的球员，他从较低的出手点投球以增加迷惑性，拥有一颗90英里初速带有水平位移和精妙控球的直球，并能利用两种不同版本的80英里初速出头变速球来打乱打者节奏。

纽约大都会：163次三振 Jonathan Santucci，左投手（第2名）这位杜克大学的产品在2024年选秀第二轮被选中，并稳步向上攀升，在2026年升上了3A。他以多一次三振的微弱优势击败了红雀的Jurrangelo Cijntje、勇士的Cedric De Grandpre以及费城人的Adam Seminaris，夺得小联盟三振王。他在大都会组织中的九局三振数（11.74）、三振率（30.8%）和期望独立防守率（3.73）均名列前茅。

华盛顿国民：.463长打率 Eli Willits，游击手（第1名/大联盟第6名）国民在2025年将Willits选为全体状元，还有几家球会将其评为选秀中的最佳球员，但唯一的问题是他最终能拥有多少力量。作为一名前大联盟外野手Reggie Willits的儿子、来自俄克拉荷马州的高中生，他在以18岁年龄从单A晋升至双A的过程中轰出14记本垒打并交出.463的长打率，让这些担忧烟消云散。守护者外野手Juneiker Caceres是全赛季比赛中唯一一位长打率（.484）更高的18岁符合条件的打者。

费城费城人：176加权得分创造 Francisco Renteria，外野手（第3名/大联盟第73名）Renteria与Angeibel Gomez一同成为入选该榜单的仅有的两位多米尼加夏季联盟球员。这位去年1月被费城人以400万美元签下的球员在交出.379/.470/.682的打击三围后赢得了联盟MVP荣誉。这一176的wRC+在任何级别符合条件的小联盟球员中领跑，其.682的长打率和1.152的OPS亦是如此。他在费城人系统的打击率、上垒率和纯长打率（.303）上也同样居于首位。
国家联盟中区

密尔沃基酿酒人：48本垒打 Andrew Fischer，三垒手/一垒手（第5名）Fischer的48记本垒打是自1982年Ron Kittle打出50支以来小联盟球员单季最多纪录，他还在长打率（.654）、OPS（1.067）和垒打数（287）上领跑小联盟，同时在打点（114）和wRC+（162）上排名第二。这位2025年来自田纳西州的首轮秀打出了小联盟中一些最高的击球初速和击球仰角，但也伴随着一些全小联盟最差的击球率，无论是在总体上还是面对好球时。

圣路易斯红雀：.328打击率、.408上垒率、.591长打率 Rainiel Rodriguez，捕手/一垒手（第1名/大联盟第10名）Rodriguez在19岁时以双A得克萨斯联盟所有三项三围数据领跑者的身份确立了自己作为比赛顶级捕手新秀的地位，并在该级别与高阶单A之间的115场比赛中交出了合计.324/.413/.574的打击三围，外加27记本垒打和11次盗垒。2024年以30万美元从多米尼加共和国签下，他的防守仍需打磨，但他的球棒应能使他成为球星。
芝加哥小熊：127得分、120保送、70盗垒 Kane Kepley，外野手（第5名）小熊在2025年选秀第二轮从北卡罗来纳州选中Kepley，因为他是一名拥有出色打击能力、速度和中外野防守的经典开路先锋。在他职业生涯的第一个完整赛季中，他在得分（2019年以来单季最多）、保送（2015年以来最多）和盗垒方面领跑小联盟。

匹兹堡海盗：40.4%三振率 Seth Hernandez，右投手（第1名/大联盟第9名）唯一放慢Hernandez脚步的是在7月份结束其赛季的斜肌受伤。他在多项数据上领跑所有海盗投手（至少投满70局），包括该三振率、自责分率（2.43）、期望独立防守率（3.19）以及三振保送率（29.8%）。这一40.4%的比例在局数达到这一标准的小联盟球员中排名第三，同时他还在九局三振数（14.35）上排名第三，在三振保送率上排名第四，在期望独立防守率上排名第七。

辛辛那提红人：.986上垒加长打率 Carter Graham，一垒手（第22名）作为2023年的第八轮秀，Graham在他职业棒球的前两个完整赛季中并没有太多亮眼表现，但他在2026年终于走出了A球并升上双A，期间交出合计.300/.421/.565的打击三围，从而跃入新秀雷达。他在红人的OPS、wRC+（151）以及所有三项三围数据类别上均处于领先地位，同时在如本垒打（29）和打点（93）等基础统计数据上也名列前茅。
国家联盟西区
亚利桑那响尾蛇：27本垒打、28盗垒 Avery Owusu-Asiedu，外野手（未进入响尾蛇前30名）去年12月在涉及Kyle Backhus的交易中从费城人交易而来，Owusu-Asiedu创造了响尾蛇农场球员历史上的第一个“25-25”赛季。这位身高6尺4寸、体重245磅的球员拥有出色的纯粹力量，一旦跑动起来便拥有扎实的速度。

洛杉矶道奇：11场比赛 Josue De Paula，外野手（第1名/大联盟第4名）作为小联盟中最佳的进攻新秀，De Paula仅用了11场大联盟比赛就赢得了道奇季后赛大名单的一个席位，在31个打数中敲出10支安打，保送数（11次）是三振数（5次）的两倍，长打数也与三振数相当。他在2022年以397,500美元从多米尼加共和国签约，今年夏天在交出.303/.401/.547的打击三围并领跑双A安打数（152）、二垒安打（37）、得分（106）和打点（104）后，赢得了得克萨斯联盟MVP荣誉。

旧金山巨人：连续3年获得联盟年度投手奖 Jacob Bresnahan，左投手（第9名）Bresnahan连续第三个赛季赢得联盟年度投手荣誉，将高阶单A西北联盟的奖项与此前新人级别亚利桑那综合联盟（2024年）和单A加利福尼亚联盟（2025年）的奖项收入囊中。在2024年7月为换取Alex Cobb而从守护者那通过交易“偷”来的他，用一颗球速92-97英里、具有巨大上飘效果的直球以及一颗80英里中段、极具下坠变化的恶心变速球让打者晕头转向。

圣迭戈教士：20岁 Ethan Salas，捕手（第1名/大联盟第21名）在20岁时，Salas是大联盟季后赛中最年轻的球员，并在圣迭戈的四场分区系列赛中首发了三场。作为2023年国际签约班级中评级最高的新秀，他以560万美元从委内瑞拉签约，随后在2024年和2025年与伤病作斗争并被教士拔苗助长。他在本赛季双A和3A之间的96场比赛中反弹，交出.296/.374/.448的打击三围，外加10记本垒打和17次盗垒，并赢得了小联盟年度防守球员奖。

科罗拉多洛矶：.402打击率 Cristian Arguelles，外野手（第5名）Arguelles在2024年1月以70万美元签约，在其最近的两个主要效力站——2025年的DSL和今年的亚利桑那综合联盟中——他的打击率都超过了.400。他在多米尼加打出.422的打击率并赢得联盟MVP荣誉，随后在ACL打出.402的打击率又赢得一个MVP奖项，然后职业生涯首次晋升至全赛季比赛。他将带着.344/.434/.518的职业生涯三围数据迈入2027赛季。
items.author: Jim Callis and Jonathan Mayo

items.titleEn: Blue Jays lead AL with 5 Gold Glove nominees
bodyEn: The 2026 Rawlings Gold Glove Award finalists were announced on Wednesday, with the winners set to be unveiled on ESPN on Sunday, Nov. 1.
Each league has three finalists at each position, including the utility spot, which was awarded for the first time in 2022.
A complete guide to baseball's 2026 awards season

To determine the winners at the nine standard positions, 30 MLB managers and up to six coaches from each team vote from a pool of players in their league, excluding players from their own team. These votes comprise 75% of the selection total, with the SABR Defensive Index counting for the other 25%.
For the utility position, Rawlings collaborated with SABR to create a specialized defensive formula separate from the traditional selection process.
All-time Gold Glove winners
The Blue Jays and Cubs each have five nominees, the most of any club. The Braves, D-backs, Rangers and Royals have four apiece.
Here are the 2026 Gold Glove Award finalists. Each position’s finalists are listed in alphabetical order.
American League
PitcherTanner Bibee, GuardiansJacob deGrom, RangersJosé Soriano, Angels/Blue Jays

None of these three pitchers has taken home a Gold Glove Award, making for an exciting competition. Looking at the advanced metrics, Bibee has the edge in both Statcast’s Outs Above Average (+6) and Defensive Runs Saved (+5). Bibee’s and Soriano’s clubs, the Guardians and Blue Jays, have been heavily featured in this award this decade. Shane Bieber won for Cleveland in 2022, and José Berríos won for Toronto the following year.
CatcherDillon Dingler, TigersBrandon Valenzuela, Blue JaysAustin Wells, Yankees

Dingler has a strong case for the best all-around catcher in baseball, in no small part due to his elite defense. Dingler’s +17 Fielding Run Value (per Statcast) ranked tops among all catchers and was tied for third best among any defenders. He also led catchers with a +22.1 Defensive Rating, via FanGraphs. Dingler took home Gold Glove honors in 2025, so he’s looking to make it two straight years.

Alejandro Kirk has long been one of the best defensive catchers in baseball and was joined by Valenzuela to make a dynamic duo in ‘26. In just 91 games as a rookie, Valenzuela ranked as a top five catcher in terms of Run Value (+11) and Defensive Rating (+13.6). Valenzuela excelled both at framing and throwing runners out.

Wells has consistently been one of the better defensive catchers in baseball during his time in the Majors. He had a +10 Run Value in 2026, after posting a +12 figure in both 2024 and ‘25. Wells is an excellent pitch framer and also blocks pitches in the dirt with the best of them.
First baseVladimir Guerrero Jr., Blue JaysVinnie Pasquantino, RoyalsChristian Walker, Astros

Guerrero’s progression into one of the better defensive first basemen is a fascinating part of his journey. Whereas he was consistently below average for much of his career, Vlad Jr. flashed his newfound level of defense in the 2025 playoffs and had a career-best defensive season across the board in 2026. Guerrero is looking for his second award after winning it in 2022.

Pasquantino was solid on both sides of the ball in 2026 and improved his defense after his metrics were down in ‘25. He’s looking to become the first Royals first baseman to win the award since Eric Hosmer in 2017.

Walker is no stranger to the Gold Glove Award -- he won it in three straight years for the D-backs from 2022-24. He’s well established as one of the best defensive first basemen of his era and he’s still going strong.
Second baseMichael Massey, RoyalsChase Meidroth, White SoxCole Young, Mariners

A Gold Glove winner in the Minor Leagues back in 2021 as the best defensive second baseman in all of the Minors, Massey is an MLB Gold Glove finalist for the first time in 2026. The Kansas City infielder proved his worth with +11 OAA, behind only Jazz Chisholm Jr. (+15) for the most among AL second basemen.

While Massey had the edge in OAA, it was Meidroth who led all AL second basemen with a +10 FRV. Meidroth spent a majority of his time at shortstop as a rookie in 2025 (and still graded out as a plus defender in limited action there in ’26), but he proved to be excellent at the keystone in his second season.

Different metrics had considerably different opinions of Young’s defense in 2026. The Mariners second baseman was credited with +16 DRS -- tied for eighth in MLB -- but was tied for 35th of 42 qualifying players at his position with -5 OAA.
Third baseCaleb Durbin, Red SoxBrooks Lee, TwinsNick Loftin, Royals

Durbin took a step up defensively in 2026 after being traded to the Red Sox from the Brewers. After accruing +1 OAA during his 2025 rookie season, he racked up +6 OAA in ’26 and led all AL third basemen with +13 DRS. Across MLB, only Alex Bregman and Matt Chapman (both at +15) had more.

A position change turned out to be huge for Lee’s glove. He came up as a shortstop and played there primarily in 2024 and ‘25 (while seeing time at second and third base) but finished with a -3 FRV in both seasons. In 2026, Lee still struggled in limited action at shortstop (-6 OAA) but was excellent (+6 OAA) at third.

Loftin stepped into a bigger role for the Royals with Maikel Garcia hampered by injury and performed admirably, both on offense and defense. He played enough third base to qualify for a Gold Glove at the hot corner while also seeing considerable playing time at second base and in right field. Loftin racked up +6 DRS in 2026, although Statcast was much more critical (-3 OAA, -1 FRV).
ShortstopAndrés Giménez, Blue JaysTaylor Walls, RaysBobby Witt Jr., Royals

Giménez won three straight AL Gold Gloves at second base from 2022-24 before former Ranger Marcus Semien beat him out in ’25. After moving to shortstop for Toronto in ’26, he now has a shot to win another Gold Glove at a new position. Giménez finished the season tied with the Cardinals’ Masyn Winn for second among shortstops with +19 OAA.

Opinions on Walls’ defense are considerably split: DRS has him at +21 (tied for third among all players), while Statcast graded him as a poor defender (-2 OAA, -2 FRV). Known for his slick glove at shortstop, Walls is a Gold Glove finalist for the second straight season.

Witt won the previous two AL Gold Gloves at short and is well positioned for a third. His +24 OAA was third in MLB, behind only Pete Crow-Armstrong and JJ Wetherholt, and his +17 FRV was tied with Winn for the most among shortstops. The Royals’ star could make it three straight seasons winning both the Gold Glove and Silver Slugger awards at his position.
Left fieldCody Bellinger, YankeesWyatt Langford, RangersChandler Simpson, Rays

Bellinger is vying for his first Gold Glove since 2019, when he won the award as a right fielder for the Dodgers. The 31-year-old led all left fielders with +21 DRS, benefitting from plus range (+6 OAA) and an 93.3 mph average arm strength that ranks in the 94th percentile of MLB.

When healthy, Langford, 24, continued to play sublime defense for the Rangers. He started 87 games in left field and totaled +5 OAA, tied for fourth most among all left fielders. That range stems from a strong jump; only Pete Crow-Armstrong and Ceddanne Rafaela had better initial reactions than Langford.

Simpson is one of the fastest players in baseball, and he put all that speed to good while roaming the outfield for the AL-best Rays in 2026. Few players improved their range more than Simpson, who led all left fielders with +8 OAA in ‘26 after accruing -5 OAA in ‘25. How did he turn things around? Simpson worked closely with outfield instructor Corey Dickerson to improve his reactions, and now ranks among the top 10 in jumps.
Center fieldEvan Carter, RangersSteven Kwan, GuardiansCeddanne Rafaela, Red Sox

Carter remained mostly healthy this year for the Rangers, appearing in 140 games in center field. Boosted by elite speed, the 24-year-old totaled +11 OAA in 2026, tied for fourth most among primary center fielders.

For the first time in his five-year career, Kwan started more games in center field (77) than in left (65) in 2026. That’s why the four-time defending Gold Glove Award winner is eligible at a different position this year. Kwan often displayed his plus arm, recording 11 outfield assists – tied for third most in MLB – and taking part in five double plays.

Rafaela isn’t quite on Pete Crow-Armstrong’s level in center field, but he’s pretty close. The 26-year-old ranked second among outfielders with +16 FRV and +17 OAA. Rafaela’s 10 five-star catches led all qualified outfielders, which certainly passes the eye test.
Right fieldWilyer Abreu, Red SoxNathan Lukes, Blue JaysCam Smith, Astros

By at least one popular metric, Abreu was the best defender in baseball in 2026: His +28 DRS led all MLB players by a wide margin. Statcast doesn’t quite favor Abreu as much, but there’s no doubting the arm of the two-time Gold Glove Award winner. Abreu’s 95.3 mph average arm strength is a top 10 mark among qualified players, and his 13 outfield assists trailed only the Dodgers’ Andy Pages.

Abreu isn’t the only AL right fielder with a cannon. Lukes joined Abreu as one of seven players with 10-plus outfield assists this season. According to Statcast’s arm value metric, Lukes had the most valuable outfield arm in the American League.

Smith, 23, has only been a full-time outfielder for two seasons. And in each of those two seasons, he’s been a Gold Glove finalist. He looked more comfortable in right field this year, benefitting from improved range: His +7 OAA ranked in the 91st percentile of MLB and fourth most among primary right fielders.
UtilityJosé Caballero, YankeesEzequiel Duran, RangersZach McKinstry, Tigers

Caballero racked up +12 DRS while moving all around the diamond for the Yankees. He played every defensive position but pitcher, catcher and first base. His 0 FRV is actually the lowest of his career -- his best was +8 as a rookie with the Mariners in 2023 -- but Caballero is still a first-time finalist for a Gold Glove.

Duran racked up 4.4 FanGraphs WAR in 2026 thanks in part to stellar defense, tying for sixth in MLB with +17 OAA (including +11 at shortstop). He was a true utility player for Texas, making double-digit appearances at second base, third base, shortstop and all three outfield positions.

Versatility has always been a big part of McKinstry’s career, but 2026 marked the first season since 2021 where his most-played position was in the outfield. He made 62 appearances in right field, 45 at second base, 34 at shortstop and a handful at third base, in left field and in center field. His +15 DRS ranked in the top 15 among all players, and his +12 FRV was tied for 14th.
National League
PitcherMichael McGreevy, CardinalsNolan McLean, MetsChris Sale, Braves

McGreevy became a mainstay in the Cardinals’ starting rotation this year, and his prowess wasn’t limited to dealing from his seven-pitch arsenal. He was also excellent at fielding his position, to the tune of +5 Defensive Runs Saved -- tied for the most among pitchers in MLB.

McLean, meanwhile, got well-deserved notoriety for his strong rookie campaign with the Mets, but he was also right behind McGreevy with +4 DRS. And Sale, a candidate to win his second Cy Young Award, is also a finalist for winning his second Gold Glove Award.
CatcherFreddy Fermin, PadresGabriel Moreno, D-backsLuis Torrens, Mets

Fermin was well rounded in his defensive excellence this past season, ranking in the 86th percentile or better in Statcast blocks above average (+10, 93rd percentile), caught stealing above average (+6, 97th) and average pop time (1.88 seconds, 86th).

Moreno, who won a Gold Glove Award behind the plate in 2023, had a breakout year for the D-backs that could net him some down-ballot NL MVP votes, also ranked among the top 20% of qualified catchers in blocks above average and caught stealing above average. He was second only to Dingler with +14 Defensive Runs Saved.
Torrens was third among MLB backstops with +12 DRS, and his +10 fielding run value ranked in the 90th percentile.
First baseTy France, PadresMatt Olson, BravesTJ Rumfield, Rockies

France, who is seeking his second career Gold Glove honor after winning at first base in the AL last year, enjoyed a career year at the plate for San Diego but also led MLB first basemen with +15 Defensive Runs Saved.

The first baseman who ranked first in fielding run value, with +12? That would be Olson, who is seeking his fourth Gold Glove Award. And Rumfield, who emerged as a star rookie for the Rockies, proved to be more than an on-base machine (he led the NL with a .390 OBP) -- he finished with +6 DRS.
Second baseBrandon Lowe, PiratesBrice Turang, BrewersJJ Wetherholt, Cardinals

Wetherholt impressed both at the plate and in the field as a rookie, but at the keystone position is where he shined brightest, leading all second basemen and even coming in second among all players -- regardless of position -- with +25 Outs Above Average.

Turang, meanwhile, accomplished the same feat in the Defensive Runs Saved department, with +23 to lead second basemen and finish runner-up among all players. If he wins the honor this year, it will be his second Gold Glove Award after he won in 2024 -- he also won the Platinum Glove Award for the NL that year.

Lowe was stellar as well, with his +15 OAA tied with Turang and Chisholm for second among second basemen. It was quite the year-to-year turnaround for the 32-year-old, who had the worst range among any primary second baseman in 2025.
Third baseAlex Bregman, CubsMax Muncy, DodgersJavier Sanoja, Marlins

Bregman, who won his first Gold Glove in 2024 in his final year with the Astros, finished with +9 OAA, second among all third basemen behind only the Padres’ Manny Machado (+12). He has shown consistency at the hot corner, grading out as an above-average defender in each of the past seven seasons.
Muncy, by contrast, hasn’t been a plus defender by fielding run value since 2021 (+5), the only previous time he was a Gold Glove finalist. He had a 0 FRV and -1 OAA for the Dodgers in 2026.

Sanoja was the NL’s Gold Glove winner at the utility position in 2025. He continued to play all over the diamond in ’26, but he saw the majority of action at third base this time around. His +6 OAA ranked fourth among NL third basemen, and his +5 FRV was tied for fourth.
ShortstopGeraldo Perdomo, D-backsDansby Swanson, CubsMasyn Winn, Cardinals

Winn eyes his second consecutive Gold Glove Award following another strong season with the glove. In fact, his numbers in 2025 (+17 FRV, +21 OAA) are more or less identical to his numbers in ‘26 (+17 FRV, +19 OAA), even though a left thumb fracture limited him to just 136 games. One way Winn got better? His rocket of an arm was even stronger, with 94.4 mph average arm strength leading all middle infielders.

Swanson won consecutive Gold Gloves from 2022-23, and his defense ticked back up again in ‘26 after a subpar performance last season. The 32-year-old became more deft at going to his backhand, recording +16 OAA – more than all but three qualified shortstops – and anchoring one of the game’s all-time great defenses.

Perdomo set new career highs with +13 FRV and +16 OAA. In fact, through his first five years in the Majors, he accrued just +10 OAA. His evolution into one of baseball’s elite defensive shortstops earns him a spot as a Gold Glove finalist for the first time in his career.
Left fieldJackson Chourio, BrewersIan Happ, CubsDaylen Lile, Nationals
Chourio’s defense took a massive step forward in 2026, setting career highs with +9 FRV and +7 OAA in his third full big league season. He led NL left fielders in both categories.

Happ eyes his fifth consecutive Gold Glove on the heels of another above-average season in left field. Most of his defensive value comes from his arm; Happ recorded nine outfield assists in 2026, tied for eighth most in MLB.

Lile, a second-year player, drew 124 starts in left field for the Nationals, a year after splitting his time between DH, right field and left field. He handled the role admirably, with above-average range (+1 OAA) and a valuable throwing arm (+1 arm value).
Center fieldPete Crow-Armstrong, CubsMichael Harris II, BravesAndy Pages, Dodgers

Crow-Armstrong is the best defender in baseball. His defense was worth +23 runs, according to FanGraphs’ “defensive runs” metric, which paced all players. PCA also led the Majors in Statcast’s fielding run value (+26) and Outs Above Average (+26), with the latter tied for the most OAA by an outfielder in a single season since at least 2016.

Harris II put together the best defensive season of his young career, with career highs in OAA (+14) and fielding run value (+12). Pages accrued +13 FRV in 2026 – third most among qualified outfielders – in part because of a sensational arm. He led MLB with 14 outfield assists and has recorded double-digit assist totals in consecutive years.
Right fieldCarson Benge, MetsCorbin Carroll, D-backsSeiya Suzuki, Cubs

Benge, 23, burst onto the scene as an NL Rookie of the Year contender thanks in part to his sublime defense. He was one of seven outfielders to record 10-plus assists and had the most valuable arm in baseball, according to Statcast’s Arm Value metric. Benge’s 96.6 mph average arm strength ranked fifth highest in the game.

Few players improved their defense from 2025 to ‘26 as much as Suzuki. The 32-year-old veteran totaled +8 fielding run value this past season after accruing negative FRV in each of his first four big league seasons. Suzuki’s +14 DRS ranked second highest among all right fielders.

Carroll makes up for a subpar arm with fantastic range: He uses elite speed to cover a ton of ground, ranking in the 95th percentile of MLB with +10 OAA. It’s the third consecutive year that Carroll, a Gold Glove finalist last year, finished with double-digit OAA totals.
UtilityMauricio Dubón, BravesJared Triolo, PiratesIldemaro Vargas, D-backs

Dubón claimed the 2023 and ’25 AL Gold Gloves at utility for the Astros and continued to play stellar defense after being traded to Atlanta. He mostly split time between shortstop and left field while also appearing at second base, at third base and in center field. Dubón posted +6 OAA at short, +1 at third, +1 in center, 0 at second and -1 in left.

Triolo would also be a repeat winner: He was the NL’s utility Gold Glover in 2024, his second big league season. In 2026, he saw action mostly at shortstop and third base but also made eight appearances at first base, six in right field and even one in center field. Grading out best at third base, Triolo ended the year with +5 DRS overall for Pittsburgh.

Playing primarily first base (74 appearances) and second base (56), Vargas had a +4 FRV, tied with 2022 for the best of his career. He saw enough action at third base, shortstop and left field to qualify for the utility position, marking the first Gold Glove finalist nod of his career.
items.titleZh: 蓝鸟以5名金手套奖提名领跑美联
items.summaryZh: 2026赛季罗林斯金手套奖最终候选名单于周三公布，多伦多蓝鸟队以5名提名领跑美联。
bodyZh: 2026年罗林斯金手套奖的最终候选名单于周三公布，获奖者将于11月1日星期日通过ESPN揭晓。
每个联盟在各个位置上都有三名候选人，其中包括自2022年起设立的多功能守备位置。
棒球2026赛季奖项完全指南。
为了确定九个常规位置的获奖者，30位MLB总教练以及每支球队最多六名教练会在其所在联盟的球员池中进行投票，但不能选择自己球队的球员。这些选票占总评选的75%，SABR防守指数占另外的25%。
对于多功能位置，罗林斯与SABR合作，制定了一个独立于传统评选流程的专业防守公式。
历届金手套奖得主。
多伦多蓝鸟和芝加哥小熊各自拥有5名提名球员，是所有俱乐部中最多的。亚特兰大勇士、亚利桑那响尾蛇、得克萨斯游骑兵和堪萨斯城皇家各有4名。
以下是2026年金手套奖最终候选名单。每个位置的候选人均按字母顺序排列。
美国联盟
投手Tanner Bibee，克利夫兰守护者Jacob deGrom，得克萨斯游骑兵José Soriano，洛杉矶天使/多伦多蓝鸟
这三位投手都没有赢得过金手套奖，这使得竞争异常激烈。从高阶数据来看，Bibee在Statcast的出局制造值（+6）和防守分差（+5）方面占优。Bibee和Soriano所在的俱乐部守护者和蓝鸟在这个十年的这个奖项中占据了重要地位。Shane Bieber在2022年为克利夫兰赢得该奖，José Berríos在次年为多伦多赢得该奖。
捕手Dillon Dingler，底特律老虎Brandon Valenzuela，多伦多蓝鸟Austin Wells，纽约洋基
Dingler是棒球界全能捕手的有力竞争者，这在很大程度上归功于他顶级的防守。据Statcast统计，Dingler的+17守备跑动价值在所有捕手中排名第一，并在所有防守球员中并列第三。根据FanGraphs的数据，他还以+22.1的防守评分领跑捕手。Dingler在2025年斩获金手套荣誉，因此他正力求实现连庄。
Alejandro Kirk长期以来一直是棒球界防守最好的捕手之一，26赛季他与Valenzuela搭档组成了充满活力的组合。作为一名菜鸟，Valenzuela仅出战91场比赛，在跑动价值（+11）和防守评分（+13.6）方面就跻身前五名捕手之列。Valenzuela在偷好球和阻止跑者盗垒方面表现出色。
Wells在大联盟效力期间一直是棒球界防守较好的捕手之一。他在2026年的跑动价值为+10，此前他在2024年和25年都取得了+12的成绩。Wells是一位出色的偷好球手，并且在阻挡地滚球方面也是顶尖水平。
一垒手Vladimir Guerrero Jr.，多伦多蓝鸟Vinnie Pasquantino，堪萨斯城皇家Christian Walker，休斯敦太空人
Guerrero成长为防守更好的一垒手之一，这是他职业生涯中引人入胜的一部分。尽管他在职业生涯的大部分时间里防守表现一直低于平均水平，但Vlad Jr.在2025年的季后赛中展露了他新提升的防守水平，并在2026年迎来了全面防守表现最佳的一年。Guerrero在2022年获奖后，正力争赢得他的第二座奖杯。
Pasquantino在2026年的攻防两端都表现稳健，在25年数据下滑后提升了自己的防守。他力争成为自2017年Eric Hosmer以来首位赢得该奖项的皇家队一垒手。
Walker对金手套奖并不陌生——他在2022-24年连续三年为响尾蛇赢得该奖。他作为自己时代防守最好的一垒手之一的地位已经巩固，并且依然表现强劲。
二垒手Michael Massey，堪萨斯城皇家Chase Meidroth，芝加哥白袜Cole Young，西雅图水手
Massey曾在2021年小联盟中荣获金手套奖，被评为整个小联盟防守最好的二垒手，他在2026年首次成为MLB金手套最终候选人。这位堪萨斯城内野手凭借+11的出局制造值证明了自己的价值，仅次于Jazz Chisholm Jr.（+15），在美联二垒手中排名第二。
虽然Massey在出局制造值上占优，但Meidroth以+10的守备跑动价值领跑所有美联二垒手。Meidroth在2025年作为菜鸟时大部分时间担任游击手（26年在有限的出场时间里依然被评为正向防守球员），但在他的第二个赛季，他证明了自己在二垒位置上的卓越表现。
不同的数据对Young在2026年的防守有着截然不同的看法。这位水手队二垒手被记入+16的防守分差——在MLB并列第八，但在其位置上42名合格球员中并列第35位，出局制造值为-5。
三垒手Caleb Durbin，波士顿红袜Brooks Lee，明尼苏达双城Nick Loftin，堪萨斯城皇家
Durbin在2026年被从酿酒人交易到红袜后，防守水平迈上了一个台阶。在2025年新秀赛季累积+1出局制造值之后，他在26年狂揽+6出局制造值，并以+13的防守分差领跑所有美联三垒手。在整个MLB中，只有Alex Bregman和Matt Chapman（均高居+15）的表现超过了他。
位置的变动对Lee的守备起到了巨大作用。他最初作为游击手出道，并在2024年和25年主要担任该位置（同时也兼顾二垒和三垒），但在这两个赛季结束时的守备跑动价值均为-3。在2026年，Lee在游击手的有限出场时间里依然挣扎（出局制造值为-6），但在三垒位置上表现极佳（出局制造值为+6）。
由于Maikel Garcia受伤困扰，Loftin在皇家队承担了更重要的角色，无论是在进攻还是防守端都表现得令人钦佩。他担任三垒的场次足够获得三垒金手套的资格，同时也在二垒和右外野获得了相当多的出场时间。Loftin在2026年获得了+6的防守分差，尽管Statcast的评价更为严苛（出局制造值为-3，守备跑动价值为-1）。
游击手Andrés Giménez，多伦多蓝鸟Taylor Walls，坦帕湾光芒Bobby Witt Jr.，堪萨斯城皇家
Giménez在2022-24年连续三年夺得美联二垒金手套奖，随后前游骑兵队的Marcus Semien在25年击败了他。在26年转投多伦多担任游击手后，他现在有机会在一个新位置上再次赢得金手套奖。Giménez赛季结束时的出局制造值为+19，与红雀队的Masyn Winn并列游击手第二位。
外界对Walls防守的看法存在很大分歧：防守分差显示他为+21（在所有球员中并列第三），而Statcast则将他评为表现不佳的防守球员（出局制造值为-2，守备跑动价值为-2）。Walls以其游击手位置上的精湛防守而闻名，连续第二个赛季成为金手套最终候选人。
Witt此前连续两年赢得美联游击手金手套奖，目前很有希望获得第三座。他+24的出局制造值在MLB排名第三，仅次于Pete Crow-Armstrong和JJ Wetherholt，而他+17的守备跑动价值与Winn并列游击手之首。这位皇家队的球星可能会连续三个赛季在其位置上同时赢得金手套奖和银棒奖。
左外野手Cody Bellinger，纽约洋基Wyatt Langford，得克萨斯游骑兵Chandler Simpson，坦帕湾光芒
Bellinger正在竞逐自2019年以来的首座金手套奖，当时他作为道奇队的右外野手赢得了该奖项。这位31岁的球员以+21的防守分差领跑所有左外野手，这得益于他出色的防守范围（出局制造值为+6）以及93.3英里/小时的平均传球臂力，该臂力在MLB中处于第94百分位。
24岁的Langford在保持健康的情况下，继续为游击手贡献精妙的防守。他在左外野首发出场87次，总计获得+5的出局制造值，在所有左外野手中并列第四。这种防守范围源于强劲的启动；只有Pete Crow-Armstrong和Ceddanne Rafaela的初始反应比Langford更好。
Simpson是棒球界速度最快的球员之一，他在2026年为美联最佳的光芒队镇守外野时，充分利用了这一速度优势。很少有球员能像Simpson那样大幅提升防守范围，他在25年累积了-5的出局制造值后，26年以+8的出局制造值领跑所有左外野手。他是如何扭转局面的？Simpson与外野教练Corey Dickerson紧密合作以改善他的反应，如今他的起步反应已跻身前十名。
中外野手Evan Carter，得克萨斯游骑兵Steven Kwan，克利夫兰守护者Ceddanne Rafaela，波士顿红袜
Carter今年为游击手保持了大部分时间的健康，在中外野出场140次。在顶级速度的加持下这位24岁的球员在2026年总计获得+11的出局制造值，在主要中外野手中并列第四多。
在其五年职业生涯中，Kwan首次在2026年作为中外野手的首发场次（77场）多于左外野（65场）。这就是为什么这位四届卫冕金手套奖得主今年有资格在不同的位置上入围。Kwan经常展现他出色的臂力，贡献了11次外野助杀——在MLB并列第三多——并参与了5次双杀。
Rafaela在中外野的水平虽然不及Pete Crow-Armstrong，但也相差无几。这位26岁的球员在外野手中以+16的守备跑动价值和+17的出局制造值排名第二。Rafaela的10次五星级美妙接球领跑所有合格外野手，这绝对经得起肉眼检验。
右外野手Wilyer Abreu，波士顿红袜Nathan Lukes，多伦多蓝鸟Cam Smith，休斯敦太空人
根据至少一项热门指标，Abreu是2026年棒球界防守最好的球员：他+28的防守分差以巨大优势领跑所有MLB球员。Statcast对Abreu的青睐程度稍逊一筹，但这位两届金手套得主的臂力毋庸置疑。Abreu 95.3英里/小时的平均传球臂力在合格球员中跻身前十，他13次外野助杀仅次于道奇队的Andy Pages。
Abreu并不是唯一拥有大炮手臂的美联右外野手。Lukes与Abreu一同成为本赛季达成10次以上外野助杀的七名球员之一。根据Statcast的臂力价值指标，Lukes拥有美联价值最高的外野手臂。
23岁的Smith担任全职外野手仅有两个赛季。在这两个赛季中，他都成为了金手套奖的最终候选人。他今年在右外野显得更加游刃有余，这得益于防守范围的提升：他+7的出局制造值处于MLB的第91百分位，在主要右外野手中排名第四。
多功能守备José Caballero，纽约洋基Ezequiel Duran，得克萨斯游骑兵Zach McKinstry，底特律老虎
Caballero在洋基队内四处奔走防守的同时，累积了+12的防守分差。他除了投手、捕手和一垒之外，防守过所有位置。他0的守备跑动价值实际上是他职业生涯中的最低值——他最好的表现是2023年作为水手队新秀时的+8——但Caballero依然首次成为金手套的最终候选人。
Duran在2026年凭借出色的防守赢得了4.4的FanGraphs胜场贡献值，以+17的出局制造值（包括游击位置上的+11）在MLB并列第六。对于得克萨斯来说，他是一名真正的多功能球员，在二垒、三垒、游击以及全部三个外野位置上都有两位数的出场记录。
全能性一直是McKinstry职业生涯的重要组成部分，但2026年是自2021年以来他出场最多的位置位于外野的第一个赛季。他在右外野出场62次，二垒45次，游击34次，并在三垒、左外野和中外野有零星出场。他+15的防守分差在所有球员中排名前15位，+12的守备跑动价值并列第14位。
国家联盟
投手Michael McGreevy，圣路易斯红雀Nolan McLean，纽约大都会Chris Sale，亚特兰大勇士
McGreevy今年成为了红雀队先发轮值的中流砥柱，他的高强本领并不局限于他那七种球路的武器库。他在守备自己位置上也表现极佳，防守分差达到了+5——在MLB所有投手中并列最高。
与此同时，McLean凭借在大都会队出色的新秀赛季赢得了实至名归的知名度，但他以+4的防守分差紧随McGreevy之后。而有望赢得第二座赛扬奖的Sale，也是赢得第二座金手套奖的候选人。
捕手Freddy Fermin，圣迭戈教士Gabriel Moreno，亚利桑那响尾蛇Luis Torrens，纽约大都会
Fermin在过去这个赛季的防守卓越性上表现全面，在Statcast的超越平均阻挡跑动（+10，第93百分位）、超越平均盗垒阻杀（+6，第97百分位）以及平均传球时间（1.88秒，第86百分位）方面均位列第86百分位或更高。
Moreno在2023年曾荣获本垒板后方的金手套奖，今年他在响尾蛇队迎来了爆发年，这可能为他赢得一些国联常规赛MVP的选票，他在超越平均阻挡跑动和超越平均盗垒阻杀方面也位居合格捕手的前20%。他的防守分差为+14，仅次于Dingler。
Torrens以+12的防守分差在MLB捕手中排名第三，他+10的守备跑动价值位列第90百分位。
一垒手Ty France，圣迭戈教士Matt Olson，亚特兰大勇士TJ Rumfield，科罗拉多洛矶
France去年在美联赢得一垒金手套后正寻求职业生涯的第二座金手套荣誉，他在圣迭戈的打击端迎来了生涯最佳的一年，同时也以+15的防守分差领跑MLB一垒手。
哪个一垒手以+12的守备跑动价值排名第一？那便是Olson，他正寻求自己的第四座金手套奖。作为洛矶队新秀脱颖而出的Rumfield证明自己不仅仅是一台上垒机器（他以.390的上垒率领跑国联）——他最终的防守分差为+6。
二垒手Brandon Lowe，匹兹堡海盗Brice Turang，密尔沃基酿酒人JJ Wetherholt，圣路易斯红雀
Wetherholt作为新秀在打击和守备两端都令人印象深刻，但在二垒这个核心位置上他大放异彩，以+25的出局制造值领跑所有二垒手，甚至在所有球员中——无论位置如何——高居第二位。
与此同时，Turang在防守分差部门取得了同样的成就，以+23领跑二垒手并在所有球员中名列亚军。如果他今年赢得这项荣誉，这将是他继2024年获奖之后的第二座金手套奖——那一年他还赢得了国联的白金手套奖。
Lowe同样表现出色，他+15的出局制造值与Turang和Chisholm并列二垒手第二位。对于这位32岁的球员来说，这是一个相当大的年度大反转，他在2025年曾拥有所有主要二垒手中最差的防守范围。
三垒手Alex Bregman，芝加哥小熊Max Muncy，洛杉矶道奇Javier Sanoja，迈阿密马林鱼
Bregman在2024年效力太空人的最后一年赢得了他的第一座金手套，最终他的出局制造值为+9，在所有三垒手中仅次于教士队的Manny Machado（+12）。他在三垒位置上展现出了稳定性，在过去的七个赛季里，防守表现一直被评为高于平均水平。
相比之下，Muncy自2021年（+5）以来，其守备跑动价值就再也没有成为正向防守球员，那也是他此前唯一一次成为金手套最终候选人。他在2026年为道奇队效力时的守备跑动价值为0，出局制造值为-1。
Sanoja是2025年国联的多功能位置金手套得主。他在26年继续镇守内野各个位置，但这次他大部分的出场时间都在三垒。他+6的出局制造值在国联三垒手中排名第四，+5的守备跑动价值并列第四。
游击手Geraldo Perdomo，亚利桑那响尾蛇Dansby Swanson，芝加哥小熊Masyn Winn，圣路易斯红雀
Winn在又一个出色的防守赛季之后，正密切关注着他的第二座连续金手套奖。事实上，他在2025年的数据（+17守备跑动价值，+21出局制造值）与26年的数据（+17守备跑动价值，+19出局制造值）大同小异，尽管左手拇指骨折将他的出场场次限制在仅136场。Winn取得进步的方式之一是什么？他那如火箭般的传球臂力变得更加强劲，94.4英里/小时的平均传球臂力领跑所有中线内野手。
Swanson在2022-23年连续赢得金手套奖，在上赛季表现平平之后，他的防守在26年再次回升。这位32岁的球员在处理反手球时变得更加娴熟，记录了+16的出局制造值——超过了除三名合格游击手之外的所有人——并撑起了这项运动历史上最伟大的防守体系之一。
Perdomo创下了+13的守备跑动价值和+16的出局制造值的职业生涯新高。事实上，在大联盟的前五年里，他总共只累积了+10的出局制造值。他演变成棒球界顶级防守游击手之一的过程，让他职业生涯首次赢得了金手套最终候选人的席位。
左外野手Jackson Chourio，密尔沃基酿酒人Ian Happ，芝加哥小熊Daylen Lile，华盛顿国民
Chourio的防守在2026年迈出了巨大的一步，在他完整的第三个大联盟赛季中，以+9的守备跑动价值和+7的出局制造值创下了职业生涯新高。他在两个类别中都领跑国联左外野手。
在左外野又一个高于平均水平的赛季之后，Happ正瞄准他的第五座连续金手套奖。他的大部分防守价值都来自于他的手臂；Happ在2026年贡献了9次外野助杀，在MLB并列第八多。
Lile是一名二年级球员，在国民队担任左外野首发124场，而上个赛季他的时间则在指定打击、右外野和左外野之间分配。他出色地胜任了这个角色，拥有高于平均水平的防守范围（出局制造值为+1）和有价值的传球臂力（臂力价值为+1）。
中外野手Pete Crow-Armstrong，芝加哥小熊Michael Harris II，亚特兰大勇士Andy Pages，洛杉矶道奇
Crow-Armstrong是棒球界防守最好的球员。根据FanGraphs的“防守跑动”指标，他的防守价值高达+23跑动，领跑所有球员。PCA还在Statcast的守备跑动价值（+26）和出局制造值（+26）方面领跑大联盟，其中后者追平了自至少2016年以来外野手单赛季出局制造值的最高纪录。
Harris II迎来了他年轻职业生涯中防守最好的一季，其出局制造值（+14）和守备跑动价值（+12）均创下职业生涯新高。Pages在2026年累积了+13的守备跑动价值——在合格外野手中排名第三——部分原因是他拥有轰动的臂力。他以14次外野助杀领跑MLB，并且连续多年助杀数达到两位数。
右外野手Carson Benge，纽约大都会Corbin Carroll，亚利桑那响尾蛇Seiya Suzuki，芝加哥小熊
23岁的Benge部分凭借其精妙的防守，作为国联年度最佳新秀的竞争者惊艳亮相。他是达成10次以上助杀的七名外野手之一，并且根据Statcast的臂力价值指标，拥有棒球界最有价值的手臂。Benge 96.6英里/小时的平均传球臂力在比赛中排名第五高。
很少有球员能像Suzuki那样在2025年至26年间大幅提升防守。这位32岁的老将在过去这个赛季总计获得了+8的守备跑动价值，而他在前四个大联盟赛季的每个赛季中守备跑动价值均为负数。Suzuki +14的防守分差在所有右外野手中排名第二高。
Carroll用出色的防守范围弥补了臂力稍逊的劣势：他利用顶级速度覆盖了广阔的防守区域，出局制造值为+10，处于MLB的第95百分位。这是去年成为金手套候选人的Carroll连续第三年出局制造值总数达到两位数。
多功能守备Mauricio Dubón，亚特兰大勇士Jared Triolo，匹兹堡海盗Ildemaro Vargas，亚利桑那响尾蛇
Dubón为太空人赢得了2023年和25年的美联多功能金手套奖，并在被交易到亚特兰大后继续保持着出色的防守。他主要在游击手和左外野之间轮换，同时也兼任二垒手、三垒手和中外野手。Dubón在游击位置上交出了+6的出局制造值，三垒+1，中外野+1，二垒0，左外野-1。
Triolo也将成为多次获奖得主：他是2024年大联盟第二个赛季的国联多功能金手套得主。在2026年，他主要出任游击手和三垒手，但也有8次在一垒出场、6次在右外野甚至1次在中外野。Triolo在三垒位置上的评级最好，最终为匹兹堡贡献了总计+5的防守分差。
Vargas主要司职一垒（74次出场）和二垒（56次出场），其守备跑动价值为+4，追平了2022年创下的职业生涯最佳纪录。他在三垒、游击和左外野的出场次数足够多，从而获得了多功能位置的候选资格，这也是他职业生涯首次获得金手套最终候选人提名。

items.titleEn: Reinvigorated and revamped Bloss headlines Blue Jays' Fall League contingent
bodyEn: SCOTTSDALE, Ariz. -- It’s not often that players with big league reps under their belt embark on the Arizona Fall League. But things have been far from linear for Jake Bloss, who has combined to throw just 51 innings over the past two seasons after undergoing Tommy John surgery, which meant that, as he put it, “time can get a little weird.”

All that down time provided ample opportunities to pick up new hobbies, something that was a natural fit for Bloss, a double major in economics and math who graduated early from Lafayette before going on to get his graduate degree from Georgetown. He intended to focus on one item long-term initially before pivoting to lots of shorter stints, like getting “pretty good” at Spanish before shifting his focus.

But his sight lines have always involved being on the mound. Bloss skyrocketed through the Astros’ system after they selected him in the third round of the 2023 Draft, making his Major League debut less than a year later. He made three starts with Houston before he was flipped to Toronto at the Trade Deadline as part of the return package (which also included Joey Loperfido and Will Wagner) for Yusei Kikuchi.

“There are certain parts that -- I don't know why -- they just stay with you, other parts are more of a blur, especially during your debut,” said Bloss of how he views those starts now. “I don't know if blackout's the right word, but you kind of just aren't thinking. ... You just kind of trust in what you've done and sometimes that means you don't remember everything. So you go back and watch it and you're like, ‘Really?’ But a super cool experience for sure.”

Since the trade, Bloss has stepped into the proverbial pitching lab. Over the past two years, the Jays have worked with the right-hander on pitch grips, mechanics and ways to improve his velocity; he threw two heaters this season for Triple-A Buffalo at 98 mph or higher, superseding his MLB-high of 96 mph during his first taste of The Show two summers ago.

The abbreviated numbers this year (6.18 ERA) for Bloss -- who ranks as the Blue Jays’ No. 11 prospect -- are a bit muddied by a June 25 outing in which he yielded 11 runs during a start in which he was focused on hitting his pitch count. But as he was gaining momentum to his side, he was shut down after just 11 regular-season starts due to a teres major strain in mid-July.

A major benefit of sending Bloss to pitch for the Mesa Solar Sox -- for whom he’s slated to throw around 15-20 innings -- is that he can work in a controlled environment that sets the stage for 2027, where he could be in the mix to throw meaningful innings for the Blue Jays after they got the second-lowest number of innings (749 1/3) from their starting staff among all American League clubs this past season.

“You're definitely tinkering, because you do have time to experiment in a non-game situation, which is helpful because you don't want to be -- if you can avoid it -- experimenting in a game, especially in games that matter," said Bloss of how he's continued to hone his craft even while not physically being on the mound. "You want to have your stuff fine-tuned. So it’s nice to have an environment where you can experiment with pitch shape, pitch mixes, with kind of no consequences.”
It begs the question: Will there be things added to his arsenal that weren’t there before?
“Might find out,” said Bloss with a smirk.
Blue Jays hitters in the AFL:

Jake Cook, OF (No. 20): Recruited to Southern Miss as a two-way player, Cook dialed his heater up to 96 mph before ultimately focusing on the batter’s box. Toronto popped him in the third round of the 2025 Draft and he immediately became the fastest player in the system, one of just four ranked prospects in baseball with an 80-grade run tool. He spent the majority of his debut campaign with Single-A Dunedin, where he hit .250 with a .738 OPS and collected 21 steals on 25 attempts.

Jake Casey, OF (No. 23): The son of 12-year big leaguer Sean Casey, Jake has quickly ascended to looking like a steal after the Jays popped him in the 15th round of the 2025 Draft. While he’s been old for the A ball levels he’s appeared in, the left-handed-hitting outfielder has a .902 OPS in 87 pro contests. After sustaining a broken hamate bone in his first game of the year with High-A Vancouver that knocked him out for more than two months, time in the Fall League will allow him to make up valuable reps.

Aaron Parker, C: Parker has moved at a one level per year pace since the Jays selected him in the sixth round out of UC Santa Barbara in 2024. The right-handed-hitting catcher set career highs in almost every major offensive category across 87 games this year for Double-A New Hampshire and was one of eight prospects across the system to collect double-digit home runs (19) and steals (12).
Other Blue Jays pitchers in the AFL:

Brandon Barriera, LHP: The 23rd overall pick in the 2022 Draft, Barriera’s pro career has been besieged by injuries -- a hybrid Tommy John surgery and internal brace procedure and a fractured forearm among them, limiting him to 66 career Minor League innings. He dealt with more issues during the summer but returned to make eight appearances, including two that marked his debut at High-A. His fastball sat 92-94 mph down the stretch and he was able to rip off multiple sliders that registered north of 2900 RPMs.

Gilberto Batista, RHP: One of three prospects Toronto received in the Danny Jansen swap with Boston just prior to the 2024 Trade Deadline, Batista has since primarily operated as a bulk reliever, logging at least 85 innings each of the past two seasons. While Batista has a clean and repeatable delivery, he was lit up this year with Vancouver, surrendering a .307 average and .925 OPS against while working to a 7.86 ERA. He works with a mid-90s heater, 84-87 mph slider and a mid-80s changeup.

Fernando Perez, RHP: A 2024 All-Star Futures Game selection, Perez hit a roadblock this season as his control eluded him, leading to 25 walks in 20 innings. He was placed on the Developmental List on May 4, returning to Double-A in late August. Still just 22 years old, the Nicaragua native has long been viewed as having exemplary feel for his four-pitch arsenal, which he’ll need since he doesn’t miss a ton of bats with average velocity and shapes. But he has a repeatable delivery coming from a 6-foot-3 frame and can pound the zone when it’s all going right.

Yondrei Rojas, RHP: Back in the Fall League for a second consecutive year, Rojas is looking to reclaim some of his prospect buzz after his first foray into the upper Minors led to a 5.47 ERA across 40 appearances this season. The 23-year-old earned his first promotion to Triple-A down the stretch and he showcased a 94-96 mph heater, upper-80s cutter, low-80s slider and mid-80s changeup across four outings for Buffalo. He’ll be Rule 5 Draft-eligible this winter, so a strong showing would go a long way toward earning him a 40-man spot with Toronto.
items.titleZh: 重整旗鼓的Bloss领衔蓝鸟秋季联盟阵容
items.summaryZh: 经历伤病后，Jake Bloss将通过亚利桑那秋季联盟寻找状态，多位蓝鸟新秀也将一同参赛。
bodyZh: 亚利桑那州斯科茨代尔讯——拥有大联盟经验的球员并不经常参加亚利桑那秋季联盟。但对于Jake Bloss来说，事情远非一帆风顺。在接受Tommy John手术后，他在过去两个赛季中总共只投了51局，正如他所说，“时间会变得有点奇怪”。
所有这些休息时间为他提供了培养新爱好的充足机会。这对Bloss来说是一个很自然的契合，他主修经济学和数学，从拉斐特学院提前毕业，随后又获得了乔治城大学的研究生学位。他最初打算长期专注于一项事物，然后转向许多较短的尝试，比如在转移注意力之前把西班牙语学得“相当不错”。
但他的视线始终离不开投手丘。自2023年选秀大会在第三轮被太空人选中后，Bloss在球队体系中飞速崛起，不到一年后便完成了大联盟首秀。他在休斯敦完成了三场先发，随后在交易截止日作为菊池雄星交易的一部分（其中还包括Joey Loperfido和Will Wagner）被交易到多伦多。
“有些部分——我不知道为什么——它们会一直留在你脑海里，而其他部分则更加模糊，尤其是在你首秀期间，”Bloss在谈到他现在如何看待这些先发时说道。“我不知道‘一片空白’是不是正确的词，但你当时基本上没在想什么……你只是相信自己所做的事情，有时这意味着你记不住所有事情。所以你回去看录像，会想：‘真的吗？’但这绝对是一次超级酷的经历。”
自交易以来，Bloss便踏入了所谓的投球实验室。在过去两年里，蓝鸟队与这位右投手一起研究了投球握法、投球机制以及提高球速的方法；本赛季他在小联盟3A水牛城投出了两记时速达到98英里或以上的速球，超越了他两个夏天前首次登上大联盟时创下的96英里的个人最高纪录。
Bloss作为蓝鸟排名第11位的潜力新秀，今年精简的数据（6.18自责分率）在一定程度上受到6月25日一场比赛的影响，那场比赛他在一次专注于达到投球数的先发中丢了11分。但正当他逐渐找回状态时，由于在7月中旬遭遇大圆肌拉伤，他在仅完成了11场常规赛先发后便赛季报销。
将Bloss送往梅萨太阳袜队投球（他计划在那里投大约15-20局）的一个主要好处是，他可以在一个受控的环境中工作，为2027年奠定基础。在刚刚过去的赛季中，蓝鸟先发投手群在所有美联球队中投出的局数倒数第二少（749 1/3局），这使得Bloss未来有望在多伦多承担重要的投球局数。
“你肯定在进行微调，因为你确实有时间在非比赛情况下进行实验，这很有帮助，因为你不想——如果能避免的话——在比赛中进行实验，特别是在那些至关重要的比赛中，”Bloss谈到自己如何在没有实际登上投手丘的情况下继续打磨球技时说道。“你希望你的球路经过精细调整。所以能有一个可以无后果地实验投球形态、投球组合的环境真是太好了。”
这引发了一个问题：他的武器库中会加入以前没有的东西吗？
“可能会发现，”Bloss带着微笑说道。
参加秋季联盟的蓝鸟打者：
Jake Cook，外野手（第20号新秀）：作为双刀流球员被南密西西比大学招募，Cook曾将他的速球球速提升至96英里，随后最终专注于打击区。多伦多在2025年选秀大会第三轮选中了他，他立刻成为了体系中最快的球员，也是全美棒球界仅有的四位拥有80分跑动能力评级的潜力新秀之一。他的首秀赛季大部分时间都在1A达尼丁度过，打击率为.250，OPS为.738，并在25次盗垒尝试中成功21次。
Jake Casey，外野手（第23号新秀）：作为12年大联盟老将Sean Casey的儿子，Jake在蓝鸟于2025年选秀大会第15轮选中他之后，迅速展现出了“淘宝成功”的潜质。虽然他在所出战的A级别联赛中年龄偏大，但这位左打外野手在87场职业比赛中的OPS达到了.902。在代表高阶1A温哥华出战的赛季首场比赛中遭遇钩骨骨折导致缺阵两个多月后，秋季联盟的时光将使他能够补回宝贵的出场次数。
Aaron Parker，捕手：自从蓝鸟在2024年选秀大会第六轮从加州大学圣巴巴拉分校选中他以来，Parker一直保持着每年升一个级别的速度。这位右打捕手今年在2A新罕布什尔出战87场比赛，在几乎所有主要进攻数据上都创下了职业生涯新高，并且是全体系八名双位数本垒打（19个）和盗垒（12个）的潜力新秀之一。
其他参加秋季联盟的蓝鸟投手：
Brandon Barriera，左投手：作为2022年选秀大会整体第23顺位新秀，Barriera的职业生涯一直受到伤病的困扰——包括混合Tommy John手术和内支架手术以及前臂骨折，这限制他在小联盟生涯中仅出场66局。他在夏天处理了更多的问题，但随后回归并完成了8次登板，其中包括两次代表高阶1A的首秀。他的直球在赛季末保持在92-94英里，并且能够投出多记转速超过2900转的滑球。

Gilberto Batista，右投手：作为多伦多在2024年交易截止日前与波士顿关于Danny Jansen交易中获得的三个潜力新秀之一，Batista此后主要担任长中继投手，过去两个赛季每个赛季的投球局数都达到至少85局。虽然Batista的投球动作干净且可复制，但他今年在温哥华表现挣扎，被对手打出.307的打击率和.925的OPS，自责分率为7.86。他的武器库包括90年代中期的直球、84-87英里的滑球以及80年代中期的变速球。

Fernando Perez，右投手：作为2024年未来之星全明星赛的入选者，Perez本赛季遇到了控制力下滑的瓶颈，在20局中送出了25次保送。他在5月4日被放入发展名单，并在8月下旬重返2A。这位现年仅22岁、出生于尼加拉瓜的投手长期以来被认为对他的四种球路有着出色的球感，鉴于他的球速和球路形态只处于平均水平且不以三振见长，他将非常需要这种球感。但他在6尺3寸的身高下拥有可复制的投球动作，一切顺利时能够很好地攻击好球带。

Yondrei Rojas，右投手：连续第二年重返秋季联盟，Rojas希望在首次踏入高阶小联盟遭遇本赛季40场比赛5.47自责分率的表现后，重新找回他作为潜力新秀的声誉。这位23岁的球员在赛季末赢得了他职业生涯首次升入3A的机会，并在为水牛城出战的四场比赛中展现了94-96英里的直球、80年代末期的卡特球、80年代初期的滑球以及80年代中期的变速球。他将在今年冬天获得规则五选秀资格，因此出色的表现将对他在多伦多赢得40人名单席位大有帮助。
items.author: Jesse Borek

items.titleEn: Early key to Blue Jays' offseason: Become more dangerous on the bases
bodyEn: TORONTO -- Welcome to the winter of baserunning. It’s not as exciting as hitting the ball 450 feet, but until the Blue Jays figure out how to do that more often, they’re about to obsess over running the bases.

Over and over again, Ross Atkins and John Schneider brought up baserunning following their 79-83 finish, last in the American League East. Some of this team’s problems will have simpler solutions, like adding some big bats capable of producing something greater than singles, but baserunning feels like the big existential issue they want to wrestle with.

“Baserunning is something that we need to be better at,” Atkins said, the first thing he singled out. “It is a clear opportunity. We have guys that can run. We have guys that can steal bases and advance better. We need to be better as decision-makers and be more aggressive in that area.”
They should, too. This team’s flaws in 2026 lead to a long list, but baserunning ranks right near the top.
The five biggest needs for Blue Jays this offseason
By the numbersWhen we think of baserunning, everyone’s mind jumps to stolen bases. The Blue Jays ranked 27th in the league with just 75 in 2026, and this isn’t a new problem, either.

The Blue Jays haven’t ranked in the top 20 in baseball in steals since 2021 (12th with 81), and haven’t stolen 100 bases as a team since 2013 (112). Only two players stole double-digit bases this past season, too, in Andrés Giménez (20) and George Springer (12).

Looking deeper at the Blue Jays’ baserunning metrics, it’s more of the same. According to Baseball Savant, they ranked 20th in baseball with a value of -3 baserunning runs, and graded out poorly when it comes to taking extra bases which result in scoring. Not only were the Blue Jays a poor basestealing team, but they didn’t go from first to third well, and too often, their bursts of aggression were ill-timed.
What they're sayingThere are ways to win without elite baserunning, but unless they completely overhaul their offensive identity, the Blue Jays truly need it.

“We were [high] in hits but low in walks,” Schneider said. “You’re relying on hits. Then that’s where the baserunning part comes in. If you’re relying on hits, you’ve got to advance and score on those hits. It’s been a very weird blend of things on the offensive side.”

Last season, the Blue Jays’ coaching staff decided just prior to the midway point of the schedule that their baserunning wasn’t good enough, and began to crank up those conversations with players. It worked, too. Think of the 2025 Blue Jays, and one of the first images that comes to mind is Springer running as hard as he can, taking the extra base whenever possible. That became contagious, but somewhere along the way it was lost.

“Some of it is personnel-driven, right? [Alejandro Kirk] is not going to win any races,” Schneider said. “But being more efficient with advancing on hits, taking more shots on stolen bases with guys who can and just not giving outs away on the bases.”

What are the next steps?The boring part -- but perhaps the most important part -- is internal improvements. The Blue Jays need to identify their good baserunners and develop some new leaders in this area.

“Ernie [Clement], Giménez and now [Brett] Bateman, they’re elite runners,” Atkins said. “Those guys can lean into that. That’s not on them, that’s on us to figure out how we push them into those areas for base advancements, stealing bases and putting more pressure on teams.”

The big names atop the free-agent market are a mixed bag on this front. Seiya Suzuki, whom Toronto is expected to pursue, is a below-average baserunner and that trend could continue in the wrong direction through his 30s, but he represents the power upside the Blue Jays desperately need, so that’s a minor issue and nothing more. Randy Arozarena is coming off a solid baserunning season, with stolen-base totals of 26 and 31 the past two seasons.
Blue Jays GM Atkins, CEO Shapiro talk Guerrero, offseason needs

An interesting addition to the conversation? Jazz Chisholm Jr., whom Blue Jays fans know well from his time with the Yankees. The 28-year-old could take up a fascinating place on the free-agent market, with his 30-30 season in 2025 but a down year in ‘26. He’s one of the best-graded runners available, though, and the Blue Jays will leave no stone unturned as they try to resurrect this piece of their identity.
items.titleZh: 多伦多蓝鸟休赛期早期关键：提升跑垒威胁
items.summaryZh: 多伦多蓝鸟在美联东区垫底后，将提升跑垒能力和侵略性作为休赛期的核心改进目标。
bodyZh: 多伦多讯——欢迎来到跑垒之冬。它或许不如将球击飞450英尺那么令人兴奋，但在多伦多蓝鸟队找到更频繁做到这一点的方法之前，他们将不得不对跑垒产生执念。
在以79胜83负结束赛季、排名美联东区垫底之后，Ross Atkins和John Schneider一次又一次地提到了跑垒。这支球队的一些问题将拥有更简单的解决方案，比如引进一些能够打出长打而不仅仅是单安打的强力打者，但跑垒似乎是他们想要解决的重大根本问题。
“跑垒是我们必须做好的方面，”Atkins说道，这是他单独拿出来说的第一件事。“这是一个清晰的机会。我们有能跑的人。我们有能盗垒并能更好地推进的球员。我们需要在决策上做得更好，并在该领域更具侵略性。”
他们也确实应该如此。这支球队在2026年的缺陷有一长串，但跑垒几乎排在最前面。
蓝鸟队在这个休赛期最大的五个需求
从数据来看：当我们想到跑垒时，每个人的脑海都会浮现出盗垒。多伦多蓝鸟队在2026年仅有75次盗垒，在联盟中排名第27位，而且这也不是一个新问题。
自2021年以来，多伦多蓝鸟队的盗垒次数就再没有进入过大联盟前20名（当年以81次排名第12），并且自2013年（112次）以来，球队单季盗垒次数就再也没有达到过100次。在刚刚过去的这个赛季中，也只有两名球员的盗垒达到了两位数，分别是Andrés Giménez（20次）和George Springer（12次）。
深入查看多伦多蓝鸟队的跑垒数据指标，情况也是大同小异。根据Baseball Savant的数据，他们的跑垒价值为-3，在大联盟中排名第20位，在争取能转化为得分的额外垒位方面评分也很低。多伦多蓝鸟队不仅是一支糟糕的盗垒球队，而且他们没能很好地从一垒推进到三垒，并且往往在不合时宜的时机表现出冲动。
他们的观点：没有顶尖的跑垒也能赢得比赛，但除非他们彻底改变进攻风格，否则多伦多蓝鸟队确实需要它。
“我们的安打率[很高]，但保送率很低，”Schneider说道。“你们依赖安打。这就是跑垒发挥作用的地方。如果你依赖安打，你就必须在这些安打上推进并得分。这在进攻端是一种非常奇怪的组合。”
上个赛季，多伦多蓝鸟队的教练组在赛程过半前不久决定他们的跑垒还不够好，并开始加强与球员的这些沟通。这也起到了作用。回想2025年的多伦多蓝鸟队，浮现在脑海中的最初画面之一就是Springer拼尽全力奔跑，尽可能地多占一个垒位。这种精神产生了传染性，但在某个过程中它丢失了。
“其中一部分是人员决定的，对吧？[Alejandro Kirk]是赢不了任何赛跑的，”Schneider说道。“但在安打推进上更有效率，让那些有能力的球员更多地尝试盗垒，并且不在垒位上白白送出出局数。”
下一步是什么？枯燥的部分——但也许是最重要的部分——是内部提升。多伦多蓝鸟队需要识别出他们的优秀跑垒员，并在这一领域培养一些新的领导者。
“Ernie [Clement]、Giménez以及现在的[Brett] Bateman，他们都是顶尖的跑垒员，”Atkins说道。“这些球员可以依靠这一点。这不是他们的责任，而是我们的责任，我们要弄清楚如何推动他们在这些领域进行垒位推进、盗垒并给球队施加更多压力。”
自由球员市场头部的名字在这个方面褒贬不一。多伦多预计会追求的Seiya Suzuki是一名低于平均水平的跑垒员，这种趋势可能会在他30多岁时朝着错误的方向延续下去，但他代表了多伦多蓝鸟队迫切需要的长打潜力，所以这只是一个小问题，无伤大雅。Randy Arozarena刚刚经历了一个稳健的跑垒赛季，过去两个赛季的盗垒总数分别为26次和31次。
蓝鸟总经理Atkins、CEO Shapiro谈Guerrero与休赛期需求
一个有趣的引援话题？Jazz Chisholm Jr.，蓝鸟球迷对他在效力洋基队期间的表现非常熟悉。这位28岁的球员在自由球员市场上可能会占据一个引人入胜的位置，他在2025年打出了30-30的赛季，但在2026年表现下滑。不过，他是可用的评分最高的跑垒员之一，多伦多蓝鸟队在试图重塑他们风格的这一部分时，将不会放过任何线索。
items.author: Keegan Matheson

items.titleEn: This Blue Jays prospect has some of the best raw tools in the Fall League
bodyEn: SCOTTSDALE, Ariz. – In the span of time it takes to fold a bag of all-dressed chips and pop on a clip, Jake Cook ran the 30-yard dash at the MLB Draft Combine in June 2025. Zooming to an event-best time of 3.51 seconds, it was a lightning quick snapshot of how fast his rise has been.

One of the first terms that scouts and evaluators offer up when describing Cook’s game is “raw.” Originally recruited to Southern Miss as a two-way player, he first redshirted in 2023 and then threw just three innings the following year, but did touch 96 mph on the mound. He focused solely on the batter’s box in 2025 and hit .350 while manning center field.

“I didn't even play in the fall,” said Cook. “I got into spring intrasquads and did my thing and my roommates were like, ‘Bro, if you keep playing like that, you're gonna get drafted.’ I was like, ‘Guys, chill, I’m just trying to play this year, just trying to start.’”

Those wheels – and raw tools – got the minds of the Blue Jays’ Draft contingent racing. Toronto popped the Mississippi native in the third round of the Draft a month later and have watched as he’s blossomed into one of four ranked prospects across baseball to earn an 80-grade run tool.
