科罗拉多洛矶 Cristian Arguelles，外野手（第5名）：在2025年以.422的打击率领跑DSL并赢得联盟MVP荣誉后，他今年在美国本土的亚利桑那综合联盟复制了这一壮举，斩获打击王（.402）和MVP提名，从而赢得了升上全赛季联盟的机会，并以总计.971的OPS和137的wRC+收官。
Jackson Cox，右投手（第8名）：Cox已经将迫使他缺席整个2024赛季的汤米·约翰手术抛在脑后，在xFIP和K/BB%上领跑农场（90局或以上），同时在K/9（11.84）、K%（30.9）、K/BB（3.28）和WHIP（1.27）上位居第二。
items.author: Jim Callis and Jonathan Mayo

items.titleEn: Jays outfield prospect Casey blazing his own trail in Arizona Fall League
bodyEn: MESA, Ariz. -- Jake Casey had Tommy John surgery while at Kent State in 2024. He broke a hamate in his first game of the 2026 season after the Blue Jays took the Kent State product in the 15th round of the 2025 Draft. So getting off to a slow start in the Arizona Fall League is not going to stress him out.

“Obviously, you’re looking for the first hit, but you don’t really want to go off of results here,” said Casey, who is still looking for his first hit of the campaign with the Mesa Solar Sox. “I think it’s more, ‘How can I learn and get better every day’ here. Just stay with the process is the biggest thing here.”

The Blue Jays’ No. 23 prospect is the son of former big leaguer/current MLB Network analyst Sean Casey, and while the 23-year-old outfielder says there are some similarities with his dad -- the left-handed swing and some mannerisms they share -- there are far more differences. That starts with speed. Even though Jake thinks his dad gets a bad rap for his lack of it, he’s aware it sets him apart from Sean.

“My mom’s side,” is where the speed comes from, Casey said. “My mom’s dad, he was a really good athlete when he was growing up. He would tell me he played football. He was really athletic. And I trained with people growing up and did a lot of speed stuff. That’s probably the reason why.”

Even though he came up empty in the hit column in Tuesday night’s 4-3 loss to Glendale, Casey showed that he’s learning that speed doesn’t slump, even if you've gone 0-for-11 to start the season. He got aboard three times and wreaked havoc on the basepaths, an area of emphasis after he stole 10 bases in 64 games during his first full season.

“Nothing to show for it the first three games, but I think I’ve already learned a lot,” Casey said. “Three bags today, a career high. Learning how to steal bases, learning how to use my speed. Understanding that I have a really elite tool -- speed -- and talking with these coaches and understanding that I can impact the game in more ways than just hitting. One thing I’m trying to learn more is to use that tool to my advantage, learn how to be a better baserunner and defender.”

He’s also working on some mechanical things along with adapting his approach, another reason why the stat sheet doesn’t matter as much. Casey got to his power in 2026 with 13 homers and a .504 slugging percentage, but that came with a 28.1 percent strikeout rate.

“I’m definitely trying to tinker with my swing a little bit,” Casey said, “trying to cut down on the swing-and-miss, cut down getting to two strikes in a lot of at-bats, trying to do more damage earlier in the counts.
“I’m using this Fall League more as an opportunity than trying to be so perfect, an opportunity to improve my offense, improve my swing.”
Subscribe to the MLB Pipeline Newsletter

While Casey missed more than two months and then had some of the typical post-hamate adjustment at the plate, he swung the bat well late in the year, with a 1.012 OPS in August. And he capped things off with something every player wants to experience as part of the last team standing when the Vancouver Canadians won the High-A Northwest League title.

“That was really cool, especially being an everyday guy in that lineup, being a part of that group of guys was really special,” Casey said. “Shout out to Vancouver, they packed the house every night. It was a really cool atmosphere to play in. That was one of the coolest things I’ve ever done in my life, winning that championship.”
items.titleZh: 蓝鸟外野潜力新秀Jake Casey在亚利桑那秋季联赛开启新征程
items.summaryZh: 蓝鸟外野潜力新秀Jake Casey正通过亚利桑那秋季联赛积累经验、打磨球技。
bodyZh: 梅萨，亚利桑那州——Jake Casey在2024年效力肯特州立大学时接受了汤米·约翰手术。在多伦多蓝鸟在2025年选秀大会第15轮选中这位肯特州立大学出品的球员后，他在2026赛季的首场比赛中就遭遇了钩骨骨折。因此，在亚利桑那秋季联赛中慢热并不会让他感到压力。
“显然，你一直在寻找第一支安打，但你其实并不想在这里只看重结果，”效力于梅萨太阳袜队的Jake Casey说道，目前他仍在寻找自己本赛季的第一支安打。“我认为更重要的是，在这里我每天如何学习并变得更好。坚持过程才是这里最重要的事情。”
这位蓝鸟排名第23位的潜力新秀是前大联盟球员兼现MLB Network分析师Sean Casey的儿子。这位23岁的外野手表示，他和父亲确实有一些相似之处——比如左手挥棒和一些共同的习惯动作，但两者的差异要大得多。这首先体现在速度上。尽管Jake认为父亲因为缺乏速度而风评不佳，但他很清楚这让自己与Sean有所不同。
“速度随我妈妈那边，”Jake Casey说。“我外公年轻时是个非常出色的运动员。他会告诉我他踢过美式足球。他运动能力极强。我从小就和别人一起训练，做过很多速度方面的专项训练。这可能就是原因所在。”
尽管在周二晚以4比3不敌格伦代尔的比赛中，他的安打栏依然挂零，但Jake Casey展现出他正在明白速度不会陷入低迷，即便赛季开局遭遇11打数0安打。他三次上垒并在垒包上大肆破坏，这是他经历首个完整赛季并在64场比赛中盗垒10次之后的重点强调领域。
“前三场比赛没有什么数据支撑，但我认为我已经学到了很多，”Jake Casey说。“今天有三个盗垒，创下了生涯新高。学习如何盗垒，学习如何利用我的速度。明白我拥有一项真正顶级的武器——速度，并与这些教练交流，明白我不仅能通过击打，还能通过更多方式影响比赛。我努力学习的一点就是利用这个优势武器，学习如何成为更好的跑垒员和防守球员。”
他还在进行一些击打机制的调整，同时适应自己的进攻策略，这也是为什么数据统计表并不那么重要的另一个原因。Jake Casey在2026年展现了长打能力，轰出13支本垒打并交出.504的长打率，但这也伴随着28.1%的三振率。
“我绝对在尝试对自己的挥棒做一点微调，”Jake Casey说，“试图减少挥空率，减少在很多打席中陷入两好球的局面，尝试在球数领先时造成更多伤害。”
“我更多地将这个秋季联赛视为一个机会，而不是去追求完美，这是一个提升我进攻、提升我挥棒的机会。”
订阅 MLB Pipeline 通讯
虽然Jake Casey缺阵了两个多月，随后在打击区也经历了一些钩骨手术后的典型适应期，但他在年底打得很好，8月份的OPS达到了1.012。最后，温哥华加拿大人赢得高阶1A西北联盟冠军时，他也体验到了所有球员都渴望经历的作为笑到最后的冠军球队一员的滋味。
“这真的很酷，尤其是作为那个阵容中的主力球员，成为那一群球员中的一员特别特别，”Jake Casey说。“向温哥华致敬，他们每晚都座无虚席。那是一个非常棒的比赛氛围。赢得那个冠军是我一生中做过的最酷的事情之一。”
items.author: Jonathan Mayo

items.titleEn: Here is each club's Arizona Fall League sleeper prospect
bodyEn: Action in the Arizona Fall League kicks off this Saturday with a full slate of games, starting with the Glendale Desert Dogs hosting the Salt River Rafters at 12:30 p.m. (local time 3:30 p.m. ET).

While a lot of attention is understandably given to the high-profile prospects -- the late additions of Sebastian Walcott, Aidan Miller and Angeibel Gomez created some fun Top 100 buzz -- the Fall League also provides the opportunity for some lesser-known guys to show what they can do against good competition, with all 30 Major League organizations watching.
Here is an under-the-radar Fall Leaguer from each organization. All 30 are currently outside their system’s Top 30 Prospects list, but a strong AFL showing could change that.
Jump to: AL East | AL Central | AL West | NL East | NL Central | NL West
AMERICAN LEAGUE EAST

Blue Jays: Aaron Parker, CThe 2024 sixth-rounder ranked third in the Blue Jays system with 19 homers over 87 games for Double-A New Hampshire this season, and that total was also tied for third-most among Double-A backstops. While Parker packed on the power in ‘26, he did so at the expense of contact with his strikeout rate climbing from 19.6 percent at High-A last year to 32.3 percent this summer, and that could be a point of emphasis in the desert. He also sprinkled in three late appearances in left field to add some versatility before his AFL time.

Orioles: Patrick Reilly, RHPA fifth-round pick by the Pirates in 2023, Reilly went to the Orioles for Billy Cook at the 2024 Trade Deadline. At one point, he was as high as No. 10 on the O’s Top 30, but after needing Tommy John surgery three starts into the 2025 season, he tumbled off the list. He made it back for 53 innings this year and his stuff -- a fastball up to 97 mph, a slider and a cutter -- missed plenty of bats (11.9 K/9). Command has never been his forte, but if he’s around the zone this fall, he could be one of the better arms in the league.

Rays: Yereny Teus, LHPTeus doesn’t cut a huge figure on the mound at 5-foot-10, but he certainly put up big-time numbers in his age-22 season for Single-A Charleston: namely a 2.00 ERA, .122 average-against and 80 strikeouts in 54 innings of relief. His 38.1 percent K rate was 15th-best among 1,382 Minor Leaguers with at least 50 frames this season. While using a 90-93 mph fastball, Teus earns his best grades on an 82-85 mph changeup and a low-80s breaking ball that both earned whiff rates at or above 60 percent, per Synergy. Fall League batters will represent a better test than their Single-A counterparts.

Red Sox: Antonio Anderson, 3B/1BThe Sox took Anderson in the third round in 2023 and signed him away from a Georgia Tech commitment with a $1.5 million bonus. He’s dwelled in the lower Minors ever since and hadn’t been an above-average for a full season until 2026, when he finished with a .273/.373/.453 line, nine homers and 113 wRC+ in 85 games for High-A Greenville. A switch-hitter, Anderson was more productive from the right side this season, but overall, it was most promising that he raised his High-A contact rate from 65.6 percent in ‘25 to 71.5 this summer.

Yankees: Antonio Gomez, RHPGomez appeared on a Yankees preseason Top 30 list as a catcher as recently as 2022, when he checked in at No. 19. But he never cracked higher than Double-A as a backstop and moved to pitching -- no shock for someone who used to have 70 grades for arm strength behind the dish. Gomez only has 10 Single-A appearances on his resume to this point, but touched 100.7 mph with his four-seamer on Aug. 8 and showed a short upper-80s slider during his time at Single-A -- two pitches that could grab more attention in the Valley.
AMERICAN LEAGUE CENTRAL

Guardians: Aidan Major, RHPThe 2024 fifth-rounder missed the entire 2025 season due to Tommy John recovery and rehab and got back on the mound this spring with Single-A Hill City, only to get struck in the head by a comebacker in a scary scene on May 26. He returned to the club two months later, and was promoted to High-A Lake County after three more starts, finishing the regular season with a 4.55 ERA and 57 strikeouts in 63⅓ innings. He sits 91-93 mph with his fastball and uses a low-80s slider, a mid-80s changeup and an upper-70s curveball to get whiffs.

Royals: Austin Charles, SSKansas City has been high on Charles’ potential as a big-bodied infielder (he’s 6-foot-5) since signing him for $429,500 as a 20th-rounder back in 2022. While he was limited to only 45 games with High-A Quad Cities by a core injury that kept him out for three months, he was productive with a .285/.353/.491 line, seven homers, 10 steals and a 115 wRC+ in that time. His 75.3 percent contact rate in the Midwest League was the highest of his career, a promising sign given he has at least above-average power potential.

Tigers: Maddox Long, RHPThe 6-foot-5 right-hander opened the season with the Washington WildThings in the Frontier League before the Tigers picked him up in June. He sported a 3.74 ERA and a 1.16 WHIP with 44 strikeouts in 33⅔ innings across the Florida Complex League, Single-A Lakeland and High-A West Michigan and now heads to Scottsdale for his fifth team of ‘26. The 25-year-old uses a 82-85 mph high-spin slider as a primary pitch -- understandable since it had a 40 percent whiff rate in full-season ball -- and backs that up with a pair of low-90s fastballs, a cutter and a changeup.

Twins: Jacob McCombs, OFAfter a strong sophomore-eligible season at UC-Irvine, McCombs went to the Twins in the seventh round of the 2025 Draft. He’s a solid left-handed hitter who can be aggressive at the plate, making a ton of contact. There’s some raw pop for him to tap into and he’s looking to make up for some lost at-bats, playing just 67 games with High-A Cedar Rapids during his first full season of pro ball. He’s capable of playing all three outfield spots.

White Sox: Garrett Wright, RHPWright signed with the White Sox as a 20th-round pick out of TCU in 2023 but only managed 16⅔ innings over the next two seasons combined. He climbed three levels in ‘26 and finished with a 4.20 ERA, .181 average-against and 77 strikeouts across 55⅔ innings between Single-A, High-A and Double-A. Now Wright heads to Glendale to close out his 40-man roster-decision year. The 6-foot-2 righty sits 95-98 mph with his fastball and gets a ton of whiffs with his 87-90 slider from an over-the-top delivery.
AMERICAN LEAGUE WEST

Angels: Peyton Olejnik, RHPOlejnik has the chance to stand out for the Mesa Solar Sox, and it’s not just because he’s 6-foot-11. The right-hander was on the back end of the Angels’ Top 30 at the start of the season, but got nudged off as he posted a 4.47 ERA in 106 2/3 IP with High-A Tri-City. He still missed bats (9.4 K/9), but as a guy without wow stuff, he needs to cut down on his walks and command his stuff within the zone better so he doesn’t get squared up as much (8.3 BB/9 in 2026).

Astros: Juan Bello, RHPBello signed with the Cubs for just $10,000 in 2022 and was coming off a solid 2024 full-season debut when he was sent to the Astros in January 2025 for Ryan Pressly. Bello has an intriguing four-pitch mix led by a curve that can really miss bats, but he hasn’t thrown a competitive pitch since July 2025 because of an elbow injury that required Tommy John surgery. There might be some rust to shake off, but this stint could help the 22-year-old get ready for a jump to Double-A in 2027.

A’s: Jay Dill, RHPDill served as Troy University’s closer in 2025 and showed off enough power stuff for the A’s to take a no-risk $100,000 flier on him in Round 18 of the Draft that July. He pitched his way from Single-A Stockton to Double-A Midland in his first full season, and the hard-throwing reliever used his power repertoire to strike out 10.7 per nine with a 30 percent overall miss rate. Whether he can throw strikes consistently enough (5.6 BB/9) will be the key to him finding a big league bullpen role in the future.

Mariners: Ty Cummings, RHPA reliever at Campbell University in 2023, Cummings was drafted in Round 7 in 2023 and given a chance to start by the Mariners. He had an encouraging first full season in High-A Everett’s rotation in 2024, then was shipped to the Rays as the player to be named later in the Randy Arozarena deal. He reached Triple-A in 2025, albeit without missing many bats, then was on the move again … back to the Mariners this April. Back in the bullpen, the results weren’t there post-trade (6.04 ERA with Double-A Arkansas), but he was sitting 95 mph with his heater for most of the year with an intriguing east-west profile.

Rangers: Jesus Gamez, RHPGamez could be one of the most volatile arms in the desert this year. He struck out 69 batters over 43⅓ innings at High-A Hub City this summer but walked more than a batter per frame (47) in that same span. He can get his fastball up to the upper 90s, and that does a nice job of setting up his secondaries with his slider and splitter both sporting whiff rates above 67 percent, per Synergy. He needs to find more of the zone or elicit more chase to be truly effective, but the volume of swing-and-miss makes him at least interesting.
Subscribe to the MLB Pipeline Newsletter
NATIONAL LEAGUE EAST

Braves: Tyler LaPorte, RHPAt 29, LaPorte is the oldest player in the AFL this year and the oldest participant in recent memory (even older than Tim Tebow!) Initially an infielder at Southern University, LaPorte pitched in the Draft League at age 24 in 2021. That led to a four-year odyssey through the indy ball ranks, playing in both the Atlantic and Frontier Leagues before finally getting a shot in affiliated ball when the Braves signed him ahead of the 2025 season. He spent 2026 at Double-A, finishing with a 1.84 ERA, a 13.4 K/9 rate and 10 saves. He can run his fastball up to 97 and his 84-85 mph slider elicited a 47 percent miss rate this season.

Marlins: Carter Johnson, INFJohnson was an over-slot second-round sign by the Marlins in 2024, joining the organization out of the Mississippi high school ranks for $2.8 million, $1.2 million above pick value. He really scuffled through his first full season (.536 OPS) in 2025, but started to get to some impact and reached High-A in 2026, thanks to some better swing decisions and added strength. He’ll keep working on attacking better pitches in better counts while continuing to work all over the dirt.

Mets: Peyton Prescott, RHPPrescott touched triple digits out of the Florida State bullpen in the spring of 2025 but tore the UCL in his right elbow and needed Tommy John surgery. The Mets took him in the fifth round anyway, believing it could be a buy-low opportunity on an electric arm. Prescott finally made his organizational debut with one inning for Single-A St. Lucie, sitting between 94.5 and 96.5 mph with that four-seamer while sprinkling in cutters, sliders, changeups and curveballs over the 18-pitch outing. The slider and changeup were both whiff-heavy options as an amateur, but the biggest thing for Prescott will be just establishing a broader foundation of innings heading into his second full season.

Nationals: Jorgelys Mota, OF/3BNats fans might recall that Mota had the highest exit velocity (115.0 mph) and longest home run (434 feet) recorded by any Washington player during Grapefruit League play last spring. He also possesses an impressive set of wheels, giving him one of the best (if not the best) combinations of power and speed in the system. However, he played only 23 games for High-A Wilmington this summer and made contact on just 57.1 percent of his swings with the Blue Rocks, underlining the hit-tool concerns that have plagued much of his career. Mota could still be good for a number of highlights with Salt River this fall, and he’ll also continue his transition to center field, where his athleticism can flourish all the more.

Phillies: Kehden Hettiger, C/1BThe surface numbers don’t stand out for Hettiger, with a career .676 OPS and a .191/.317/.348 line over 61 games for Double-A Reading this year. But there’s raw power in his left hand swing and some of his underlying tendencies -- he doesn’t swing at pitches out of the zone and pulls the ball well in the air -- are interesting, even if he needs to work on his in-zone miss. He also grades very well in terms of his defensive metrics behind the plate and he’s still only 22 years old.
NATIONAL LEAGUE CENTRAL

Brewers: Matt Wood, CWood may have been a bit overshadowed by bigger names on a loaded Double-A Biloxi roster this season, but his performance was up there among the Shuckers’ best. The lefty slugger rarely expanded the zone and made a good amount of contact when he did swing, leading to a 52/71 K/BB ratio and a .398 OBP over 95 games in the Southern League. The Brewers also improved the quality of his angles off the bat, enabling him to hit a career-high 18 homers. He was left unprotected when eligible in last year’s Rule 5 Draft but could strengthen his 40-man case by carrying his momentum to the Scottsdale roster.

Cardinals: Sammy Hernandez, C/1BHernandez began the year as High-A Peoria’s No. 2 catcher behind phenom Rainiel Rodriguez, but after Rodriguez’s promotion to Double-A Springfield, the 5-foot-9 backstop took on a more central role and flourished, finishing with a .279/.411/.529 line, 11 homers and 21 steals across 65 games in the Midwest League. His 140 wRC+ was third-best in the system behind Rodriguez’s 150 and Miguel Hernández’s 146. An extreme pull hitter from the right side, Hernandez cut down on some of his swing aggression and nearly doubled his previous career homer high of six in the process.

Cubs: Kade Snell, OFSnell began his college career as a left-handed pitcher at Auburn, but after redshirting because of injuries in 2021, he transferred to Wallace-Dothan Community College in Alabama and was the national junior college player of the year as a two-way guy in 2023. After transferring to Alabama and serving in both roles the next year, he was an outfielder only in 2025, leading to him becoming an intriguing money-saving senior sign in the fifth round of that year’s Draft. A broken wrist limited him to 81 games with High-A South Bend, but he offers an intriguing combination of feel for the barrel and swing decisions to go along with sneaky pop, the ability to steal a bag and play all three outfield spots, though he’s likely best suited for left.

Pirates: Zander Mueth, RHPThe Pirates went over slot to sign the projectable Mueth out of the Illinois high school ranks for $1.8 million in the second round of the 2023 Draft. It has not gone well since an encouraging 2024 debut season and he’s yet to get past Single-A Bradenton. The 6-foot-6 right-hander's raw stuff has always been electric -- he was up to 99 mph with his heater this year -- but he’s struggled with his command both in the zone (9.2 BB/9 this season) and out of it (8.7 BB/9). The Pirates are hoping ignite something by having him come out of the bullpen this fall without telling him when he’s pitching until the day of. He’s often been guilty of trying to do too much off the field and they want him to just show up and let his stuff play.

Reds: Victor Diaz, RHPDiaz joined the Reds as a non-drafted free agent out of Seminole State Junior College in August 2024 and had a fairly nondescript first full season of pro ball in 2025. Things clicked a bit more pitching out of High-A Dayton’s bullpen this year, striking out 13.3 per nine (albeit with a 6.5 BB/9 rate) and posting a 3.33 ERA to earn a bump up to Double-A. His fastball, which tops out at 99 mph, missed bats at a 30 percent rate in 2026.
NATIONAL LEAGUE WEST

D-backs: Joe Ariola, LHPThe 6-foot-2 left-hander struck out 45.7 percent of his batters faced over 34⅔ innings across the Arizona Complex League, Single-A, High-A and Double-A this season, giving him the highest K rate among the 2,402 Minor Leaguers who pitched at least 30 frames in 2026. As if that wasn’t impressive enough, the 2025 seventh-rounder out of Wake Forest also finished with a 1.56 ERA and a 1.04 WHIP over 21 appearances. Ariola throws a 93-96 mph fastball from a high release that can make hitters uncomfortable, and his 79-81 mph curveball gets plus-plus whiff rates off of that. He can also mix in a slider and a changeup to keep hitters guessing, though he doesn’t need them as much in a relief role.

Dodgers: Sam Horn, RHPHorn might be the most intriguing guy on this list, which is kind of amazing since he’s yet to throw a pro pitch and amassed just 15 innings over two seasons at Missouri. Tommy John surgery knocked out his 2024 season and most of his career as Mizzou’s quarterback also got erased by injury, including a broken tibia suffered on the one play he ran under center for the Tigers after signing with Los Angeles for nearly $500,000 in the 17th round of the 2025 Draft. It will be everyone’s first pro look at Horn, his fastball (up to 98 mph in 2025) and his 82-86 mph sweeper.

Giants: Dalton Wentz, 2B/3BOne of two 2026 draftees in the Fall League this year, Wentz hit 18 homers and finished with an OPS over 1.000 at Wake Forest this past spring as one of the more intriguing sophomore-eligibles in the class. The Giants gave him almost $585,000 in Round 16 to add him to their robust system and he got his feet wet with 13 games for High-A Eugene. He has a power-over-hit profile and can really crush fastballs, though he’s going to have to learn to tone down his aggressiveness and handle soft stuff better while seeing time at second and third base.

Padres: Justin DeCriscio, UTILThe 2025 10th-rounder out of NC State focused primarily on shortstop between Single-A, High-A and Double-A in his first full season but also saw time at five different positions, giving him the utility label at an early juncture in his career. Batting from the right side, DeCriscio posted solid contact rates at every stop to fuel his rise and finished with a .270/.358/.425 line, 13 homers and 22 steals over 121 games. He may project best as a hit-tool forward player who can fill multiple roles off the bench, and that’d be a solid outcome for a former senior sign who joined the organization for just $15,000.

Rockies: Jack O’Dowd, C/1BThe son of former Rockies’ GM and long-time MLB Network analyst Dan O’Dowd, it took a while for Jack O’Dowd to find a home. He hit over .300 in the Draft League in 2024, then spent a year lighting up the independent Pioneer League before the Rockies signed him as a free agent this past January. Playing most of the year at age 25, the fact he crushed Single-A California League pitching didn’t land on many radars, but people started noticing when he got bumped up to High-A after 22 games. He was on the move again to Double-A 34 games after that, and while his production certainly dipped with Hartford, he still finished the year with a .307/.383/.564 line to go along with 23 homers and 91 RBIs.
items.titleZh: 各队亚利桑那秋季联赛潜力新秀盘点
items.summaryZh: 亚利桑那秋季联赛即将开打，本文盘点30支球队阵中备受关注的潜力新秀。来看多伦多蓝鸟及其他球队的未来之星。
bodyZh: 亚利桑那秋季联赛将于本周六拉开帷幕，首日将进行多场比赛，打头阵的是格伦代尔沙漠狗队于当地时间下午12:30（美东时间下午3:30）迎战盐河落水狗队。
尽管外界的目光自然聚焦于那些备受瞩目的顶级新秀——塞巴斯蒂安·沃尔科特（Sebastian Walcott）、艾丹·米勒（Aiden Miller）和安吉贝尔·戈麦斯（Angeibel Gomez）等人的压哨加入引发了百大新秀榜的讨论——但秋季联赛也为一些名气较小的球员提供了一个在30支大联盟球队的注视下、与优秀竞争对手较量的舞台。
以下是各支球队阵中一位较为低调的秋季联赛球员。这30人目前均不在各自球队的Top 30潜力新秀榜单内，但在秋季联赛中的强势表现可能会改变这一现状。
跳转至：美联东区 | 美联中区 | 美联西区 | 国联东区 | 国联中区 | 国联西区
美国联盟东区
多伦多蓝鸟：亚伦·帕克（Aaron Parker），捕手。这位2024年的第六轮秀本赛季在2A新罕布什尔轰出19支本垒打，在蓝鸟体系中排名第三，这一数据也在2A所有捕手中并列第三。帕克在2026年展现了爆发力，但这以牺牲击球率为代价，他的三振率从去年在高阶1A的19.6%飙升至今年夏天的32.3%，这可能会成为他在沙漠中重点改进的地方。在参加秋季联赛之前，他还客串了三场左外野，以增加防守多面性。

巴尔的摩金莺：帕特里克·赖利（Patrick Reilly），右投。赖利是海盗在2023年选秀中第5轮选中的球员，在2024年交易截止日前作为比利·库克（Billy Cook）交易的一部分来到金莺。他曾一度高居金莺Top 30榜单第10位，但在2025赛季投了三场比赛后便接受了汤米·约翰手术，随后跌出榜单。他今年伤愈复出投了53局，其球威——高达97英里的直球、滑球和卡特球——制造了大量的挥空（每9局11.9次三振）。控球从来都不是他的强项，但如果他今年秋天能控制好进垒点，他可能会成为联盟中最好的投手之一。

坦帕湾光芒：叶雷尼·托乌斯（Yereny Teus），左投。身高5尺10寸的托乌斯在投手丘上并不显得高大，但他在效力单A查尔斯顿的22岁赛季交出了亮眼数据：在54局的后援投球中，防御率2.00、被打击率.122并送出80次三振。他38.1%的三振率在今年投满至少50局的1,382名小联盟球员中排名第15位。据Synergy统计，托乌斯的90-93英里直球表现平平，但其82-85英里的变速球和80码出头的决胜球（breaking ball）均获得了60%或以上的挥空率。秋季联赛的打者将是对他比单A时期更好的考验。

波士顿红袜：安东尼·安德森（Antonio Anderson），三垒手/一垒手。红袜在2023年第三轮选中安德森，并以150万美元的签约金截胡了佐治亚理工学院的承诺。此后他一直混迹于低阶小联盟，直到2026年才迎来首个整季表现高于平均的赛季，他在高阶1A格林维尔出赛85场，交出.273/.373/.453的打击三围、9支本垒打和113的加权得分创造力（wRC+）。作为一名左右开弓打者，安德森今年右打时的效率更高，但总体而言，最令人欣喜的是他将高阶1A的击球率从2025年的65.6%提升到了今年夏天的71.5%。

纽约洋基：安东尼·戈麦斯（Antonio Gomez），右投。戈麦斯最近一次出现在洋基季前Top 30榜单上是在2022年，当时他作为捕手排名第19位。但他作为捕手最高只升到2A，随后转型为投手——对于一个以前在捕手位置上拥有70分臂力评分的球员来说，这并不令人意外。戈麦斯目前在简历上只有10场单A出场记录，但在8月8日的比赛中，他的四缝线直球曾达到100.7英里/小时，并在单A效力期间展示了一颗80码中后段的短滑球——这两球可能会在峡谷（Valley）吸引更多关注。
美国联盟中区

克利夫兰守护者：艾丹·迈杰尔（Aidan Major），右投。这位2024年的第五轮秀因接受汤米·约翰手术及康复错过了整个2025赛季，并在今年春天于单A希尔城重返投手丘，不料在5月26日的一场比赛中被一颗强袭球击中头部，场面惊险。两个月后他重返球队，在再投三场先发后被升至高阶1A湖郡，常规赛结束时交出4.55防御率，在63又1/3局中送出57次三振。他的直球球速维持在91-93英里/小时，并依靠80码初段的滑球、80码中段的变速球和70码末段的曲球来制造挥空。

堪萨斯城皇家：奥斯汀·查尔斯（Austin Charles），游击手。皇家自2022年以第20轮、42.95万美元签下这位身材高大的内野手（身高6尺5寸）以来，一直很看好他的潜力。尽管他因伤势缺阵三个月，导致在高阶四城队仅出场45场，但在此期间他表现高效，交出.285/.353/.491的打击三围、7支本垒打、10次盗垒以及115的wRC+。他在中西部联盟75.3%的击球率是其职业生涯新高，考虑到他至少拥有高于平均水平的长打潜力，这是一个充满希望的信号。

底特律老虎：马多克斯·朗（Maddox Long），右投。这位身高6尺5寸的右投手在赛季初效力于边疆联盟的华盛顿野生物队，6月被老虎签下。他在佛罗里达复合联盟、单A莱克兰和高阶1A西密歇根总共33又2/3局的投球中，交出3.74防御率、1.16的WHIP和44次三振，现在前往斯科茨代尔效力其2026赛季的第五支球队。这位25岁的球员以一颗82-85英里、高旋转率的滑球作为主要球种——这很好理解，因为它在全赛季比赛中的挥空率达到了40%，并辅以两颗90码出头的直球、一颗卡特球和一颗变速球。
明尼苏达双城：雅各布·麦科姆斯（Jacob McCombs），外野手。在加州大学尔湾分校度过了一个强势的大二赛季后，麦科姆斯在2025年选秀大会第七轮加盟双城。他是一名稳健的左打者，在打击区上积极性高，能打出大量安打。他还有一些尚未完全挖掘的生涩爆发力，并且正试图弥补因伤错失的打席——在他职业生涯的首个完整赛季中，他仅代表高阶1A锡达拉皮兹出场67次。他能够胜任外野三个位置。

芝加哥白袜：加勒特·赖特（Garrett Wright），右投。赖特在2023年通过第20轮选秀从得克萨斯基督教大学（TCU）与白袜签约，但在接下来的两个赛季里总共只投了16又2/3局。他在2026年连升三级，在单A、高阶1A和2A之间合计出战55又2/3局，交出4.20防御率、.181被打击率和77次三振。如今赖特前往格伦代尔，以结束他面临40人名单抉择的一年。这位身高6尺2寸的右投手直球球速在95-98英里/小时之间，并凭借高压投球姿势投出的87-90英里滑球制造了大量挥空。
美国联盟西区

洛杉矶天使：佩顿·奥莱尼克（Peyton Olejnik），右投。奥莱尼克有机会在梅萨太阳袜队脱颖而出，这不仅因为他身高6尺11寸。这位右投手在赛季初处于天使Top 30榜单的末尾，但随着他在高阶三城队以106又2/3局投出4.47防御率而被挤出榜单。他依然能制造挥空（每9局9.4次三振），但作为一个球威不算惊艳的投手，他需要减少保送，并在好球带内更好地控制球路，以减少被扎实击中的概率（2026年每9局8.3次保送）。

休斯敦太空人：胡安·贝洛（Juan Bello），右投。贝洛在2022年仅以1万美元与小熊签约，在经历了2025年1月作为换取瑞安·普雷斯利（Ryan Pressly）的筹码被送往太空人之前，他刚度过了一个扎实的全赛季首秀。贝洛拥有令人期待的四球种组合，以一颗极具三振能力的曲球为主，但由于需要进行汤米·约翰手术的肘部伤势，他自2025年7月以来就没有在正式比赛中投过球。他可能需要摆脱一些生锈的状态，但这次秋季联赛的历练有助于这位22岁球员为2027年升入2A做好准备。

运动家：杰伊·迪尔（Jay Dill），右投。迪尔在2025年担任特洛伊大学的终结者，展现出了足够的球威，让运动家在同年7月的选秀第18轮以10万美元的低风险签下了他。在他职业生涯的首个完整赛季里，他从单A斯托克顿一路投到了2A米德兰，这位球速极快的后援投手利用其强大的投球组合，交出了每9局10.7次三振、整体挥空率30%的成绩单。他未来能否在在大联盟牛棚找到一席之地，关键在于他能否保持足够的控球稳定性（每9局5.6次保送）。

西雅图水手：泰·卡明斯（Ty Cummings），右投。卡明斯在2023年是坎贝尔大学的后援投手，在2023年第7轮被选中后，水手给了他担任先发的机会。他在2024年高阶1A埃弗雷特的先发轮换中度过了令人鼓舞的首个全赛季，随后作为兰迪·阿罗萨雷纳（Randy Arozarena）交易案中的待定球员被送往光芒。他在2025年升上3A，尽管并没有制造太多挥空，随后又在今年4月……再次被交易回水手。回到牛棚后，交易后的表现并不理想（在2A阿肯色防御率为6.04），但他在大部分时间里直球球速维持在95英里，并展现了令人感兴趣的东西向配球风格。

得克萨斯游骑兵：赫苏斯·加梅斯（Jesus Gamez），右投。加梅斯可能是今年沙漠中状态最起伏不定的投手之一。他今年夏天在高阶胡比城43又2/3局的投球中三振了69名打者，但同期也投出了超过每局一次的保送（47次）。他的直球球速可达90码后段，这为他的配球打下了良好基础，据Synergy统计，他的滑球和指叉球的挥空率均超过67%。他需要找到更多好球带或诱使更多挥空才能真正展现威力，但挥空率的数量至少让他充满看点。
订阅 MLB Pipeline 新闻通讯
国家联盟东区

亚特兰大勇士：泰勒·拉波尔特（Tyler LaPorte），右投。29岁的拉波尔特是今年秋季联赛中年龄最大的球员，也是近年记忆中年龄最大的参赛者（甚至比蒂姆·蒂博特 Tim Tebow还要年长！）。拉波尔特最初在南方大学担任内野手，2021年24岁时曾在选秀联盟（Draft League）投球。这开启了他长达四年的独立联盟漫游之旅，先后效力于大西洋联盟和边疆联盟，直到勇士在2025赛季前将他签下，他才终于获得了在附属小联盟球队效力的机会。他在2026年效力于2A，以1.84的防御率、每9局13.4次三振和10次救援成功结束赛季。他的直球球速可达97英里，其84-85英里的滑球在今年赛季引诱了47%的挥空率。
迈阿密马林鱼：卡特·约翰逊（Carter Johnson），内野手。约翰逊是马林鱼在2024年以高于顺位价值120万美元、总计280万美元从密西西比州高中阵营签下的高顺位第二轮秀。他在2025年的首个完整赛季表现挣扎（OPS仅.536），但在2026年通过改善挥棒决策和增加力量，开始打出破坏力并升上高阶1A。他将继续致力于在更好的球数下对好球发起攻击，同时在内野各个位置上磨练防守。

纽约大都会：佩顿·普雷斯科特（Peyton Prescott），右投。普雷斯科特在2025年春季从佛罗里达州大牛棚登板时球速曾达到三位数，但随后右肘尺侧副韧带（UCL）撕裂并接受了汤米·约翰手术。大都会依然在第五轮将其选中，坚信这是一个低价买入潜力电臂的机会。普雷斯科特终于在单A圣露西完成了他在组织内的首秀，投了一局，其四缝线直球球速在94.5至96.5英里之间，在这18球的登板中还穿插了卡特球、滑球、变速球和曲球。他在业余时期滑球和变速球都是极佳的挥空武器，但对于普雷斯科特来说，最重要的还是在迈向第二个完整赛季的过程中，建立起更扎实的投球局数基础。

华盛顿国民：约尔格利斯·莫塔（Jorgelys Mota），外野手/三垒手。国民球迷可能还记得，莫塔在去年春训格雷普果联赛期间曾打出华盛顿球员中最高的击球初速（115.0英里/小时）和最远的本垒打（434英尺）。他还拥有出色的脚程，这让他拥有球队体系中最好（如果不是最好之一）的力量与速度结合。然而，他今年夏天在高阶威尔明顿仅出场23场，在蓝岩队的挥棒中击球率仅为57.1%，这突显了长期困扰他职业生涯的击球能力（hit-tool）隐患。莫塔今年秋天在盐河队依然能制造不少高光时刻，他也将继续转型为中外野手，让自己的运动能力得到更充分的发挥。

费城费城人：凯登·赫蒂格（Kehden Hettiger），捕手/一垒手。表面数据对赫蒂格来说并不起眼，他职业生涯的OPS为.676，今年在2A雷丁出赛61场交出.191/.317/.348的打击三围。但他的左打击球动作中蕴含着生涩的爆发力，且其潜在的击球倾向——不挥好球带外的球、并且能将球拉向空中——很有看点，尽管他仍需改善在好球带内的挥空问题。他在本垒后方的防守数据评级也非常高，而且他年仅22岁。
国家联盟中区

密尔沃基酿酒人：马特·木头（Matt Wood），捕手。本赛季在球星云集的2A比洛克西阵容中，木头的光芒或许有些被掩盖，但他的表现堪称Shuckers队的佼佼者之一。这位左打重炮手极少扩大好球带，挥棒时能打出不错的安打，在南部联盟的95场比赛中交出了52/71的三振/保送比以及.398的上垒率。酿酒人还改善了他击球的仰角品质，帮助他轰出了职业生涯新高的18支本垒打。他在去年规则五选秀符合资格时未受到保护，但如果能将这股势头带到斯科茨代尔的名单中，他将增加自己留在40人名单中的筹码。

圣路易斯红雀：萨米·赫尔南德斯（Sammy Hernandez），捕手/一垒手。赫尔南德斯在今年年初是高阶皮奥里亚队中排名雷尼尔·罗德里格斯（Rainiel Rodriguez）之后的第二捕手，但在罗德里格斯被升至2A斯普林菲尔德后，这位身高5尺9寸的捕手承担了更核心的角色并迎来爆发，在中西部联盟的65场比赛中交出.279/.411/.529的打击三围、11支本垒打和21次盗垒。他的140 wRC+在球队体系中排名第三，仅次于罗德里格斯的150和米格尔·埃尔南德斯的146。作为一名极致的右打拉打型打者，赫尔南德斯减少了部分挥棒激进性，并借此将他之前6支本垒打的生涯纪录几乎翻倍。

芝加哥小熊：凯德·斯内尔（Kade Snell），外野手。斯内尔的大学生涯是以奥本大学的左投手身份开始的，但在2021年因伤红衫（Redshirt）一年后，他转学到阿拉巴马州的华莱士-多坦社区学院，并在2023年成为全美两栖球星级别的全美初级学院年度最佳球员。转学至阿拉巴马大学并在次年承担双栖角色后，他于2025年专职外野手，这让他成为了该年选秀第五轮中一个引人注目的省钱高年级签约对象。手腕骨折限制他在高阶南本德仅出场81场，但他展现了对球棒掌控力的迷人结合以及挥棒决策，同时兼具潜在爆发力、盗垒能力以及镇守外野三个位置的能力，尽管他可能最适合左外野。

匹兹堡海盗：赞德·穆斯（Zander Mueth），右投。海盗在2023年选秀第二轮以180万美元的高于顺位签约金签下了这位极具塑造空间的伊利诺伊州高中生穆斯。自2024年令人鼓舞的首秀赛季以来，一切并不顺利，他至今仍未升过单A布雷顿顿。这位身高6尺6寸的右投手球威一直极为惊人——他今年的直球球速高达99英里——但他在好球带之内（本季每9局9.2次保送）和之外（每9局8.7次保送）的控球都陷入挣扎。海盗希望通过让他在今年秋天从牛棚出发、且当天才被告知何时登板的方式来激发点什么。他经常在场外试图做太多事情，球队希望他能直接登场并释放球威。

辛辛那提红人：维克托·迪亚兹（Victor Diaz），右投。迪亚兹在2024年8月通过塞米诺尔州立初级学院的未选秀自由球员身份加入红人，并在2025年迎来了平淡无奇的职业生涯首个全赛季。今年在高效力于高阶代顿的牛棚后，情况有所好转，他交出了每9局13.3次三振（尽管保送率高达6.5）和3.33防御率的成绩单，从而赢得了升上2A的机会。他的直球球速最高可达99英里，在2026年制造了30%的挥空率。
国家联盟西区

亚利桑那响尾蛇：乔·阿里奥拉（Joe Ariola），左投。这位身高6尺2寸的左投手在今年亚利桑那复合联盟、单A、高阶1A和2A总共34又2/3局的投球中，三振了面对打者的45.7%，这让他在2026年所有投满至少30局的2,402名小联盟球员中拥有最高的三振率。仿佛这还不够令人印象深刻似地，这位来自维克森林大学的2025年第七轮秀在21场出场中还交出了1.56的防御率和1.04的WHIP。阿里奥拉以高出手点投出93-96英里的直球，这会让打者感到不适，而他的79-81英里曲球则能在此基础上产生极高的挥空率。他还可以穿插滑球和变速球来让打者猜不透，尽管他在后援角色中并不那么需要这些。

洛杉矶道奇：萨姆·霍恩（Sam Horn），右投。霍恩可能是这份名单中最引人注目的球员，考虑到他尚未投过一球，且在密苏里大学的两个赛季里总共只投了15局，这简直令人惊叹。汤米·约翰手术让他缺席了2024赛季，他在密苏里大学作为四分卫的大部分职业生涯也因伤病而被抹杀，其中包括在以近50万美元在2025年选秀第17轮与洛杉矶签约后，为老虎队打中锋时遭遇的胫骨骨折。这将是所有人首次在职业赛场上看到霍恩、他的直球（2025年最高可达98英里）以及他的82-86英里扫掠滑球（sweeper）。

旧金山巨人：道尔顿·文茨（Dalton Wentz），二垒手/三垒手。作为今年秋季联赛仅有的两名2026年选秀新秀之一，文茨今年春天在维克森林大学轰出19支本垒打，OPS超过1.000，是该届备受瞩目的高年级可签球员之一。巨人以近58.5万美元的第16轮顺位将其招入麾下，以充实他们强大的体系，他通过在高阶尤金出战13场比赛来适应环境。他的球风偏向力量型而非纯安打型，且非常擅长痛击直球，尽管他在兼任二三垒防守的同时，必须学会收敛激进性并更好地应付慢速球。

圣迭戈教士：贾斯廷·德克里斯西奥（Justin DeCriscio），多功能内野手。这位来自北卡罗来纳州大的2025年第10轮秀在职业生涯的首个完整赛季中，主要在单A、高阶1A和2A之间镇守游击，但也客串了五个不同的防守位置，这让他在职业生涯早期就贴上了多功能球员的标签。作为一名右打者，德克里斯西奥在每一站都保持了扎实的击球率来推动自己晋升，在121场比赛中交出.270/.358/.425的打击三围、13支本垒打和22次盗垒。他最适合的发展方向可能是一名球棒能力出众、能胜任板凳席多重角色的球员，对于一个当初仅以1.5万美元加入球队的高年级新秀来说，这也是个不错的结局。

科罗拉多洛矶：杰克·奥多德（Jack O’Dowd），捕手/一垒手。作为前洛矶总经理兼长期 MLB 网络分析师丹·奥多德（Dan O’Dowd）的儿子，杰克·奥多德花了一段时间才找到立足之地。他在2024年的选秀联盟中打击率超过.300，随后在独立先锋联盟度过了闪耀的一年，直到洛矶在今年1月以自由球员身份将其签下。由于大部时间都在25岁的年龄段打球，他在单A加州联盟大杀四方的事实并没有引起太多雷达的关注，但当他在22场比赛后被提拔到高阶1A时，人们开始注意到他。在此后34场比赛中他又被升至2A，尽管他在哈特福德的数据确实有所下滑，但他仍以.307/.383/.564的打击三围、23支本垒打和91个打点结束了这一年。
items.author: Jonathan Mayo and Sam Dykstra

items.titleEn: 3 key questions before Blue Jays retool roster for 2027
bodyEn: TORONTO -- Until the Blue Jays can tear up the floors and begin to renovate this roster via free agency and trades, they’re stuck watching postseason baseball like the rest of us.

These coming weeks will be spent obsessing over how they can squeeze every bit of extra potential out of the players already on this roster. Some of these internal upgrades are obvious, like the pending return of Addison Barger for what the Blue Jays hope is a full, healthy 2027, or the likely move of Spencer Miles from the bullpen to the rotation.
Those are easy wins. Some of the other question marks are more complicated, and will shape how the Blue Jays attack their offseason when the fun really begins.
1. Who is Vladimir Guerrero Jr.?

Publicly, the Blue Jays have thrown their full support behind Guerrero after his career-worst season, with just nine home runs and a .688 OPS. General manager Ross Atkins shed some light on this, and made it clear that they didn’t see the league making any glaring adjustments to Guerrero, he just lost a “feeling” that he needs to get back.

“He’s such a dynamic athlete and hitter that it’s a really complex problem,” Atkins said. “Everyone in here can probably emulate his rhythm, his tempo, that toe tap and how he creates that momentum and rhythm. It’s a really impressive thing to watch. As he lost a little bit of that rhythm and timing over the course of pretty early in the season, it started to impact his confidence. Once it impacted his confidence, the in-game adjustments and in-season adjustments became very difficult.”

Privately, the Blue Jays need to be very honest with themselves. Do they truly believe that Guerrero will bounce back to hit 30-plus home runs with an .875 OPS next season, or is there concern? That will shape their offseason and how they build the lineup around Guerrero, because the 2026 version of this lineup was the worst in baseball.

Atkins also made it clear that Guerrero was not injured in 2026, at least nothing structural beyond the usual soreness and tightness all players experience. They believe they’ve identified the problem, but like Atkins says, it’s “complex,” and the solution might be, too.
2. Is Ernie Clement the starting second baseman?

Clement’s game just felt a bit out of sync this season. His bat looked great early, but his defense surprisingly lagged behind. Then, it flipped about four months into the season. Clement entered August with a .738 OPS, but put up just a .442 OPS in August and September. All things considered, is that enough to hold a guaranteed starting job?

“He’s got to earn every bit of that,” Atkins said. “It’s not just writing down, ‘OK, we’re covered,’ but he always has [earned it]. When he’s been given an opportunity, he’s run with it. We’re always trying to complement every player the best that we can. Ernie can be an everyday, impactful player. He can also be a player who plays [most] games and plays at a really high level, and because we’re such a good team, he isn’t the guy that’s being pencilled in every day.”

The 2025 postseason and ’26 World Baseball Classic appearance were factors, especially for a player with Clement’s all-out playing style. He’s due an arbitration raise from $4.6 million, though, so consider this a flexible roster spot. If the Blue Jays add another infielder, Clement has the athleticism to play every infield spot. Somehow, some way, he’s going to find his way into just about every game next season.
3. Can the Blue Jays count on anything from Anthony Santander?
Two years, 54 games and a .175 average. Santander’s five-year, $92.5 million deal isn’t off to a great start.

He rehabbed from shoulder surgery late into 2026, but it never felt like Santander was a realistic option to return. He’s expected to be fully healthy heading into 2027, though, and the Blue Jays need to figure out how he fits this roster.
“We want Tony to be thinking about playing the outfield and being an option for us there,” Atkins said, “having as much flexibility as possible.”

Atkins says he’d prefer to keep the DH spot open. That could allow the Blue Jays to cycle players through, something that wasn’t always an option with George Springer taking up that spot the past couple of seasons. Santander still feels like the best bet to have the most starts at DH next season, but at this point, the Blue Jays need to consider any contributions from him a bonus.
items.titleZh: 多伦多蓝鸟在2027赛季重组阵容前的3个关键问题
items.summaryZh: 多伦多蓝鸟正面临阵容重组，以下是展望2027赛季的三个关键问题。
bodyZh: 多伦多蓝鸟 -- 在能够拆除旧有框架并通过自由球员市场和交易来翻新这个阵容之前，他们只能像我们其他人一样苦等季后赛。
接下来的几周时间将用来琢磨如何榨取出这套现有阵容中球员们的每一点潜力。其中一些内部提升显而易见，比如多伦多蓝鸟希望Addison Barger能迎来一个健康且完整的2027赛季，或者Spencer Miles很可能从牛棚转入先发轮值。
这些都是容易解决的问题。其他一些问号则更加复杂，并将决定多伦多蓝鸟在真正热闹的休赛期到来时如何采取行动。
1. Vladimir Guerrero Jr.究竟状态如何？
在经历了他职业生涯表现最糟糕的一个赛季（仅有9记本垒打和.688的上垒率加长打率）之后，多伦多蓝鸟在公开场合表达了对Guerrero的全力支持。总经理Ross Atkins对此做出了一些解释，并明确表示他们并未发现联盟对Guerrero做出任何显著的针对性调整，他只是失去了需要找回的“感觉”。
Atkins表示：“他是一位极具爆发力的运动员和打者，这是一个非常复杂的问题。这里的每个人大概都能模仿他的节奏、节拍、点脚动作以及他是如何创造那种动量和节奏的。这真的是一件令人印象深刻的事情。随着他在赛季初就不知不觉地失去了一点这种节奏和时机，这开始影响他的自信心。一旦影响到他的自信心，场上和赛季中的调整就会变得非常困难。”
私下里，多伦多蓝鸟需要对自己非常诚实。他们是否真的相信Guerrero能在下赛季反弹并打出30多记本垒打以及.875的上垒率加长打率，还是说心存担忧？这将决定他们的休赛期计划以及如何在Guerrero周围构建打线，因为2026版本的这套打线是全棒球最差的。
Atkins还明确表示，Guerrero在2026年并未受伤，至少除了所有球员都会经历的常规酸痛和紧绷感之外，没有结构性损伤。他们认为已经找出了问题所在，但正如Atkins所说，这是“复杂的”，解决方案可能也是如此。
2. Ernie Clement是先发二垒手吗？h3.
Clement的比赛状态在这个赛季感觉有点不合拍。他的球棒在早期看起来很棒，但他的防守却出人意料地落后了。接着，在大约赛季进行四个月后情况发生了逆转。Clement进入8月时的上垒率加长打率是.738，但在8月和9月仅交出了.442的上垒率加长打率。综合考虑所有因素，这足以保住一个固定的先发位置吗？
Atkins说：“他必须靠实力赢得这一切。这不只是写下‘好的，我们搞定了’，而且他总是能做到。当他获得机会时，他总是能把握住。我们一直在尽最大努力为每位球员提供补强。Ernie可以成为一名有影响力的每日出赛球员。他也可以是一名出场[大部分]比赛并打出极高水准的球员，而且因为我们是一支很棒的球队，他不是那种每天都被写进先发名单的人。”
2025年季后赛和2026年世界棒球经典赛的参赛经历都是影响因素，尤其是对于Clement这种拼尽全力的球风而言。不过，他将面临从460万美元起步的薪资仲裁涨薪，因此这是一个灵活的阵容位置。如果多伦多蓝鸟再添置一名内场手，Clement具备防守所有内场位置的运动能力。无论如何，他下赛季几乎肯定会想方设法挤进每一场比赛。
3. 多伦多蓝鸟还能指望Anthony Santander带来贡献吗？
两年，54场比赛，.175的打击率。Santander的五年9250万美元合同开局并不顺利。
他在2026赛季末期一直在从肩部手术中进行康复，但Santander回归从未让人觉得是一个现实的选项。不过，预计他在进入2027赛季时将完全恢复健康，而多伦多蓝鸟需要弄清楚他如何融入这套阵容。h3.
Atkins说：“我们希望Tony考虑守外野，并成为我们在那里的一个选项，尽可能拥有最多的灵活性。”
Atkins表示他更倾向于让指定打击位置保持空缺。这可以让多伦多蓝鸟轮换球员上场，而在过去几个赛季George Springer占据该位置时，这并不总是一个选项。Santander仍然是下赛季获得最多指定打击先发次数的最大热门，但在目前这个阶段，多伦多蓝鸟需要将他带来的任何贡献都视为额外收获。
items.author: Keegan Matheson

items.titleEn: Crackling bats and 400-foot blasts: Sights and sounds from the Canadian Futures Showcase
bodyEn: You could see it in their smiles.

From great individual performances to winning games with brand new teammates, players understood the assignment at the Blue Jays Academy Canadian Futures Showcase: not everyone gets this opportunity, so go out and have fun.

Over the course of four days, 150 of the best high school players from across Canada came together for the 12th annual edition of the event, which was held at Rogers Field at Nat Bailey Stadium in Vancouver, B.C.

It was the first time the location had been moved outside of Ontario and an opportunity for many players, including those who had taken part the last couple of years at Rogers Centre in Toronto, to suit up somewhere new.

Just as they had in previous years, they were split into six teams then put through the paces during Scout Day on Thursday, Sept. 17, with hitting, speed and fielding drills to break down all the analytics.
At the plate and armed with wood bats, 25 players cracked exit velocities over 100 mph while seven sent baseballs over 400 feet.
Topping both was Jalen Jacob (Maple, Ont.), who crushed one during batting practice 110 mph that went 425 feet.

“Just remember that this isn’t something where it’s super-serious or it’s important to win,” said Jacob. “It’s something where you’re here just to enjoy the time with the guys. Just having a good time and showing out – that’s what keeps me going.”

Sam Ellis (La Peche, Que.) had the fastest 60-yard dash with a time of 6.25 seconds, while the top throwing velocities for position players went to catcher Tanner Morris (Sudbury, Ont.) at 90 mph, infielder Cohen Miller (Calgary, Alta.) at 91 mph, and outfielders Ethan Borovilos (Etobicoke, Ont.) and Trace Pettit (Dorchester, Ont.) shared the top speed at 92 mph.
Great days for baseball
After showing their skills to the dozens of scouts in attendance, many who wouldn’t have normally made the trek to Toronto, the players shifted their focus to games.

Under the tutelage of a cast of star coaches including former Canadian MLB players like Andrew Albers, Denis Boucher, Pete Orr, Chris Reitsma, Michael Saunders and Matt Stairs, each team played four contests over the next two-and-a-half days, aiming for a berth in Sunday’s championship finale.

Dozens of professional, college and national team scouts remained in attendance throughout the round-robin games to see how each player handled game situations, while the players enjoyed the great baseball weather provided during the duration of the event.

“My biggest goal for this tournament was just to play hard and with energy,” said Toronto-born Ira Rootman, who now resides in California and also has family in Vancouver. “Stepping into this one, it’s a new environment and I’m just going to have fun with my friends and prove what I have.”

Tournament play was about more than wins and losses through, with offensive points being awarded for wins as well as bases earned and stolen bases while defensive points were awarded for catching would-be base-stealers.
By the end of Saturday’s games, Team New Blue was the only unbeaten team and had picked up numerous bonus points, while Team Royal snuck by Team Red to earn a berth in the final.
Launching baseballs into orbit
Championship Sunday began with Daril Rodriguez (Red Deer, Alta.) looking to defend his Home Run Derby crown.
He was matched up against five others, including Theo Lima (Whitby, Ont.), Gino De Santis (Chatham, Ont.), Gabriel Lehouillier (Levis, Que.), Mikey Batiste (Mississauga, Ont.), and Jacob.
Unfortunately for Rodriguez, he wasn’t able to make it out of the first round as Lima, Batiste and Jacob all advanced.

Lima pounded six out in the final round while Batiste hit four. Then Jacob stole the show, hitting seven, complete with a towering bat flip as he watched the seventh clear the tall fence in right field.
“This means everything,” said the 6-foot-2, 248-pound lefty. “It's my third year here. I fell short two times in a row, so I'm going to hang this [championship chain] up in my room, 100 percent.”
The New Blue Crew
Then it was onto the championship game, where Team New Blue asserted itself as the most complete team once again.

De Santis hit an RBI single in the bottom of the first to start the scoring and they never looked back, scoring another in the second and two runs in each of the third and fourth innings, en route to a 6-1 win over Team Royal.
Hudson Nikkel (Vauxhall, Ab.) led the team offensively, going 1-for-2 with a two-run single in the third, while Galen Hudel (Waterloo, Ont.) scored twice and added an RBI.
“Everyone wanted to do it for the guy beside them,” Hudel said about the strong team chemistry shown. “That was kind of our motto throughout the whole week was do it for the guy beside you.”
It was an unforgettable weekend for the high school players, who now return home with new knowledge and confidence knowing they are amongst the best in the country.
Team Royal infielder Dayne Liske (Drayton Valley, Alta.) – who was named Showcase MVP after hitting .455 with a 1.637 OPS, a triple, two homers and four RBIs – says no one could have asked for more.
“Not a lot of kids get to do this,” he said. “Looking back on it one day, we’ll think it was special, so being here means a lot.”
items.titleZh: 加拿大未来之星展示会：强力挥棒与400英尺本垒打
items.summaryZh: 加拿大未来之星展示会在温哥华落幕，150名顶尖高中球员展现实力。
bodyZh: 你可以从他们的笑容中看出来。
从出色的个人表现到与全新的队友一同赢下比赛，球员们深知参加多伦多蓝鸟学院加拿大未来之星展示会的意义：并非每个人都能获得这样的机会，所以尽管放手去玩，享受乐趣。
在四天的时间里，来自全加拿大各地的150名最优秀的高中球员齐聚一堂，参加了第12届年度赛事，本次比赛在不列颠哥伦比亚省温哥华的纳特贝利体育场罗杰斯球场举行。
这是该赛事首次移师安大略省以外举行，对于许多球员来说——包括过去几年曾在多伦多罗杰斯中心参加过比赛的球员——这是一个在全新场地上披挂上阵的机会。
与往年一样，他们被分为六支球队，并在9月17日星期四的球探日接受了各项测试，通过击球、速度和守备训练来分解各项数据。
在木棒的加持下，有25名球员的击球初速超过了100英里/小时，同时有7名球员将棒球轰出了400英尺以外。
其中表现最抢眼的是来自安大略省马普尔的Jalen Jacob，他在击球练习中轰出了一记时速110英里、飞行距离达425英尺的本垒打。
“只需记住，这不是那种超级严肃或是非要分出胜负的场合，”Jalen Jacob说道，“你来到这里只是为了和队友们享受这段时光。玩得开心并展现自己——这就是支撑我不断前行的动力。”

来自魁北克省拉佩什的Sam Ellis以6.25秒的成绩跑出了最快的60码短跑，而各位置球员中传球速度最快的则包括捕手、来自安大略省萨德伯里的Tanner Morris（90英里/小时），内野手、来自艾伯塔省卡尔加里的Cohen Miller（91英里/小时），以及外野手、来自安大略省怡陶碧谷的Ethan Borovilos和来自安大略省多彻斯特的Trace Pettit，他们以92英里/小时的速度并列第一。
棒球的美好日子
在向现场数十名球探（其中许多人平时不会特意前往多伦多）展示了他们的技能之后，球员们的重心转移到了比赛上。
在众多明星教练的指导下，其中包括前加拿大MLB球员Andrew Albers、Denis Boucher、Pete Orr、Chris Reitsma、Michael Saunders和Matt Stairs，每支球队在接下来的两天半里进行了四场比赛，目标是争夺周日冠军决赛的席位。
在整个循环赛期间，数十位职业球探、大学球探和国家队球探始终在现场观察每位球员如何处理比赛中的各种局面，而球员们则享受着赛事期间绝佳的棒球天气。
“我参加这次比赛的最大目标就是拼尽全力、打出活力，”出生于多伦多、目前居住在加利福尼亚且在温哥华也有家人的Ira Rootman说道，“来到这里是一个全新的环境，我只想和朋友们一起享受乐趣，证明我自己的实力。”
然而，锦标赛的比赛不仅关乎胜负，进攻端会根据胜利以及获得的垒包和盗垒来给予积分，防守端则会根据抓获潜在盗垒者的表现来授予积分。
到周六比赛结束时，New Blue队成为唯一一支保持不败的球队，并获得了大量额外积分，而Royal队则险胜Red队，赢得了决赛席位。
将棒球轰向天际
冠军星期日从Daril Rodriguez（来自艾伯塔省雷德戴尔）卫冕本垒打大赛冠军开始。
他的对手包括其他五名球员，分别是Theo Lima（安大略省惠特比）、Gino De Santis（安大略省查塔姆）、Gabriel Lehouillier（魁北克省莱维斯）、Mikey Batiste（安大略省密西沙加）以及Jalen Jacob。
对Daril Rodriguez不幸的是，他在首轮便遭淘汰，Theo Lima、Mikey Batiste和Jalen Jacob均成功晋级。
Theo Lima在决赛轮轰出6支本垒打，Mikey Batiste击出4支。随后Jalen Jacob抢尽风头，轰出7支本垒打，当他的第七记本垒打飞越右外野高高的围墙时，他霸气地甩飞了球棒。
“这意味着一切，”这位身高6英尺2英寸、体重248磅的左打者说道，“这是我在这里的第三年。我连续两年功亏一篑，所以我百分之百要把这个[冠军项链]挂在我的房间里。”
New Blue队登顶
接下来是冠军争夺战，New Blue队再次展现了他们作为最全能球队的实力。
Gino De Santis在第一局下半敲出一支带打点的安打首开纪录，此后他们便一骑绝尘，第二局再得一分，第三局和第四局各取两分，最终以6比1击败Royal队。
Hudson Nikkel（艾伯塔省沃克斯霍尔）在进攻端表现出色，全场2打数1安打并在第三局贡献一支两分打点安打，而Galen Hudel（安大略省滑铁卢）则跑回两分并有一分打点。
“每个人都想为了身边的队友去拼，”Galen Hudel在谈到球队展现出的强大凝聚力时说道，“这可以说是我们整个星期的座右铭，那就是为了你身边的队友去战斗。”
对于这些高中球员来说，这是一个难忘的周末，他们带着新的知识和自信返回家乡，深知自己已跻身全国最优秀球员之列。
Royal队内野手Dayne Liske（艾伯塔省德雷顿山谷）——他以.455的打击率、1.637的攻击指数、一支三垒安打、两支本垒打和4分打点的表现被评为展示会MVP——表示没有人能奢求更多了。
“没有多少孩子能有这样的经历，”他说，“回首往事的那一天，我们会觉得这段经历弥足珍贵，所以能来到这里意义重大。”
items.author: Joe McFarland

items.titleEn: The final Top 100 Prospects list of the year has a new look
bodyEn: The Minor League playoffs have been completed. There are only a handful of players with prospect eligibility remaining left in the Major League postseason, and there will be fewer with each passing round. Time for us in prospectdom to go into offseason mode? Not so fast, friends.

The Arizona Fall League takes over our world beginning with Opening Day this Saturday. It’s like a baseball groundhog in Peoria has allowed us six more weeks of summer. But before we get to the start of our autumn and the eventual turn to winter, let’s give more of a spruce up to the Top 100 prospects list.

This isn’t a full revamp like we do for the preseason and in-season Top 100 updates. Rather, this is one of our occasional market corrections, a series of tweaks to get the rankings in a better shape ahead of the AFL, 40-man roster decisions and other offseason moves. As such, we revoted on the Top 15 completely, moved other prospects up or down 10 or more spots as needed, took a few names off the list and replaced them with fresh ones.
Let’s dive in:
Top 15

1. Jesús Made, SS, Brewers2. Franklin Arias, SS, Red Sox3. Leo De Vries, SS/3B, Athletics4. Josue De Paula, OF, Dodgers5. Kade Anderson, LHP, Mariners6. Eli Willits, SS, Nationals7. Josuar Gonzalez, SS, Giants8. Sebastian Walcott, SS/3B, Rangers9. Seth Hernandez, RHP, Pirates10. Rainiel Rodriguez, C/1B, Cardinals11. Ryan Sloan, RHP, Mariners12. Grady Emerson, SS, Rays13. Walker Jenkins, OF, Twins14. Roch Cholowsky, SS, White Sox15. Eduardo Quintero, OF, Dodgers

With Made holding onto the top spot, the headlining move here is that Arias slides above De Vries into the No. 2 spot. Boston’s top prospect completed a breakout age-20 campaign -- particularly in the power department -- and finished with a .323/.400/.557 and career-high 25 homers in 117 games between Double-A and Triple-A. Despite his age, he continued to make a ton of contact in zone in his first move to the Minors’ top level, and his slugging gains could get him to above-average pop long term, which would be hugely valuable given his defensive gifts at short give him a solid floor already anyways. He leaps over De Vries, who underwent right shoulder surgery on Sept. 14 and could need up to eight months for a full recovery.

De Paula also moves up to the Top 4 -- despite his well-known defensive limitations in the outfield -- after looking like the most talented hitting prospect in the Minors. The 21-year-old slugger got more aggressive at the plate but still managed to improve his contact rate at Double-A Tulsa and maintain his plus power. Those were big reasons why Los Angeles promoted him straight from the Texas League last month when it needed a DH replacement for Shohei Ohtani, and De Paula responded to the aggressive move by going 10-for-31 (.323) with a homer and 11 walks in 11 games with the big club.

Gonzalez and Rodriguez -- ranked 15th and 16th in our most recent list -- each jump into the Top 10 for the first time. The Giants switch-hitting shortstop continued to perform in his move stateside in the Arizona Complex League and Single-A San Jose, and he’s considered one of the most gifted defensive shortstops in the Minors, giving him true five-tool potential ahead of his 19th birthday later this month. Rodriguez had one of the greatest finishing sprints of the regular season, hitting .417/.482/.806 with 14 homers, 16 walks and only 20 strikeouts over 168 plate appearances as a 19-year-old in his final 36 games of the season with Double-A Springfield. The Cardinals will explore expanding his defensive versatility -- potentially with time at third base -- in order to find him a place in St. Louis, but Rodriguez is showing a bat that can play anywhere.

Walcott (No. 8) and Quintero (No. 15) will be the top two prospects in this year’s Fall League. The former returned from internal brace surgery in mid-July and displayed a pretty right-handed swing geared to tap into his significant raw power; next up will be proving himself defensively after making only two starts at shortstop in the regular season as he built back from the elbow injury. Quintero pushed his way into the Top 15 after displaying strong data at High-A Great Lakes that married high contact and impressive impact for an age-20 player. His approach can border on passivity with just a 33.9 percent swing rate in the Midwest League, but he otherwise deserves points for being a plus runner who could be valuable in any of the three outfield spots.
Highest risers
+19 Leo Bernal, C/1B, Cardinals (99 to 80)+17 Joseph Dzierwa, LHP, Orioles (86 to 69)+17 Marek Houston, SS, Twins (71 to 54)+17 Seaver King, SS/2B, Nationals (68 to 51)

One reason the Cardinals might explore moving Rodriguez around is that Bernal looks like he seized the club’s Major League starting catching job, both for 2027 and beyond. After a solid showing at Triple-A Memphis that featured a career-high 16 homers and a 116 wRC+ over 101 games, the switch-hitting backstop hit .284/.333/.474 with five homers in 24 games for St. Louis down the stretch. He also earned solid defensive marks across the board, including an average 1.88 second-base pop time that ranked in the Majors’ 86th percentile. He whiffed a little bit more than you’d like in his first taste of the bigs, but otherwise, he heads into the offseason with a strong (if smallish) MLB résumé for a 22-year-old backstop.

Dzierwa could have been forgiven if he’d wilted down the stretch of a breakout first full season, but that didn’t happen; in fact, he had a 2.32 ERA with 33 strikeouts and six walks over his final six starts (31 innings) for Double-A Chesapeake. The 6-foot-8 southpaw made it through 131 innings in his first Minor League campaign, and even if his changeup is the closest thing to a plus pitch in his bag right now, his exceptional command and control kept him successful throughout 2026 and fueled his rise in the ranks.

Houston looked like he was fading in August but caught fire again in September, ending his first first full season on a 10-game hitting streak in which he hit .405 with eight strikeouts and seven walks over 50 plate appearances. The 2025 16th overall pick is certainly hit-tool forward offensively, but with his strong base of speed and defense at a premium position, he’s just a few power improvements from being in more solid standing for a Top 50 spot.

After some struggles with offensive consistency in 2025, King started showing signs of a turnaround in the Arizona Fall League last year and carried that momentum into his second full season. His 21 homers (16 of which came with Triple-A Rochester) marked a new career high, and he posted a 104.9 mph 90th-percentile exit velocity and 110.9 mph max EV that made the power gains look stickier, even more so if he can lift the ball more often. His ability to play short might factor into Washington’s plans to move CJ Abrams to second base.
New faces
98. Hayden Alvarez, OF, Angels99. Enddy Azocar, OF, Orioles

Alvarez gives the Halos a third Top 100 prospect behind Arjun Nimmala (No. 34) and Tyler Bremner (No. 42). Playing in his age-19 season, Alvarez showed off a solid approach at Single-A and High-A to finish with a solid .391 on-base percentage over 118 games, and while the power still isn’t showing up in major ways yet, he did connect on a career-high 12 homers and has room in his 6-foot-3 frame to add more strength as he enters his 20s. He also has plus speed that helped him steal 53 bags in ‘26, and we considered that entire package when adding him to the T100.

Another 19-year-old, Azocar joined the Orioles system from the Red Sox in the Trade Deadline blockbuster that moved Adley Rutschman the other way. He kept on producing in his second organization, finishing with an .885 OPS, 21 homers and 20 steals across 110 games at Single-A and High-A on the year. His contact rate actually jumped almost 10 points from Greenville (69.7 percent) and Frederick (79.3) to compare two High-A assignments, and that will deserve monitoring considering he already has the potential for above-average power and speed.
Biggest droppers

-22 Billy Carlson, SS, White Sox (59 to 81)-20 Josue Briceño, C/1B, Tigers (66 to 86)-15 Josh Hammond, SS/3B, Royals (67 to 82)-13 Thomas White, LHP, Marlins (34 to 47)-13 Felnin Celesten, SS, Mariners (47 to 60)-13 Jonny Farmelo, OF, Mariners (70 to 83)-12 Demetrio Crisantes, 2B, D-backs (72 to 84)-10 Xavier Neyens, 3B/SS, Astros (90 to 100)

Carlson missed almost two months with a torn left thumb ligament from May to July and then didn’t play after Aug. 9 due to a skin infection, thus finishing out the year with only 57 games with Single-A Kannapolis. While his defense remains phenomenal, he didn’t homer once in his limited first full season and the plurality of his batted balls (41.8 percent) went the other way, causing a slip in his stock. Similarly, Briceño began his year with right wrist surgery and ended it with a right ankle sprain -- two injuries that allowed him to play only 32 games at the Minors’ upper levels. The 6-foot-4 left-handed slugger has special power, but he’s played more than 56 games in a campaign only once since reaching full-season ball in 2023.

Hammond got off to an impressive start at Single-A Columbia in his first full season, and his improved chances of sticking at shortstop only increased enthusiasm. But he only slugged .312 over his final 40 games to finish as a league-average bat in the Carolina League on the year as a whole. White, who missed much of the year with a left shoulder capsular strain, slid back to put him in a more appropriate position compared to his fellow lefty pitchers.

Celesten, who was named Northwest League MVP in ‘26, really struggled after a late-season promotion to Double-A Arkansas, where he hit .171 with a 44 wRC+ and 33.6 percent K rate no thanks to an aggressive approach that led to much swing-and-miss. It was an overall positive season for Farmelo in that he was healthy and easily cleared 100 games played for the first time in his career; the larger sample size also proved how exposed he can be to swing-and-miss against softer stuff as was the case in his 46-game turn at Double-A.

Crisantes and Neyens drop for opposite reasons. The former is a hit-tool-first second baseman who lacked significant impact after a late-season callup to Triple-A Reno with a 100.8 mph 90th-percentile EV there. (He isn’t done in 2026 with the AFL next up on his docket.) Neyens has plus-plus raw power from the left side but made contact on only 60.8 percent of his swings over 35 games with High-A Asheville. That’s when he did swing because he only offered on 30.3 percent of the pitches he saw at the level, and that’s a level of passivity that can make him a difficult evaluation heading into his age-20 season of 2027.
Moving out
Karson Milbrandt, RHP, Marlins (from 75)Steele Hall, SS, Reds (from 88)

After absolutely dominating for Double-A Pensacola to begin 2026, Milbrandt struggled to find the strike zone with any consistency at Triple-A Jacksonville, where he had an 8.39 ERA with 62 strikeouts and 52 walks in 64 1/3 innings. His three primary pitches (four-seamer, slider, sweeper) each had slugging percentages against of .460 or higher in the International League.

The Reds took Hall ninth overall in 2025 as a long-term project considering he was 17 on Draft Day, and that remains the case. However, he struggled with contact after a late July move from the Arizona Complex League to Single-A Daytona -- for example, his in-zone contact rate was in the low 70s -- and he’ll have to exhibit adjustments at the plate to get back on this list.
items.titleZh: 年度最后一份百大潜力新秀榜面貌焕然一新
items.summaryZh: 百大潜力新秀榜单迎来更新，多位球星在榜单上位置发生变动，亚利桑那秋季联赛即将开打。
bodyZh: 小联盟季后赛已经结束。在现存的大联盟季后赛球队中，仅剩少数几位仍具潜力新秀资格的球员，且随着每一轮赛事的推进人数还将减少。我们这些关注潜力新秀的人是时候进入休赛期模式了吗？朋友们，别急。
亚利桑那秋季联赛将于本周六的揭幕战开始接管我们的视线。这就好比皮奥里亚的一只棒球土拨鼠让我们多享受了六周的夏天。但在我们迎来秋天并最终转入冬天之前，让我们对百大潜力新秀榜单进行一次更多的修整。
这并不是像我们对季前和赛季中百大更新那样的大规模重组。相反，这是我们偶尔进行的市场修正之一，是一系列微调，旨在为秋季联赛、40人名单决策以及其他休赛期运作做好更充分的排名准备。因此，我们对前15名进行了完全重新投票，根据需要将其他潜力新秀上下移动了10个或更多的顺位，并从榜单中去除了一些名字，换上了新鲜血液。
让我们深入了解：
前15名

1. Jesús Made, 游击手, 密尔沃基酿酒人 2. Franklin Arias, 游击手, 波士顿红袜 3. Leo De Vries, 游击手/三垒手, 运动家 4. Josue De Paula, 外野手, 洛杉矶道奇 5. Kade Anderson, 左投, 西雅图水手 6. Eli Willits, 游击手, 华盛顿国民 7. Josuar Gonzalez, 游击手, 旧金山巨人 8. Sebastian Walcott, 游击手/三垒手, 得克萨斯游骑兵 9. Seth Hernandez, 右投, 匹兹堡海盗 10. Rainiel Rodriguez, 捕手/一垒手, 圣路易斯红雀 11. Ryan Sloan, 右投, 西雅图水手 12. Grady Emerson, 游击手, 坦帕湾光芒 13. Walker Jenkins, 外野手, 明尼苏达双城 14. Roch Cholowsky, 游击手, 芝加哥白袜 15. Eduardo Quintero, 外野手, 洛杉矶道奇

随着Made保住榜首位置，最引人注目的变动是Arias超越De Vries升至第二位。这位波士顿顶级潜力新秀完成了一个突破性的20岁赛季——尤其是在长打能力方面——在双A和三A的117场比赛中交出.323/.400/.557的打击三围，并创下生涯新高的25支本垒打。尽管年龄尚轻，在他首次升入小联盟顶级层级时，他依然在好球带内保持了极高的击球率，而他长打能力的提升可能会在远期为他带来高于平均水平的爆发力，鉴于他在游击位置上的防守天赋已经为他奠定了坚实的下限，这无论如何都将极具价值。他超越了于9月14日接受右肩手术、可能需要长达八个月才能完全康复的De Vries。

尽管De Paula在场上防守有着众所周知的局限性，但他看起来像是小联盟中最具天赋的打击新秀，这也使他跻身前四。这位21岁强打者在打击区上变得更具侵略性，但仍设法在双A图尔萨提升了击球率并保持了其出色的力量。这些都是上个月当洛杉矶需要为大谷翔平寻找指定打击替代者时，将他直接从得克萨斯联盟提拔上来的重要原因，De Paula通过在11场大联盟比赛中31打数10安打（.323打击率）、击出1支本垒打并选到11次保送的优异表现回应了这一激进的运作。

Gonzalez和Rodriguez——在我们最近的榜单中分别排名第15和第16——双双首次闯入前十。这位巨人的左右开弓游击手在来到美国本土并在亚利桑那秋季联盟和单A圣何塞出赛期间持续交出好表现，他被认为是小联盟中最具防守天赋的游击手之一，并在本月晚些时候19岁生日到来之前展现出真正的五拍子潜力。Rodriguez在常规赛收官阶段迎来了最伟大的冲刺之一，作为一名在双A斯普林菲尔德度过赛季最后36场比赛的19岁球员，他在168个打席中交出.417/.482/.806的打击三围，轰出14支本垒打，选到16次保送，仅吞下20次三振。红雀队将探索拓展他的防守多面性——可能安排三垒守备时间——以便为他在圣路易斯找到一席之地，但Rodriguez展现出的打击棒子在任何地方都能发挥作用。

Walcott（第8位）和Quintero（第15位）将是今年秋季联赛中排名最高的两名潜力新秀。前者在7月中旬从内支架手术中复出，并展示了相当出色的右打挥棒，旨在发挥他巨大的天生力量；接下来他需要在常规赛中证明自己的防守能力，由于从手肘伤势中恢复，他在常规赛中仅在游击位置首发过两次。Quintero在高级单A五大湖展现出高击球率与惊人击球力道的强劲数据后，杀入前15名，这对于一名20岁球员来说实属不易。他的打法有时近乎被动，在中西部联盟的挥棒率仅为33.9%，但除此之外，他作为一名出色的跑者赢得了认可，能够在三个外野位置上都展现价值。
上升最快的球员
+19 Leo Bernal, 捕手/一垒手, 圣路易斯红雀（从99升至80） +17 Joseph Dzierwa, 左投, 巴尔的摩金莺（从86升至69） +17 Marek Houston, 游击手, 明尼苏达双城（从71升至54） +17 Seaver King, 游击手/二垒手, 华盛顿国民（从68升至51）

红雀队可能探索轮换Rodriguez位置的一个原因是，Bernal看起来已经牢牢占据了球队大联盟的主力捕手位置，无论是2027年还是更远的未来。在三A孟菲斯有过稳健表现（在101场比赛中交出生涯新高的16支本垒打和116的wRC+）之后，这位左右开弓的捕手在圣路易斯收官阶段的24场比赛中交出.284/.333/.474的打击三围和5支本垒打。他在全方位的防守上也赢得了不错的评分，包括平均1.88秒的二垒传球时间，在全大联盟中排名第86百分位。在初登大联盟时，他吞下的三振比人们所希望的要稍微多了一些，但除此之外，对于一名22岁的捕手而言，他带着一份强劲（尽管样本较小）的大联盟履历进入休赛期。

如果Dzierwa在突破性的第一个完整赛季收官阶段表现疲软，人们本可以原谅他，但并没有发生这种情况；事实上，他在双A切萨皮克的最后六场比赛（31局）中投出了2.32的自责分率，送出33次三振和6次保送。这位身高6尺8寸的左投在他的第一个小联盟赛季中投满了131局，即便他的变速球是他目前武器库中最接近单项优质的球路，但他杰出的控球和制球能力让他在整个2026赛季都保持成功，并推动了他在榜单上的排名上升。
Houston在8月时看起来有些状态下滑，但在9月再度火热起来，以一场10场安打的连续安打秀结束了他的第一个完整赛季，在50个打席中交出.405的打击率，送出8次三振和7次保送。这位2025年整体第16顺位新秀在进攻端显然是以打击技巧见长，但凭借其出色的速度基础以及在关键防守位置上的能力，他只需在力量上做一些提升，便能在前50名的榜单中站得更稳。

在2025年进攻稳定性遭遇一些挣扎后，King在去年的亚利桑那秋季联赛中开始展现出好转迹象，并将这种势头延续到了他的第二个完整赛季。他轰出的21支本垒打（其中16支在三A罗切斯特打出）创下了生涯新高，并且交出了104.9英里的第90百分位击球初速以及110.9英里的最高击球初速，这让力量的增长看起来更加稳定，如果他能更频繁地打出高飞球，这种增长甚至会更加显著。他防守游击的能力可能会影响华盛顿将CJ Abrams移防二垒的计划。
新面孔
98. Hayden Alvarez, 外野手, 洛杉矶天使 99. Enddy Azocar, 外野手, 巴尔的摩金莺

Alvarez为天使队在Arjun Nimmala（第34位）和Tyler Bremner（第42位）之后增添了第三位百大潜力新秀。在19岁的赛季中，Alvarez在单A和高级单A展现了稳健的打击策略，在118场比赛结束时交出了.391的稳健上垒率，虽然力量尚未以重大方式展现，但他确实轰出了生涯新高的12支本垒打，并且随着他迈入20岁，他那6尺3寸的体格仍有空间增添更多力量。他还拥有出色的速度，帮助他在26赛季盗走了53个垒包，我们在将他加入百大时综合考虑了整体能力。

另一位19岁球员Azocar在交易截止日轰动性地将Adley Rutschman送往对家的交易中，从红袜队加入金莺体系。他在第二支球机构中持续产出，在单A和高级单A的110场比赛中交出.885的OPS、21支本垒打和20次盗垒。对比两个高级单A的指派，他的击球率实际上从格林维尔（69.7%）和弗雷德里克（79.3%）大幅跳升了近10个百分点，鉴于他已经具备高于平均水平的力量和速度潜力，这非常值得持续关注。
跌幅最大的球员

-22 Billy Carlson, 游击手, 芝加哥白袜（从59降至81） -20 Josue Briceño, 捕手/一垒手, 底特律老虎（从66降至86） -15 Josh Hammond, 游击手/三垒手, 堪萨斯城皇家（从67降至82） -13 Thomas White, 左投, 迈阿密马林鱼（从34降至47） -13 Felnin Celesten, 游击手, 西雅图水手（从47降至60） -13 Jonny Farmelo, 外野手, 西雅图水手（从70降至83） -12 Demetrio Crisantes, 二垒手, 亚利桑那响尾蛇（从72降至84） -10 Xavier Neyens, 三垒手/游击手, 休斯敦太空人（从90降至100）

Carlson在5月到7月期间因左手拇指韧带撕裂缺阵了近两个月，随后又因皮肤感染自8月9日后未能出场，因此整个赛季在单A坎纳波利斯仅打了57场比赛。尽管他的防守依然极其出色，但在他受限的第一个完整赛季里他没有击出一支本垒打，且他的击球多数（41.8%）被推向反方向，导致他的身价下滑。同样地，Briceño以右腕手术开始赛季，并以右脚踝扭伤结束赛季——这两次伤病使他在小联盟高级层级中仅出场32场比赛。这位身高6尺4寸的左打强打者拥有特殊的力量，但自2023年进入全赛季球季以来，他单个赛季出场超过56场的次数只有一次。
Hammond在他的第一个完整赛季在单A哥伦比亚迎来了令人印象深刻的开局，他留在游击防区几率的提升增强了人们的热情。但在最后40场比赛中，他的长打率仅为.312，最终在整个卡罗拉纳联盟中成为一名联盟平均水平的打者。White因左肩关节囊拉伤缺席了大半个赛季，他的排名有所回落，这使他与同为左投手的队友相比处于一个更合适的定位。

在26年荣获西北联盟MVP的Celesten在赛季末被提拔到双A阿肯色后陷入了极大的挣扎，在那里他交出.171的打击率、44的wRC+以及33.6%的三振率，这少不了激进打法导致大量挥空的原因。对Farmelo而言，这整体是一个积极的赛季，因为他保持了健康，职业生涯中首次轻松突破100场出场；更大的样本量也证明了他在面对较慢球速时面对挥空是多么容易暴露出弱点，就像他在双A的46场出赛中所经历的那样。

Crisantes和Neyens因相反的原因排名下跌。前者是一位以打击技巧为主的二垒手，在赛季末被提拔到三A里诺后缺乏显著的打击爆发力，其第90百分位击球初速为100.8英里。（随着秋季联赛提上日程，他在2026年的征程尚未结束。）Neyens拥有来自左侧的极佳天生力量，但在高级单A阿什维尔的35场比赛中，他的挥棒击球率仅为60.8%。这是在他确实选择挥棒的情况下，因为他在该层级面对的球中仅有30.3%选择出棒，这种被动程度使他在迈入2027年20岁赛季时成为一个很难评估的对象。
掉出榜单
Karson Milbrandt, 右投, 迈阿密马林鱼（原第75位） Steele Hall, 游击手, 辛辛那提红人（原第88位）
在2026赛季初为双A彭萨科拉展现绝对压制力之后，Milbrandt在三A杰克逊维尔难以稳定找到好球带，在那里他在64.3局中投出了8.39的自责分率，送出62次三振和52次保送。他的三种主要球路（四缝线速球、滑球、横扫滑球）在国际联盟中被对手打出的长打率均达到.460或更高。
红桃队在2025年以第9顺位选中Hall，由于他在选秀日时年仅17岁，将其视作长期培养项目，目前情况依然如此。然而，在7月下旬从亚利桑那秋季联盟转入单A代顿后，他在击球上面临挣扎——例如，他的好球带内击球率仅在70%出头——他必须在打击区做出调整才能重返这份榜单。
items.author: Sam Dykstra

items.titleEn: Blue Jays GM Atkins, CEO Shapiro talk Guerrero, offseason needs
bodyEn: TORONTO -- This offseason will be long and complicated, but the Blue Jays’ problems are short and simple. They need to score more runs. That’s it.

Every conversation we have about the Blue Jays this winter will come back to their offense, which ranked last in homers (152) and runs scored (648) in 2026. Even if they cloned starter Dylan Cease and built an entire rotation out of him, this is such a frustrating way to live, forever stuck in low-scoring games and too often lacking the firepower to do much about it.
Just days after Toronto finished last place in the American League East with a 79-83 record, general manager Ross Atkins and president and CEO Mark Shapiro kept coming back to the same topic.

“Offensively, we never gained any momentum. We never put the ball in the seats,” Atkins said. “We’re not walking, we’re not getting on base nearly enough. When that happens, you’re relying on line drives in gaps. The contact just wasn’t enough.”

This offseason will bring all of the usual tinkering, likely by adding a starter or two, or perhaps some depth in the bullpen. But it feels like something more substantial is needed to fix the Blue Jays' offense, something that changes the DNA of this group and points them in a different direction.

Free agency isn’t overflowing with answers. Expect the Blue Jays to be one of the most aggressive suitors for Cubs outfielder Seiya Suzuki -- one of the most obvious fits -- while the Mariners' Randy Arozarena and the Pirates' Brandon Lowe also sit near the top of a weak position player class.

Japan could be the key to the Blue Jays’ offseason once again, one year after landing third baseman Kazuma Okamoto on a four-year, $60 million deal, which has paid dividends after he led the team with 33 homers. Looking to expand their organization’s presence in Japan both on and off the field, the Blue Jays will send a contingent across the Pacific this winter, and Shapiro may make a trip, too.

The headliner of this year's international class is Japanese star Teruaki Sato, a 27-year-old power hitter who's hit 38 home runs with the Hanshin Tigers of the Nippon Professional Baseball League in 2026. Sato also represented Team Japan at the World Baseball Classic.
The Blue Jays have worked hard to make themselves not just an option, but a destination for top talent out of Asia.
That said, just how much help this offense needs is up to one man, Vladimir Guerrero Jr.

Guerrero is coming off one of the most disappointing seasons we’ve seen from a star in this franchise’s history, hitting just nine home runs with a .688 OPS, all with the backdrop of his new 14-year, $500 million deal he signed in April 2025. That is the Blue Jays’ No. 1 problem and priority to fix.

“[Guerrero]'s such a dynamic athlete and hitter that it’s a really complex problem,” Atkins said. “Everyone in here can probably emulate his rhythm and tempo, that toe tap and how he creates that momentum. It’s a really impressive thing to watch. As he lost a little bit of that rhythm and timing pretty early in the season, it started to impact his confidence. Once it impacted his confidence, the in-game adjustments and in-season adjustments became very difficult.”

Like Atkins, Shapiro threw his support behind Guerrero, calling him “one of the most special offensive players in this game and in the history of this franchise.” Everyone within 100 miles of this ball club knows, however, that Guerrero needs to rebound in a major way for any of this to work.

“I tried to think through whether I’d experienced anything like that,” Shapiro said. “I can remember slumps with great players, players who in the past, we were dependent on for success and how that all feels, but usually they don’t last as long as this one lasted. There’s just such an overwhelming level of compassion for him because of our belief in him, the same belief that led us to where we are and the commitment we made to him.”

While the postseason rolls on without the Blue Jays, their front office will obsess over the answers to Guerrero’s problems, along with every other player on this roster. Then, the attention turns to adding, or perhaps even overhauling, this roster.

Aggression has never been the front office’s issue. They’ve traded top prospects and former first-round picks repeatedly. Backed by one of the top-spending owners in baseball, there’s no limit to what the Blue Jays could do this winter, but they’ve got to get it right. And no matter how it happens, they’ve got to score more runs in 2027.
items.titleZh: 蓝鸟总经理Atkins、CEO Shapiro谈Guerrero与休赛期需求
items.summaryZh: 多伦多蓝鸟管理层谈论休赛期补强方向及如何解决球队进攻火力不足的问题。
bodyZh: 多伦多讯——这个休赛期将会漫长而复杂，但多伦多蓝鸟的问题却很短小且简单。他们需要得到更多分数。就这样。
这个冬天我们关于蓝鸟的每一次讨论都会回到他们的进攻上，该队在2026年的本垒打数（152个）和得分（648分）均排名垫底。即便他们克隆一个先发投手Dylan Cease并用他组建整支轮换阵容，这种生活方式也太让人沮丧了，永远陷在低比分比赛中，并且常常缺乏足够的火力来改变现状。
就在多伦多以79胜83负的战绩在美国联盟东区垫底几天后，总经理Ross Atkins以及总裁兼CEO Mark Shapiro反复谈到了同一个话题。
“在进攻端，我们从未获得任何势头。我们没能把球打出球场，”Atkins说道。“我们没有获得足够的保送，上垒率远远不够。当这种情况发生时，你就只能依靠空当处安打。击球力度实在不够。”
这个休赛期将伴随着所有常规的小修小补，可能会引进一两名先发投手，或者增加一些牛棚深度。但感觉修复蓝鸟的进攻需要更实质性的东西，需要改变这支球队的基因并将其引向不同的方向。
自由球员市场并不缺乏答案。预计蓝鸟将成为芝加哥小熊外野手Seiya Suzuki最积极的追求者之一——这是最明显的契合点——而西雅图水手的Randy Arozarena和匹兹堡海盗的Brandon Lowe也在这份实力较弱的野手名单的头部。
在以四年6000万美元签下三垒手Kazuma Okamoto一年之后，日本可能会再次成为蓝鸟休赛期关键所在。Okamoto本赛季以33记本垒打领跑全队，这笔签约收到了回报。为了扩大该组织在场内外的日本影响力，蓝鸟今年冬天将派遣代表团跨越太平洋，Shapiro也可能会亲自前往。
今年国际球员市场的头条人物是日本球星Teruaki Sato，这位27岁的强力打者在2026年效力于日本职业棒球联盟的阪神虎队时击出了38个本垒打。Sato还代表日本队参加了世界棒球经典赛。
蓝鸟一直在努力让自己不仅成为一个选项，更成为来自亚洲的顶级人才的目的地。
话虽如此，这个进攻端到底需要多少帮助，归根结底取决于一个人，那就是Vladimir Guerrero Jr.。
Guerrero刚刚经历了一名球星在该队历史上最令人失望的赛季之一，他仅打出9个本垒打，OPS为.688，而这一切的背景是他刚刚在2025年4月签下的14年5亿美元新合同。这是蓝鸟的头号问题和首要解决任务。
“[Guerrero]是一名如此充满活力和运动能力的打者，以至于这是一个非常复杂的问题，”Atkins说道。“这里的每个人大概都能模仿他的节奏和拍子，那个点地动作以及他是如何带动势头的。这真的是一件令人印象深刻的事情。随着他在赛季初失去了一点节奏和时机，这开始影响他的自信心。一旦影响了他的自信心，比赛中的调整和赛季中的调整就变得非常困难。”
和Atkins一样，Shapiro表达了对Guerrero的支持，称他是“这项运动和本球队历史上最特殊的进攻球员之一”。然而，这支球团周围方圆百里的人都知道，Guerrero需要在很大程度上反弹，这一切才能奏效。
“我试图回想我是否经历过类似的事情，”Shapiro说道。“我能记起伟大球员的低潮，那些过去我们依赖他们来取得成功的球员，以及这一切感觉如何，但通常它们不会持续这么久。出于对他的信任，人们对他有一种压倒性的同情，正是这种信任引领我们走到今天，也是我们对他的承诺。”
当季后赛在没有蓝鸟参与的情况下继续进行时，他们的管理层将全神贯注于解决Guerrero的问题，以及名单上的每一位球员。然后，注意力将转向补强甚至彻底重组这支阵容。
积极进取从来不是管理层的难题。他们曾多次交易顶级潜力新秀和前首轮选秀权。在棒球界顶级挥霍老板之一的支持下，蓝鸟今年冬天能做的事情没有限制，但他们必须做对。无论如何，他们在2027年必须得到更多分数。
